questions.explanation: Exercise Amogh Jwala was conducted by the Southern Command of the Indian Army at the Babina Field Firing Ranges in Uttar Pradesh from 6 to 18 March 2026. The exercise aimed to validate advanced combat capabilities, including the integration of mechanised forces, Apache helicopters, and unmanned aerial systems. It also tested network-enabled warfare systems for real-time communication and decision-making. The drills emphasized modern warfare strategies such as electronic warfare, air defence coordination, and night operations, demonstrating the army’s preparedness for future, technology-driven battle scenarios.

questions.question: Where was India’s first indigenously developed Floating LiDAR Buoy System successfully tested?
questions.explanation: India’s first indigenous Floating LiDAR Buoy System was successfully tested off the Muttom coast in Tamil Nadu by the National Institute of Ocean Technology (NIOT). This milestone demonstrates India’s growing capability in advanced marine and atmospheric monitoring technologies. The system uses laser-based remote sensing to measure wind characteristics up to 300 meters above sea level, making it highly useful for offshore wind energy projects. Its design allows deployment in deep-sea conditions and resilience against harsh tropical weather. This innovation also supports India’s renewable energy goals and reduces dependence on costly foreign technology, strengthening self-reliance.

questions.question: Which company launched an AI hub at GIFT City, Gandhinagar, to deliver AI-powered BFSI services globally?
questions.explanation: Wipro, one of India’s leading IT companies, launched an AI hub at GIFT City in Gandhinagar to provide advanced AI-powered services to global Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance (BFSI) clients. The hub focuses on delivering solutions such as digital banking, regulatory technology, and risk management systems. It is designed with scalable capacity and aims to enhance innovation using the Wipro Intelligence platform. This initiative strengthens India’s position as a global fintech hub, promotes high-skilled job creation, and supports the growth of AI-driven financial services and digital transformation.

questions.question: Which country has partnered with India for the restoration of the Prambanan Temple complex?
questions.explanation: India has collaborated with Indonesia to restore the historic 9th-century Prambanan Temple complex located in Yogyakarta. This initiative highlights strong cultural and diplomatic ties between the two nations. The restoration will be carried out using the anastylosis method to preserve authenticity, with support from the Archaeological Survey of India. The project also faces challenges such as identifying and assembling thousands of scattered stone blocks. This collaboration reflects India’s “Act East” policy and emphasises shared civilizational heritage, as Prambanan is a UNESCO World Heritage Site dedicated to the Hindu Trimurti.

questions.question: Which company signed an MoU with the University of Science and Technology Beijing for research on low-carbon steelmaking technologies?
questions.explanation: Tata Steel is the company that partnered with the University of Science and Technology Beijing to advance research in low-carbon steelmaking technologies. The collaboration focuses on areas such as scrap-based steel production, waste valorisation, carbon capture, and improving end-product performance. By leveraging advanced research facilities, the partnership aims to scale innovative solutions for industrial use. This initiative aligns with broader sustainability goals, helping reduce carbon emissions in the steel sector and promoting environmentally responsible manufacturing practices through global cooperation and technological advancement.

questions.question: Which year was the Dentists Act, repealed during the establishment of the National Dental Commission, originally enacted?
questions.explanation: The Dentists Act served as the foundational legal framework regulating dental education and practice in India for several decades. Enacted in 1948, it governed the functioning of the Dental Council of India until recent reforms replaced it with the National Dental Commission. The repeal of this Act represents a major step toward modernizing the regulatory structure. By moving away from an older system, the government aims to improve transparency, ensure better standards in dental education, and align India's healthcare framework with global best practices.

questions.question: Which company received RBI approval for an indirect change in control of its subsidiaries following a major investment by Bain Capital?
questions.explanation: Manappuram Finance Ltd is the company whose subsidiaries are undergoing an indirect change in control following RBI approval. A significant development in India’s financial sector involves a major investment by Bain Capital into key subsidiaries dealing with microfinance and housing finance. This investment required regulatory approval due to changes in ownership and management structure. The Reserve Bank of India granted this approval, allowing the transaction to proceed. The deal includes a capital infusion and an open offer under SEBI regulations, expected to alter shareholding patterns and strengthen the company’s growth potential.

questions.question: Which shipbuilding company signed a contract with the Shipping Corporation of India for constructing India’s first methanol dual-fuel vessel?
questions.explanation: Mazagon Dock Shipbuilders Limited is the company that entered into a landmark agreement with the Shipping Corporation of India for building India’s first indigenously developed methanol dual-fuel vessel. This project represents a major advancement in green maritime technology, incorporating a diesel-electric propulsion system capable of using methanol as an alternative fuel. The initiative supports environmental sustainability by reducing harmful emissions such as greenhouse gases and sulfur oxides. It also strengthens domestic shipbuilding under national initiatives like “Make in India” while contributing to long-term goals of a cleaner and technologically advanced maritime sector.

questions.question: Where is the ‘Bharat Innovates Deep-Tech Pre-Summit’ being organised by the Ministry of Education in March 2026?
questions.explanation: IIT Bombay is hosting the ‘Bharat Innovates Deep-Tech Pre-Summit’ organised by the Ministry of Education as part of a broader initiative to promote deep-tech innovation in India. The event is held at the IIT Bombay Research Park and serves as a platform for showcasing cutting-edge technologies developed by startups and academic institutions. It also acts as a selection stage for India’s participation in global innovation events. By bringing together startups, investors, and industry leaders, the summit aims to accelerate the commercialisation of research and strengthen India’s position in emerging technology sectors.

questions.question: Which organisation launched the 5G Innovation Hackathon 2026 to promote scalable solutions using 5G, AI, and IoT?
questions.explanation: The 5G Innovation Hackathon 2026 is a major initiative aimed at fostering innovation in next-generation technologies such as 5G, artificial intelligence, and the Internet of Things. It is part of a broader effort to create practical and scalable use cases through collaboration between students, startups, and industry participants. The Department of Telecommunications is the key body responsible for organising this event under the Ministry of Communications. By providing funding, infrastructure, and intellectual property support, the initiative seeks to accelerate technological advancements and strengthen India’s position in the global digital ecosystem.

questions.question: Which country partnered with India to strengthen postal cooperation and enhance regional connectivity through a recent MoU?
questions.explanation: India has been focusing on improving regional connectivity and cooperation with its neighbouring countries through strategic agreements. One such initiative involves collaboration in the postal and logistics sectors, aiming to modernise systems and improve service efficiency. The agreement includes areas like technology sharing, capacity building, digital remittance services, and institutional training. Bhutan is a key partner in this initiative, benefiting from India’s experience in digital infrastructure such as UPI and the Digital Address Code. This collaboration is expected to boost financial inclusion, strengthen bilateral ties, and enhance connectivity, especially in remote and underserved regions.

questions.question: How many academic institutions have been approved for quantum teaching facilities under the National Quantum Mission?
questions.explanation: 23 academic institutions have been approved under the National Quantum Mission to establish quantum teaching facilities and laboratories. This initiative aims to strengthen India’s capabilities in quantum science and technology by building a strong foundation in education and research. The approved institutions will focus on developing skilled manpower and advancing innovation in quantum computing, communication, and related fields. Additionally, more institutions are under review for future inclusion, reflecting the government’s commitment to expanding the quantum ecosystem and positioning India as a global leader in emerging technologies.

questions.question: In which state is the Metropolis project by Reliance MET City, recognised as India’s first LEED Platinum Pre-Certified project, located?
questions.explanation: Haryana is the state where the Metropolis project by Reliance MET City is located, marking a significant milestone in sustainable urban development. The project has achieved India’s first LEED Platinum Pre-Certification under the global LEED for Cities framework, reflecting high standards in energy efficiency, water management, and climate resilience. Located in the Jhajjar district near Delhi, the development benefits from strategic connectivity and infrastructure. It is part of a larger industrial and residential ecosystem, supporting economic growth while promoting environmentally responsible urban planning aligned with international sustainability benchmarks.

questions.question: Which company launched India’s first passive hybrid index fund combining equity and government securities?
questions.explanation: Edelweiss Asset Management is the entity that introduced India’s first passive hybrid index fund, marking an important innovation in the mutual fund industry. The fund combines equity exposure through the Nifty LargeMidcap250 Index with debt investment in government securities via the Nifty 8–13 year G-Sec Index. This structure allows investors to benefit from both market growth and relative stability. The initiative follows regulatory approvals for debt indices and aims to provide a diversified investment option that balances risk and returns, making it suitable for investors seeking long-term financial stability.

questions.question: On which date is the World Day for Glaciers observed globally?
questions.explanation: The World Day for Glaciers is observed annually on March 21 to highlight the critical importance of glaciers in maintaining ecological balance and supporting life on Earth. Glaciers store nearly 70% of the world’s freshwater, making them essential for water supply, agriculture, and ecosystems. They also act as key indicators of climate change, as their rapid melting signals rising global temperatures. The observance encourages global awareness and action to protect glaciers through sustainable practices, scientific research, and climate initiatives to ensure water security and environmental stability for future generations.

questions.question: Who has been appointed as the Brand Ambassador for the BHIM Payments App to promote trust and digital financial inclusion?
questions.explanation: MS Dhoni has been chosen as the Brand Ambassador for the BHIM Payments App, reflecting the platform’s emphasis on reliability and user trust. His reputation as a dependable and composed leader aligns well with the app’s identity as a secure digital payment solution. The association comes at a strategic time as BHIM approaches its tenth anniversary and aims to expand its reach across the country. By leveraging Dhoni’s popularity and credibility, the initiative seeks to encourage greater adoption of digital payments and enhance financial inclusion among diverse sections of society.

questions.question: Which Indian state successfully launched its first sounding rocket near Dholera in March 2026?
questions.explanation: Gujarat marked a significant milestone by successfully launching its first sounding rocket near Dholera on March 15, 2026. Developed by Ahmedabad-based Omspace Rocket and Exploration Pvt Ltd, the rocket reached an altitude of about 3 kilometers and carried a mini satellite payload for weather data collection. This achievement highlights the growing role of private startups in India’s space sector and reflects the state’s commitment to innovation through its Spacetech Policy 2025–2030. The mission also demonstrated advancements in propulsion, avionics, and lightweight composite materials, strengthening India’s self-reliance in aerospace technology.

questions.question: Which state government signed an MoU with the National Dairy Development Board in March 2026 to boost its dairy sector?
questions.explanation: The Himachal Pradesh government signed a Memorandum of Understanding with the National Dairy Development Board on March 16, 2026, to strengthen its dairy sector. The agreement focuses on enhancing milk processing capacity, improving infrastructure, and supporting farmers by providing better facilities. A key component of this initiative is the development of the Dagwar dairy project, which aims to become a major processing hub. Additionally, the promotion of dairy products under the ‘HIM’ brand is expected to boost the state’s market presence and generate employment opportunities in the dairy industry.

questions.question: In which country is NPCI International expanding UPI merchant acceptance to enhance cross-border payment experiences?
questions.explanation: Sri Lanka is the country where NPCI International Payments Limited is expanding UPI merchant acceptance to improve cross-border digital payments. This initiative enables Indian tourists to make seamless transactions using UPI through integration with LankaQR infrastructure. It reflects growing economic and technological cooperation between the two nations. The expansion also supports Sri Lanka’s digital economy by increasing the adoption of secure and efficient payment systems. With UPI handling billions of transactions monthly, this collaboration enhances financial connectivity and strengthens bilateral ties through modern digital infrastructure.

questions.question: On which date is World Water Day observed globally every year?
questions.explanation: World Water Day is observed annually on March 22 to emphasize the importance of freshwater and advocate for sustainable management of water resources. The day raises awareness about global water challenges such as scarcity, pollution, and unequal access to safe drinking water. In 2026, the theme “Water and Gender” highlights the link between water access and gender equality, focusing on the challenges faced by women and girls. It also encourages inclusive decision-making and promotes solutions that ensure equitable and sustainable water management for communities worldwide.

questions.question: In which city will the ‘Gau-Tech 2026’ exhibition be organised by the Maharashtra Goseva Commission?
questions.explanation: Pune is the city selected to host the ‘Gau-Tech 2026’ exhibition, organised by the Maharashtra Goseva Commission in collaboration with the Global Confederation of Cow-Based Industries. The event will take place at the Agriculture College and focuses on promoting cow-based agriculture and rural economic development. It aims to showcase innovative technologies, support sustainable farming practices, and create new business opportunities. The initiative also aligns with the broader national vision of strengthening village industries and contributing to long-term economic growth through rural empowerment.

questions.question: On which date is World Poetry Day celebrated globally?
questions.explanation: World Poetry Day is observed annually on March 21 across the globe. This date was officially designated by UNESCO in 1999 during its General Conference in Paris. The purpose of celebrating this day is to recognize poetry as a powerful form of cultural and artistic expression that connects people across different backgrounds and generations. It also promotes linguistic diversity, encourages the reading and writing of poetry, and helps preserve endangered languages. The observance brings together poets, writers, and artists worldwide through various events such as poetry readings, competitions, and cultural programs.

questions.question: When is the International Day of Forests observed each year globally?
questions.explanation: The International Day of Forests is observed every year on March 21 to highlight the vital role forests play in sustaining life on Earth. Established by the United Nations General Assembly in 2012, the day promotes awareness about forest conservation and sustainable use of forest resources. Forests contribute significantly to economies by providing employment, raw materials, and supporting livelihoods. They also help regulate the climate, maintain biodiversity, and protect water cycles. Various activities such as tree plantation drives, awareness campaigns, and educational programs are conducted worldwide to encourage people to protect and preserve forests.

questions.question: Which institution is developing flexible semiconductor sensors for early cancer detection and continuous health monitoring?
questions.explanation: IIT Jodhpur is the institution where researchers are working on advanced flexible semiconductor sensors designed for continuous health monitoring and early detection of diseases like cancer. The innovation involves soft, wearable electronics that can track vital parameters such as heart rate, temperature, and muscle activity. Using Organic Electrochemical Transistor (OECT) technology, these sensors can interact effectively with biological signals and fluids. The devices are made from biocompatible materials, ensuring comfort for long-term use, and have applications in healthcare, early diagnosis, and even monitoring physiological conditions in defence environments.

questions.question: Who has been appointed as the Director (Personnel) at NMDC in 2026?
questions.explanation: Krishna Kumar Thakur, a 1998 batch Indian Railway Personnel Service officer, has been appointed as the Director (Personnel) at NMDC Limited in 2026. With over two decades of experience in human resource management, he has served in various roles across Indian Railways and public sector enterprises. His expertise includes large-scale recruitment, workforce planning, and HR policy implementation. He has also held key positions in organisations like RITES Limited, Konkan Railway Corporation, and BHEL. His leadership is expected to strengthen employee engagement, productivity, and HR systems within NMDC.

questions.question: Who has been appointed as the brand ambassador for Uniqlo in India in 2026?
questions.explanation: Uniqlo, a global apparel brand, appointed Indian cricketer Jasprit Bumrah as its brand ambassador for India in 2026. This collaboration marks a significant step in the company’s expansion strategy in the Indian market. Jasprit Bumrah, known for his exceptional fast bowling skills, brings strong recognition and influence among fans. The partnership was launched with a campaign centred on Uniqlo’s LifeWear philosophy, which emphasises comfort, simplicity, and functionality in everyday clothing. The campaign is promoted across digital platforms, social media, and retail outlets to engage a wide audience, especially the younger generation.

questions.question: On which date is World Puppetry Day celebrated globally every year?
questions.explanation: World Puppetry Day is celebrated every year on March 21 to promote and preserve the traditional art of puppetry across the world. Initiated in 2003 by UNIMA (Union Internationale de la Marionnette), the day highlights puppetry as an important cultural and educational tool. It encourages artists and communities to engage in performances, workshops, and exhibitions that showcase diverse puppetry styles. The celebration also emphasizes the role of puppetry in storytelling, spreading social awareness, and educating audiences, especially children, by simplifying complex ideas through creative expression and performance arts.

questions.question: Which company has launched India’s first 24x7 LPG ATM in Gurugram?
questions.explanation: Bharat Petroleum Corporation Limited has launched India’s first 24x7 LPG ATM in Gurugram as a pilot initiative to modernise LPG distribution. The automated kiosk allows consumers to quickly exchange empty cylinders for filled ones within a few minutes, eliminating dependency on delivery schedules. It uses lightweight, transparent composite cylinders that enable users to monitor gas levels easily. The system operates digitally, requiring OTP-based verification and supporting payments via UPI or cards. This innovation enhances convenience, ensures round-the-clock accessibility, and represents a significant step towards digitisation and efficiency in the energy distribution sector.

questions.question: Where will the Indian Navy commission its latest indigenous stealth frigate, ‘Taragiri’, on 03 April 2026?
questions.explanation: Visakhapatnam has been chosen as the venue for the commissioning of the Indian Navy’s latest indigenous stealth frigate ‘Taragiri’ on 03 April 2026. The event marks a major milestone in India’s push for naval self-reliance and indigenous defence manufacturing. Built under Project 17A by Mazagon Dock Shipbuilders Limited, the vessel incorporates advanced stealth features, modern weapon systems, and over 75% indigenous content. The commissioning ceremony, presided over by Defence Minister Rajnath Singh, highlights the strategic importance of strengthening India’s maritime capabilities and ensuring robust security across its naval frontiers.

questions.question: Who has been conferred with the honorary Knight Commander of the Order of the British Empire (KBE) for strengthening UK-India business ties?
questions.explanation: N. Chandrasekaran, Chairman of Tata Sons, has been awarded the honorary Knight Commander of the Order of the British Empire (KBE) by the British Sovereign. This recognition highlights his significant role in enhancing business, trade, and economic relations between India and the United Kingdom. Under his leadership, the Tata Group has made substantial investments in sectors like green steel, battery technology, and automobiles, particularly through Jaguar Land Rover. The honour reflects his contribution to strengthening bilateral ties and fostering economic collaboration between the two nations.

questions.question: In which city was the India-Africa Strategic Partnership Meet held during the Bharat Electricity Summit 2026?
questions.explanation: The India-Africa Strategic Partnership Meet took place on 21 March 2026 as part of the Bharat Electricity Summit 2026. The event was organized in New Delhi, which served as the venue for high-level discussions between Indian and African representatives. The meeting focused on strengthening cooperation in energy, infrastructure, and sustainable development. Key participants included ministers, international leaders, and officials from organisations like the African Union and Africa50. Hosting the event in the national capital underscores its importance in shaping policy dialogue, fostering international collaboration, and promoting India’s leadership in renewable energy and capacity-building initiatives.

questions.question: Where was the 27th Annual General Meeting of the Wildlife Institute of India Society, chaired by the Union Environment Minister, held?
questions.explanation: Dehradun served as the venue for the 27th Annual General Meeting of the Wildlife Institute of India (WII) Society, chaired by Union Environment Minister Bhupender Yadav. The meeting reviewed significant achievements in wildlife conservation, including progress in the cheetah reintroduction program and breeding efforts for the Great Indian Bustard. It also discussed infrastructure mitigation measures such as wildlife crossings on highways, and highlighted new research initiatives like the National River Research Centre. The AGM emphasised future planning and collaboration to strengthen conservation strategies and research capabilities in India.

questions.question: Which country does Fanny Utagushimaninde, the youngest Women’s T20I centurion, represent?
questions.explanation: Fanny Utagushimaninde is a young cricketer from Rwanda who achieved a remarkable milestone by becoming the youngest player to score a century in Women’s T20 International cricket. She scored an unbeaten 111 runs off 65 balls against Ghana during the Nigeria Invitational Women’s T20I Tournament. At just 15 years and 223 days old, she broke the previous record held by Uganda’s Prosscovia Alako. Her outstanding performance not only set a new age record but also marked the highest score on a T20I debut, highlighting Rwanda’s growing presence in international women’s cricket.

questions.question: Which company has launched an affordable Semaglutide injection in India using an innovative multi-dose pen?
questions.explanation: Zydus has introduced an affordable Semaglutide injection in India, targeting the treatment of Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus and obesity. The innovation includes a reusable multi-dose pen, allowing patients to adjust dosages conveniently from a single device, unlike traditional single-use pens. This significantly improves ease of use and reduces treatment costs, with an average monthly expense of around ₹2,200. Manufactured at the Zydus Biotech Park in Ahmedabad, the product aims to make GLP-1 therapies more accessible, especially in a country facing a growing burden of diabetes and rising obesity rates.

questions.question: Which state has been selected to host the 49th Yonex Sunrise Junior National Badminton Championship (U-19) in 2026?
questions.explanation: Sikkim has been officially chosen as the host for the 49th Yonex Sunrise Junior National Badminton Championship (U-19) in 2026. This is a significant milestone as it marks the first time the state will host a national-level badminton tournament of this scale. The event is scheduled from 14 November to 21 November 2026 and will include both individual and team competitions. Organised under the Badminton Association of India, the championship will bring together top junior players from across the country, offering valuable exposure and boosting the sporting ecosystem in Sikkim.

questions.question: Which Indian state is launching ‘Nivesh Mitra 3.0’ to boost ease of doing business and industrial growth?
questions.explanation: Uttar Pradesh is introducing ‘Nivesh Mitra 3.0’ as an upgraded single-window clearance portal to enhance the ease of doing business and accelerate industrial development. The platform includes advanced features such as AI-powered chatbots, real-time SMS alerts, and data-driven approval systems to simplify regulatory procedures. It also offers a Combined Application Form, enabling investors to interact with multiple departments through a unified interface. Additionally, new industrial schemes and investor support measures like land allotment and subsidies are being implemented to promote faster project execution and attract significant investments into the state.

questions.question: Which company has secured a BBB- (Investment Grade) credit rating with a stable outlook from Acuite Ratings & Research Limited?
questions.explanation: IBL Finance Ltd has been awarded a BBB- (Investment Grade) rating with a stable outlook by Acuite Ratings & Research Limited. This rating highlights the company’s strong financial discipline, effective governance practices, and robust compliance framework. Achieving investment-grade status enhances the company’s credibility and enables it to access capital markets at more favourable interest rates. It also reflects sound risk management within its fintech-driven lending operations. As a technology-focused NBFC listed on the NSE, this milestone is expected to support IBL Finance Ltd’s future growth and strengthen its position in the digital lending ecosystem.

questions.question: Which country collaborated with India in conducting the tri-services Exercise Lamitiye 2026?
questions.explanation: Exercise Lamitiye 2026 marked a significant milestone as it was the first tri-services exercise involving the Indian Army, Navy, and Air Force, along with the Seychelles Defence Forces. Conducted in Seychelles, the exercise enhanced military interoperability through activities such as VBSS operations, joint boarding drills, and coordinated troop landings. It also reflected India’s broader strategic vision under the MAHASAGAR initiative, aiming to strengthen regional security and cooperation. The name “Lamitiye,” meaning friendship in Creole, symbolizes the longstanding diplomatic and defence ties between the two nations.

questions.question: When is World Tuberculosis (TB) Day observed annually?
questions.explanation: World Tuberculosis (TB) Day is observed every year on March 24 to commemorate the discovery of the TB-causing bacterium by Dr. Robert Koch in 1882. The day serves as a global platform to raise awareness about tuberculosis, which remains one of the deadliest infectious diseases worldwide. It also highlights efforts to eliminate TB through coordinated global action. In 2026, the theme ‘Yes! We can end TB!’ reinforces optimism and collective responsibility. Countries like India are actively working towards ambitious targets, aiming to eliminate TB ahead of global deadlines through national health programs.

questions.question: Who set the Guinness World Record for the fastest ascent of the seven volcanic summits?
questions.explanation: Bhupathiraju Anmish Varma, a mountaineer from Visakhapatnam, achieved a remarkable feat by setting a Guinness World Record for the fastest ascent of the seven volcanic summits. He completed this challenging expedition in just 92 days, 4 hours, and 45 minutes. His journey began with Mount Elbrus in Russia and ended with Mount Sidley in Antarctica. The expedition required immense physical endurance and mental strength, as he faced extreme weather conditions, logistical challenges, and difficult terrains, especially in Antarctica, making his accomplishment truly exceptional.

questions.question: Who won the gold medal in shot put at the National Para-Athletics Championship held in Bhubaneswar?
questions.explanation: Ria Solanki, a 19-year-old para-athlete from Meerut, Uttar Pradesh, achieved a remarkable milestone by winning the gold medal in the shot put event at the National Para-Athletics Championship in Bhubaneswar, Odisha. Born without her left hand below the elbow, she began formal training in 2018 and faced numerous physical and financial challenges along the way. Her family made significant sacrifices to support her athletic journey, including working extra jobs and compromising their own needs. Her victory not only brought her national recognition but also highlighted her determination, resilience, and potential to represent India at international para-sports competitions.

questions.question: Which state launched the ‘Ningol Van Initiative’ on the occasion of the International Day of Forests in 2026?
questions.explanation: Manipur launched the ‘Ningol Van Initiative’ on March 21, 2026, aligning with the International Day of Forests. The initiative focuses on enhancing community participation in forest conservation, with special emphasis on the role of women in protecting biodiversity and promoting sustainable practices. It aims to expand across all 16 districts of the state and supports livelihoods through micro food-processing units under Van Dhan Vikas Kendras, most of which are operated by women. The program also complements efforts to tackle illegal activities like poppy cultivation and promotes reforestation through bamboo and essential oil crops.

questions.question: Who was appointed as the Non-Executive Part-Time Chairman of South Indian Bank in 2026?
questions.explanation: Jose Joseph Kattoor was appointed as the Non-Executive Part-Time Chairman of South Indian Bank, a prominent private sector lender based in Kerala. His appointment was approved by the Reserve Bank of India for a tenure of three years, starting from March 23, 2026. He succeeded V.J. Kurian, who retired after completing his term. Kattoor had already been serving as an Independent Director on the bank’s board since July 2024, making his elevation a natural progression in leadership. His appointment reflects continuity and stability in the bank’s governance structure.

questions.question: Which state government announced the phased rollout of an Artificial Intelligence (AI) Mission to improve governance?
questions.explanation: Madhya Pradesh has announced a phased implementation of an Artificial Intelligence (AI) Mission aimed at enhancing governance and public service delivery. The initiative will be executed in three phases, starting with building infrastructure, followed by scaling successful AI applications, and finally establishing AI as a permanent capability in governance. The mission focuses on improving citizen services, especially for farmers and marginalized groups, and enhancing administrative efficiency through data-driven decision-making. It also aims to identify risks in sectors like agriculture and health while promoting collaboration with startups and educational institutions for AI skill development.

questions.question: Which bank was penalised by the RBI for non-compliance with deposit norms?
questions.explanation: HSBC faced a monetary penalty of ₹31.80 lakh imposed by the Reserve Bank of India due to deficiencies in regulatory compliance. The bank failed to maintain a searchable database of unclaimed deposits on its official website and did not generate or assign the Unclaimed Deposits Reference Number (UDRN) for certain deposits transferred to the Depositor Education and Awareness Fund. These lapses were identified during a statutory inspection of its financial position as of March 31, 2025. The penalty highlights the importance of adhering to RBI guidelines and maintaining transparency in banking operations.

questions.question: Which bank launched India's first UPI-linked overdraft facility for Women Self-Help Group members?
questions.explanation: Bank of Baroda introduced India’s first UPI-linked overdraft facility specifically designed for Women Self-Help Group members, marking a major step in financial inclusion. The initiative allows eligible users to access instant credit of up to ₹5,000 digitally without visiting a bank branch. Integrated with Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana accounts, the facility enables seamless transactions through UPI apps. Developed in collaboration with NPCI, IBA, and DAY-NRLM, it promotes digital payments, enhances financial accessibility for rural women, and helps them build a formal credit history for future financial opportunities.

questions.question: Which state government announced the Indiramma Family Life Insurance Scheme in the Financial Year 2026–27 Budget?
questions.explanation: The Indiramma Family Life Insurance Scheme was announced as part of the Financial Year 2026–27 Budget by the Telangana government. The scheme aims to provide financial security to families by offering a life insurance cover of ₹5 lakh to each eligible household. It is designed to benefit around 1.15 crore families across the state, regardless of their socio-economic background. The initiative seeks to prevent financial distress among families in the event of the death of an earning member, ensuring a universal safety net for citizens.

questions.question: Who received the Women Empowerment Award for Art and Culture at the UK House of Commons?
questions.explanation: Rituparna Sengupta, a renowned actress, was honoured with the Women Empowerment Award for Art and Culture at the House of Commons in the United Kingdom. The award ceremony was organised by GloWomen CiC to celebrate International Women's Day, recognizing individuals who have made notable contributions to society. The award was presented by distinguished personalities Seema Malhotra and Virendra Sharma. Her recognition highlights her impactful and sustained contributions to the field of art and culture, as well as her role in promoting women’s empowerment through her work.

questions.question: Which disease is the focus of the collaborative clinical study announced by the Ministry of Ayush and DBT using Ayurveda as an adjunct therapy?
questions.explanation: The collaborative clinical study launched by the Ministry of Ayush and the Department of Biotechnology focuses on Tuberculosis, aiming to integrate Ayurveda with standard Anti-Tuberculosis Treatment. This approach seeks to enhance recovery outcomes, improve nutrition, and elevate the quality of life for patients. A major focus is on managing TB-related cachexia, a condition involving severe weight and muscle loss. Conducted over a 24-month period across leading medical institutions such as AIIMS and JIPMER, the study reflects a scientific effort to validate traditional medicine through evidence-based research and promote holistic healthcare solutions.

questions.question: Which Indian state will host the Khelo India Tribal Games (KITG) 2026, marking the first national event exclusively for tribal athletes?
questions.explanation: The Khelo India Tribal Games (KITG) 2026 will be hosted by Chhattisgarh from 25 March to 03 April 2026. This event is a landmark initiative as it is the first national-level competition dedicated entirely to tribal athletes, promoting grassroots participation and inclusion. The games will be organised across Raipur, Jagdalpur, and Surguja, with over 6,000 participants, including 2,300 athletes. It is jointly managed by key sports bodies like the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports and the Sports Authority of India, highlighting its national importance.

questions.question: Which country surpassed the Netherlands to become India’s third-largest export destination in February 2026?
questions.explanation: In February 2026, China became India’s third-largest export destination, overtaking the Netherlands due to a strong increase in trade volumes. Exports to China surged by 32.4% year-on-year, reaching $1.67 billion, largely driven by demand for electronics and marine products. Despite this growth, imports from China also rose significantly, contributing to a widening trade deficit exceeding $100 billion during the April–February period. Meanwhile, exports to the United States declined due to tariff pressures, further influencing China’s rise in ranking among India’s export markets.

questions.question: Which company partnered with Sarvam AI to introduce voice-based conversational commerce and payments in India?
questions.explanation: Razorpay has collaborated with Sarvam AI to launch innovative voice-first conversational commerce solutions in India. This initiative enables users to search for products, place orders, and complete payments using natural voice interactions in multiple Indian languages, improving accessibility and user experience. The system leverages Sarvam AI’s advanced “agentic stack” to interpret user intent and execute transactions seamlessly without traditional navigation. Early adopters such as Swiggy and The Derma Co have begun integrating this technology, highlighting its scalability and potential to transform digital commerce across diverse linguistic demographics in India.

questions.question: Which bank received the ‘National Award for Outstanding Performance in SHG Bank Linkage 2024-25’ for its contribution to rural empowerment?
questions.explanation: Karnataka Grameena Bank was honoured with the ‘National Award for Outstanding Performance in SHG Bank Linkage 2024-25’ by the Union Ministry of Rural Development for its exceptional contribution to rural empowerment and financial inclusion. The bank has played a crucial role in supporting Self-Help Groups (SHGs) by extending ₹2,835 crore in credit to over 80,000 groups, primarily benefiting rural women. Its efforts are aligned with the Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana - National Rural Livelihoods Mission, and its strengthened institutional structure has further enhanced its outreach and effectiveness.

questions.question: Which company became a signatory to the United Nations Global Compact, committing to integrate ESG principles into its operations?
questions.explanation: L&T Finance Ltd became a signatory to the United Nations Global Compact (UNGC), marking a significant step toward embedding Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) principles into its business strategy. By joining this global initiative, the company aligns itself with internationally recognized standards focused on human rights, labour practices, environmental protection, and anti-corruption. It also commits to supporting the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs). As part of this engagement, the company must submit an annual Communication on Progress report, ensuring transparency, accountability, and continuous improvement in its sustainability efforts.

questions.question: In which city was the “Capabilities Discovery Session” hosted by CSIR and the Ministry of External Affairs for Global South ambassadors?
questions.explanation: The “Capabilities Discovery Session” organised by the Council of Scientific and Industrial Research (CSIR) and the Ministry of External Affairs (MEA) was held in New Delhi. The event aimed to strengthen South–South Cooperation by showcasing India’s advancements in Science, Technology, and Innovation to diplomats from various regions, including Oceania, West Asia, and the Caribbean. It highlighted India’s scientific capabilities through multiple thematic sectors such as healthcare, agriculture, and environmental sustainability, emphasizing collaborative research, technology transfer, and solutions to global challenges like climate change and food security.

questions.question: What is India’s current indigenous urea production capacity achieved under the Atmanirbhar Bharat initiatives?
questions.explanation: India has significantly enhanced its indigenous urea production capacity to 283.74 Lakh Metric Tonnes per annum under the Atmanirbhar Bharat initiatives. This growth is driven by policy measures such as the New Investment Policy (NIP)–2012, which led to the establishment of six new urea units, adding substantial capacity. The increase reflects the government’s focus on reducing dependency on imports and strengthening domestic fertiliser production. Additionally, reforms like the New Urea Policy (2015) and expansion of raw material supply agreements have further contributed to ensuring long-term sustainability and self-reliance in fertiliser production.

questions.question: Who has been appointed as a Co-opted Member of the Sustainability Reporting Standards Board (SRSB) of the ICAI for the 2026–27 term?
questions.explanation: P.V. Narayana Rao, a highly experienced Chartered Accountant, has been appointed as a Co-opted Member of the Sustainability Reporting Standards Board (SRSB) of the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India for the 2026–27 term. With a professional career spanning over 37 years, he has contributed significantly to advancing corporate governance and sustainability practices. The SRSB plays a key role in aligning Indian corporate reporting with global standards, particularly the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) 2030, and works closely with regulatory bodies like SEBI and the Ministry of Corporate Affairs.

questions.question: Which company signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with DPIIT to support startups in the manufacturing and HVAC sectors?
questions.explanation: Blue Star Limited entered into a strategic partnership with the Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT) to strengthen the manufacturing startup ecosystem, particularly in the HVAC sector. This collaboration focuses on promoting innovation in areas such as advanced manufacturing, digital solutions, and supply chain improvements. Startups will benefit from access to R&D facilities, expert mentorship, and opportunities for product testing and validation. The initiative also includes organising innovation challenges and hackathons, enabling startups to develop scalable solutions and integrate into global value chains, thereby boosting India’s industrial growth.

questions.question: In which country is the 14th Ministerial Conference (MC14) of the World Trade Organisation being held in 2026?
questions.explanation: The 14th Ministerial Conference (MC14) of the World Trade Organization is being held in Yaounde, the capital city of Cameroon, from March 26 to 29, 2026. This significant global event brings together trade ministers from WTO member nations to discuss key issues such as WTO reforms, agriculture and food security, fisheries subsidies, and digital trade policies. The conference is chaired by Cameroon’s Minister of Trade, Luc Magloire Mbarga Atangana. Hosting such a major international event highlights Cameroon’s role in global trade discussions and provides a platform for addressing the concerns of developing and least developed countries.

questions.question: Which state emerged as the overall champion at the 24th National Para Athletics Championships by topping the medals tally?
questions.explanation: Haryana secured the top position at the 24th National Para Athletics Championships by delivering an outstanding performance across multiple events. The state won a total of 95 medals, including 39 gold, 31 silver, and 25 bronze, showcasing dominance in both track and field competitions. Tamil Nadu followed as the runner-up, while Gujarat secured third place. Haryana’s success was also highlighted by individual achievements, such as Ankur Dhama winning gold in the men’s 5000m T11 event. The large-scale competition featured over 1,400 para-athletes from across India, emphasising inclusivity and sporting excellence.

questions.question: Which company launched the NxtOption platform to simplify advanced options trading for retail investors?
questions.explanation: HDFC Securities introduced the NxtOption platform to provide retail investors with a comprehensive and advanced trading solution for Futures and Options (F&O). The platform integrates multiple functionalities such as strategy building, analytics, and execution into a single interface, eliminating the need for third-party tools. It enables users to create complex trading strategies, assess risk and payoff scenarios, and monitor performance in real time. With features like Strategy Builder, Strategy Watch, and Easy Options, it aims to make derivatives trading more accessible while promoting informed decision-making among investors in India’s capital markets.

questions.question: Where will the 9th PharmaMed 2026 conference be hosted?
questions.explanation: The 9th PharmaMed 2026 conference is scheduled to take place in New Delhi on March 27, 2026. Organised by the Department of Pharmaceuticals in collaboration with the PHD Chamber of Commerce and Industry, the event aims to bring together policymakers, regulators, and industry leaders. It focuses on advancing India’s pharmaceutical sector by promoting innovation, improving regulatory standards, and strengthening supply chains. The conference also emphasises healthcare equity, ensuring access to affordable and quality healthcare for all citizens, aligning with the vision of building a developed and inclusive India.

questions.question: What GDP growth rate has S&P Global Ratings projected for India for FY27?
questions.explanation: S&P Global Ratings has projected India’s GDP growth rate at 7.1% for the fiscal year 2026–27, reflecting a positive outlook on the country’s economic performance. This upward revision is driven by strong domestic demand, particularly robust private consumption and increased investment across sectors. The agency also highlighted stable export performance as a contributing factor. Additionally, inflation is expected to normalise at around 4.3%, while the Reserve Bank of India is likely to maintain a neutral monetary policy stance. Overall, the projection underscores confidence in India’s economic resilience and sustained growth momentum.

questions.question: Who was honoured with the ‘Women Empowerment Trailblazers Award’ at the BRICS Chamber of Commerce and Industry Women Empowerment Annual Summit 2026?
questions.explanation: Kalpana Soren, a Member of Legislative Assembly from Jharkhand, received the ‘Women Empowerment Trailblazers Award’ at the BRICS Chamber of Commerce and Industry Women Empowerment Annual Summit and Felicitation 2026 held in New Delhi. The award recognised her impactful work in promoting women-led development and grassroots empowerment initiatives in Jharkhand. She dedicated the honour to the women of her state, emphasising their courage and role in shaping society. She also highlighted the importance of uplifting marginalized women and encouraging entrepreneurship among women as key drivers of social and economic change.

questions.question: Who has been appointed as the Managing Director for Asia-Pacific by OpenAI?
questions.explanation: Kiran Mani has been appointed as the Managing Director for Asia-Pacific by OpenAI, marking a significant step in the company’s expansion strategy in high-growth markets. He is set to take on this role in June 2026 and will be based in Singapore, reporting to the Chief Strategy Officer. Mani brings extensive experience from his leadership roles, including serving as CEO of JioStar and holding key positions at global companies like Google, Microsoft, and IBM. His appointment highlights OpenAI’s focus on strengthening its presence in the Asia-Pacific region, especially in countries like India with rapidly growing user bases.

questions.question: What is the name of the portal launched to digitise and accelerate infrastructure approvals for projects like Road Over Bridges?
questions.explanation: PRISM-SG, which stands for Portal for Rail-Road Inspection & Stages Management – Steel Girders, was launched to streamline and digitise infrastructure approval processes in India. It focuses on improving efficiency and transparency in the construction of Road Over Bridges by replacing manual systems with an integrated digital platform. The portal enables online submission, inspection scheduling, real-time monitoring, and complete audit trails. By connecting multiple stakeholders such as Indian Railways, contractors, and inspection agencies, it significantly reduces approval timelines from nearly a year to just a few months, thereby accelerating infrastructure development and improving coordination.

questions.question: Which organisation partnered with TRIFED to enhance tribal e-commerce by providing logistics support?
questions.explanation: The Department of Posts, operating under the Ministry of Communications, entered into a strategic partnership with TRIFED to strengthen tribal e-commerce in India. This collaboration focuses on integrating tribal products into the digital economy by offering a comprehensive logistics framework. It includes end-to-end solutions such as order pickup, transmission, and delivery across even the most remote areas, leveraging its vast postal network. The initiative also incorporates technical integration for real-time tracking and efficient payment systems. This effort significantly boosts market access, helping tribal artisans and entrepreneurs increase their income and visibility nationwide.

questions.question: Which company successfully test-fired the world’s first fully 3D-printed booster engine, ‘Agnite’?
questions.explanation: Agnikul Cosmos, a Chennai-based space-tech startup, achieved a major milestone by successfully test-firing ‘Agnite’, the world’s first fully 3D-printed booster-stage engine. The engine stands out due to its single-piece construction using advanced 3D printing technology, reducing production time and enhancing reliability. It is also notable for being tested with electric motor-driven pumps, marking innovation in propulsion systems. This development strengthens India’s private space sector capabilities and offers greater flexibility in satellite launches, including customizable payload options and quicker turnaround times for missions across defence, disaster response, and commercial applications.

questions.question: Who has been appointed as India’s next High Commissioner to the United Kingdom?
questions.explanation: Periasamy Kumaran has been appointed as India’s next High Commissioner to the United Kingdom by the Ministry of External Affairs. He is a senior diplomat with extensive international experience and is currently serving as Secretary (East) in the MEA. Over his distinguished career, he has held key diplomatic positions in Cairo, Tripoli, Brussels, Islamabad, Washington D.C., and Colombo. He has also served as Ambassador to Qatar and High Commissioner to Singapore. His appointment reflects his vast expertise in international relations and diplomacy, making him well-suited for this important role in strengthening India-UK ties.

questions.question: What was India’s rank in the 2025 World Air Quality Report published by IQAir?
questions.explanation: In the 2025 World Air Quality Report released by IQAir, India was ranked as the 6th most polluted country globally. The rankings were determined based on PM2.5 data collected from thousands of monitoring stations across numerous countries. Countries like Pakistan, Bangladesh, and Tajikistan ranked higher in pollution levels. The report also highlighted that only a small percentage of countries met the World Health Organisation’s recommended air quality standards. India’s position reflects ongoing environmental challenges, particularly in urban areas, where pollution continues to impact public health and quality of life significantly.

questions.question: Which organisation partnered with the National Commission for Women to launch the Women’s Digital Safety Awareness Initiative?
questions.explanation: The National Commission for Women collaborated with Truecaller to launch the Women’s Digital Safety Awareness Initiative in March 2026. This partnership focuses on enhancing digital safety for women by addressing online risks such as phishing, impersonation, harassment, and financial fraud. A key component of the initiative is the “TrueCyberSakhi: A Digital Safety Toolkit,” which provides interactive learning modules, self-assessment tools, and practical safety guidelines. Additionally, Truecaller verified the NCW’s 24x7 helpline on its platform, helping users identify authentic communication channels and reducing the risk of fraud or impersonation.

questions.question: From which Olympic Games year will the IOC ban transgender women and DSD athletes from competing in the female category?
questions.explanation: The International Olympic Committee has decided to implement a ban on transgender women and athletes with Differences in Sex Development (DSD) from competing in the female category starting with the 2028 Los Angeles Olympics. This decision is based on scientific findings indicating performance advantages linked to male puberty. The policy introduces mandatory biological verification through SRY gene screening to ensure fairness in women’s sports. It will apply to all future Olympic Games and aims to maintain competitive balance while ensuring that athletes are treated with dignity and respect throughout the eligibility process.

questions.question: What is the name of the operation launched by the Indian Navy to secure energy vessels in the Strait of Hormuz?
questions.explanation: The Indian Navy launched Operation Urja Suraksha to protect India’s energy supply routes in the strategically important Strait of Hormuz amid rising geopolitical tensions in West Asia. The operation involves deploying multiple frontline warships to escort Indian-flagged vessels carrying crucial resources such as LNG, LPG, and crude oil. It ensures safe passage for these ships and helps maintain uninterrupted energy supplies to India. The mission also includes coordination with various government agencies and focuses on safeguarding maritime trade routes, thereby strengthening national energy security and resilience against potential disruptions.

questions.question: In which city was China Mobile’s Global Intelligence Centre (GIC) officially launched?
questions.explanation: China Mobile inaugurated its Global Intelligence Centre (GIC) in Hong Kong, marking a significant advancement in the region’s digital and technological infrastructure. The facility is designed to support large-scale artificial intelligence operations, including training complex AI models and managing high-performance computing tasks. Equipped with advanced technologies like digital twins, AI-driven scheduling, and autonomous inspections, the center enhances operational efficiency and connectivity. It also plays a strategic role in linking global data networks and strengthening Hong Kong’s position as a key hub in China’s Digital China initiative and the broader Asia-Pacific technology ecosystem.

questions.question: Which state’s Chief Minister flagged off the Dehradun–Pithoragarh flight service?
questions.explanation: The Dehradun–Pithoragarh flight service was inaugurated by the Chief Minister of Uttarakhand, Pushkar Singh Dhami, to improve regional connectivity within the state. This initiative significantly reduces travel time between Dehradun and the remote border district of Pithoragarh to about one hour. The service is particularly important for a mountainous state where air connectivity acts as a lifeline for transportation, emergency services, and supply delivery. The development is part of broader efforts under schemes like UDAN and the state’s own air connectivity program to strengthen infrastructure, promote tourism, and enhance accessibility in hilly and border regions.

questions.question: What is the name of the portal launched by the National Housing Bank to facilitate home loans for government and defence personnel?
questions.explanation: The National Housing Bank introduced the Gruh Sugam Portal to simplify access to housing finance for Defence, Paramilitary, and Government personnel. This digital platform enables users to apply for home loans online through their administrative units, eliminating the need for physical visits to banks. It acts as a unified marketplace where applicants can compare loan offers from multiple lenders and choose the most suitable option. The portal also includes features such as online chat support and grievance redressal mechanisms, enhancing user experience. Overall, it promotes financial inclusion and supports affordable housing, especially for personnel posted in remote areas.

questions.question: Who was sworn in as Nepal’s youngest Prime Minister in March 2026?
questions.explanation: Balendra Shah, also known as Balen, became Nepal’s youngest Prime Minister at the age of 35 after being sworn in on March 27, 2026. Representing the Rastriya Swatantra Party (RSP), he led his party to a historic victory by securing a majority in the House of Representatives. His rise marks a significant political shift in Nepal, as he defeated established leaders and traditional parties. Additionally, he is the first Prime Minister from the Madhes region, highlighting increased regional representation. His leadership symbolises a move toward youth-driven, reform-oriented governance in Nepal.

questions.question: Which state became the second in India to adopt a Uniform Civil Code (UCC) after Uttarakhand in 2024?
questions.explanation: Gujarat became the second state in India to adopt a Uniform Civil Code (UCC) after Uttarakhand. The Gujarat Legislative Assembly passed the UCC Bill, 2026, on March 24, 2026, through a majority voice vote. The law aims to establish a common legal framework for all citizens regardless of religion, covering areas such as marriage, divorce, succession, and live-in relationships. It also includes provisions like the prohibition of bigamy and mandatory registration of live-in relationships. However, Scheduled Tribes and certain constitutionally protected groups are exempted, ensuring protection of customary rights while promoting legal uniformity and gender equality.

questions.question: Which company partnered with Google Cloud to expand collaboration for application modernisation and cloud migration?
questions.explanation: Red Hat partnered with Google Cloud to enhance collaboration aimed at accelerating application modernization and cloud migration. This partnership integrates Red Hat OpenShift directly into the Google Cloud console, enabling a unified platform for managing containers and virtual machines. It also marks the general availability of OpenShift Virtualization on Google Cloud, allowing businesses to run traditional and modern workloads together. The collaboration supports AI applications, Kubernetes-based deployments, and hybrid cloud environments. With features like unified billing, native service integrations, and simplified migration tools, organizations can efficiently modernize infrastructure and streamline operations.

questions.question: Who has been selected to represent India at the World Youth Parliament 2026 from Sikkim?
questions.explanation: Stuti Pradhan, a young leader from Sikkim, has been chosen to represent India at the World Youth Parliament 2026, a global platform for youth engagement in policy discussions. Her selection came after her success as the state-level winner of the Viksit Bharat Youth Parliament 2025, highlighting her leadership and policy insight. She will participate alongside representatives from several countries, contributing to discussions on international issues and governance. Her participation reflects India’s emphasis on youth involvement in shaping future policies and promoting global collaboration among emerging leaders.

questions.question: Who has assumed charge as the Chairperson of the National Commission for Backward Classes (NCBC) in March 2026?
questions.explanation: Sadhvi Niranjan Jyoti assumed charge as the Chairperson of the National Commission for Backward Classes (NCBC) on March 18, 2026. She brings significant experience as a former Member of Parliament and Union Minister of State, having handled portfolios such as Rural Development and Consumer Affairs. Known for her work in uplifting marginalised communities, her leadership is expected to strengthen the protection and socio-economic development of the backward classes. Alongside her, Kiran Umesh Mahalle also joined as a Member, contributing her experience in grassroots governance and social welfare initiatives.

questions.question: Which organisation collaborated with the Indian Army’s Corps of Electronics and Mechanical Engineers to accelerate defence indigenisation?
questions.explanation: IITM Pravartak Technologies Foundation partnered with the Indian Army’s Corps of Electronics and Mechanical Engineers to boost defence indigenisation efforts. The collaboration focuses on developing indigenous engineering solutions to reduce reliance on foreign technologies. A Nodal Indigenisation Centre has been set up in Avadi, Chennai, to support this initiative. The partnership emphasises bridging the gap between field requirements and academic research, fostering innovation in areas such as sensing systems, cyber-physical systems, autonomous technologies, and upgrading legacy military equipment, ultimately enhancing India’s self-reliance in defence production.

questions.question: Which company signed an MoU with the National Council for Cement and Building Materials (NCB) to strengthen construction skills?
questions.explanation: The National Council for Cement and Building Materials entered into a Memorandum of Understanding with UltraTech Cement Limited to enhance construction-related skills across the sector. The collaboration focuses on training civil engineers, contractors, RMC professionals, and masons over a period of three to five years. Key areas of training include technical aspects such as material testing and concrete mix design, as well as sustainable construction practices aligned with environmental goals. The initiative also emphasizes practical learning through workshops, site demonstrations, and exposure visits to cement plants and ready-mix concrete facilities, thereby improving industry standards and workforce capability.

questions.question: Which country introduced strict screen-time guidelines for children under 5 to protect their mental health and development?
questions.explanation: The United Kingdom introduced strict screen-time guidelines for young children to address concerns about excessive digital exposure. The advisory recommends no screen use for children under two years and limits screen time to one hour per day for children aged two to five. It also suggests avoiding screens during meals and before bedtime to ensure better sleep and development. This move is part of a broader global trend where governments are taking steps to safeguard children’s well-being, as excessive screen time has been linked to sleep disruption, reduced physical activity, and challenges in social and cognitive development.

questions.question: Which country conducted the first BRICS Youth Coordination Meeting in 2026?
questions.explanation: India conducted the first BRICS Youth Coordination Meeting on March 25, 2026, in a virtual format as part of its BRICS Chairship for the year. The meeting marked the beginning of youth-related engagements under the theme of resilience, innovation, cooperation, and sustainability. Representatives from all BRICS nations participated to align on future initiatives. India also outlined key platforms such as youth summits, ministerial meetings, and volunteering activities. The initiative emphasizes collaboration in areas like education, entrepreneurship, innovation, sustainability, and social inclusion, strengthening youth cooperation among BRICS countries.

questions.question: Which company achieved the highest-ever daily oil and gas production on March 26, 2026?
questions.explanation: Oil India Limited achieved a record-breaking milestone on March 26, 2026, by registering its highest-ever daily oil and gas production. The total output reached 1,47,159 Barrels of Oil Equivalent per day, while crude oil production alone stood at 80,060 barrels, marking the highest level in the past decade. This success was driven by the company’s Mission 4+ strategy, extensive drilling of wells and workovers, adoption of advanced technologies like Cyclic Steam Simulation, and new discoveries in the Assam Shelf Basin, reflecting strong growth and efficiency in the energy sector.

questions.question: What is the name of India’s first helicopter-launched unmanned aerial system project initiated by the Indian Air Force?
questions.explanation: Vayu Baan is India’s first helicopter-dropped unmanned aerial system project initiated by the Indian Air Force to enhance combat capabilities. Designed as an air-launched drone, it can be deployed from helicopters to perform both reconnaissance and precision strike missions. The system is capable of autonomous navigation, real-time video transmission, and operating in GPS-denied environments. With a stand-off range of over 50 km and an endurance of around 30 minutes, it significantly improves operational safety by allowing aircrew to stay out of high-threat zones while maintaining offensive reach.

questions.question: On which date was Earth Hour 2026 observed globally?
questions.explanation: Earth Hour 2026 was observed on March 28, marking the 20th anniversary of this global environmental movement. Organised by the World Wide Fund for Nature, the event encourages individuals, communities, and organisations to take meaningful action for the planet. The theme “Give an Hour for Earth” promotes dedicating one hour to activities that support environmental sustainability. Over the years, Earth Hour has evolved from a symbolic lights-off event into a broader movement aimed at raising awareness about climate change and biodiversity loss, inspiring long-term sustainable practices and global cooperation.

questions.question: Which Indian Navy ship made a port call at Maputo, Mozambique, on March 26, 2026?
questions.explanation: INS Trikand, a frontline guided missile frigate of the Indian Navy, arrived at Maputo, Mozambique, on March 26, 2026, as part of its operational deployment in the South West Indian Ocean Region. The visit aims to strengthen maritime cooperation and enhance bilateral relations between India and Mozambique. During the port call, the ship is involved in humanitarian assistance by delivering disaster relief materials, conducting professional exchanges with the Mozambique Navy, and engaging in social outreach activities such as medical camps, yoga sessions, and community services, reflecting India’s commitment to regional partnership and security.

questions.question: According to the QS World University Rankings 2026, how many top 50 entries did India achieve?
questions.explanation: India achieved a remarkable feat in the QS World University Rankings 2026 by doubling its top 50 entries from 12 in 2024 to 27 in 2026. This significant improvement reflects India’s growing academic strength and global competitiveness in higher education. Premier institutions such as the IITs, IIM Ahmedabad, IIM Bangalore, IIM Calcutta, JNU, and BITS Pilani contributed to this surge with strong performances across various disciplines. The rankings evaluate universities based on academic reputation, employer reputation, research output, and international collaboration, highlighting India’s momentum in quality and competitiveness.

questions.question: What is Goldman Sachs’ revised GDP growth forecast for India in 2026?
questions.explanation: Goldman Sachs has revised India’s GDP growth forecast for 2026 to 5.9%, reflecting concerns over rising global oil prices and economic uncertainties. India, being a major importer of crude oil, is highly vulnerable to fluctuations in energy prices, which can increase inflation and widen the trade deficit. Additionally, factors such as the weakening rupee and global supply disruptions contribute to slower economic momentum. Higher inflation may prompt the Reserve Bank of India to increase interest rates, which can reduce consumer demand and investment, further affecting overall economic growth in the short term.

questions.question: On which date is World Meteorological Day observed every year?
questions.explanation: World Meteorological Day is observed annually on March 23 to mark the establishment of the World Meteorological Organisation (WMO) in 1950. The day emphasises the importance of meteorology in understanding weather, climate, and water systems. It highlights how accurate weather data supports disaster preparedness, agriculture, aviation, and environmental protection. The 2026 theme, “Observing Today, Protecting Tomorrow,” underscores the role of continuous monitoring and advanced technologies in mitigating climate risks. Celebrating this day also promotes global cooperation in sharing weather data and improving forecasting systems for a safer and more sustainable future.

questions.question: On which date is the International Day for the Right to Truth concerning gross human rights violations observed?
questions.explanation: The International Day for the Right to Truth is observed on March 24 each year to emphasize justice, transparency, and respect for human dignity. This day commemorates Archbishop Óscar Arnulfo Romero, who was assassinated on March 24, 1980, for speaking out against human rights abuses. It highlights the importance of ensuring that victims and their families have access to accurate information about violations such as torture, disappearances, and killings. The United Nations established this observance to promote awareness, strengthen justice systems, and honor those who have courageously defended human rights across the world.

questions.question: Till which year has the Indian government extended the PM E-DRIVE scheme for EV incentives?
questions.explanation: The Indian government has extended the PM E-DRIVE scheme for electric vehicle incentives until 2028, demonstrating its continued commitment to promoting sustainable mobility. This policy shift prioritises segments such as e-rickshaws and electric three-wheelers, which play a crucial role in last-mile connectivity and logistics. While subsidies for electric two-wheelers will end earlier, the extended timeline for other segments ensures steady growth in the EV ecosystem. The scheme also aims to balance economic growth with fiscal responsibility, encouraging manufacturers to focus on innovation, localisation, and market-driven strategies as subsidies are gradually phased out.

questions.question: Which institution launched the Krishnamurthy Tandon School of Artificial Intelligence with a ₹100 crore endowment?
questions.explanation: IIM Ahmedabad has launched the Krishnamurthy Tandon School of Artificial Intelligence with a ₹100 crore endowment to strengthen India’s AI and education ecosystem. The initiative aims to bridge the gap between advanced AI research and real-world applications in business and governance. It focuses on areas such as ethical AI use, workforce readiness, and strategic integration of AI in organisations. By promoting translational research, the institution seeks to convert innovations into practical solutions. This move highlights the growing importance of AI in shaping industries and reflects India’s commitment to becoming a leader in emerging technologies.

questions.question: What GDP growth rate has the OECD projected for India in FY26?
questions.explanation: The OECD has projected India’s GDP growth at 7.6% for FY26, highlighting the country’s strong economic resilience despite global uncertainties. This growth is supported by robust domestic demand, increasing infrastructure investments, and expansion in technology-driven sectors. Additionally, favourable trade conditions and a growing middle class contribute to sustained consumption and industrial activity. However, challenges such as rising global energy prices and geopolitical tensions, particularly in West Asia, may affect future growth prospects. The projection reflects optimism about India’s economic fundamentals while also cautioning about potential slowdowns due to external pressures.

questions.question: Whose signature will appear on US dollar bills for the first time in 165 years, starting June 2026?
questions.explanation: The United States is set to introduce a historic change in its currency design by featuring the signature of President Donald Trump on dollar bills starting in June 2026. This marks the first time in 165 years that a sitting president’s signature will replace that of the US Treasurer. The decision aligns with the 250th anniversary of American independence and reflects a symbolic shift in monetary tradition. While the overall design of the currency remains unchanged, this modification highlights evolving practices in financial governance and demonstrates how national milestones can influence institutional decisions.

questions.question: On which date is World Theatre Day celebrated globally every year?
questions.explanation: World Theatre Day is celebrated annually on March 27 to recognise the importance of theatre as a powerful medium of cultural expression and communication. Initiated by the International Theatre Institute, the day promotes awareness about the value of theatre in society and encourages governments to support the performing arts. It highlights how theatre fosters creativity, addresses social issues, and strengthens cultural exchange across nations. The celebration also brings together artists and audiences worldwide through performances, workshops, and events, reinforcing theatre’s role in promoting peace, dialogue, and global harmony.

questions.question: Which state government launched the Industrial Park Promotion Policy 2026 to attract investment and boost industrial growth?
questions.explanation: The Industrial Park Promotion Policy 2026 has been introduced by the Rajasthan government to enhance industrial development, attract both domestic and foreign investment, and generate employment opportunities. The policy promotes flexible development models, including private ownership and public-private partnerships, ensuring broad participation. It also emphasizes sustainable growth through incentives for renewable energy use and eco-friendly infrastructure. Additionally, measures to improve ease of doing business, such as faster approvals and financial concessions, aim to create a business-friendly environment. This initiative aligns with national programs like Make in India and strengthens Rajasthan’s position as a growing industrial hub.

questions.question: Which region of India witnessed the inauguration of a new District Court Complex at Kargil?
questions.explanation: The District Court Complex at Kargil was inaugurated to enhance judicial infrastructure in the remote and high-altitude region of Ladakh. Due to harsh climatic conditions, the inauguration was conducted virtually by the Chief Justice of India. Ladakh’s unique geographical challenges often make access to justice difficult for residents. The newly constructed complex, equipped with modern facilities and climate-resilient design, aims to address these issues. By bringing legal services closer to the people, especially in border districts like Kargil, it improves accessibility, reduces travel hardships, and strengthens the delivery of justice in the region.

questions.question: Who was appointed as the new Director-General of the BBC in March 2026?
questions.explanation: Matt Brittin has been appointed as the new Director-General of the BBC, marking a significant leadership change in the organisation. A former Google executive, he brings extensive experience from his tenure at the tech giant, where he served as President of the Europe, Middle East, and Africa (EMEA) region. His appointment follows the resignation of Tim Davie amid controversy. Brittin is set to take charge in May 2026 and is expected to guide the BBC through evolving media landscapes, focusing on digital transformation, editorial integrity, and global outreach in an increasingly competitive broadcasting environment.

questions.question: In which country did Dr S. Jaishankar participate in the G7 Foreign Ministers’ Meeting in March 2026?
questions.explanation: Dr S. Jaishankar attended the G7 Foreign Ministers’ Meeting held in France in March 2026.
