It provides ₹1,000 per month for general category women and ₹1,500 for Scheduled Caste women. Women aged 18 and above who are registered voters and residents of the state can benefit. With no family cap and additional benefits alongside existing pensions, the initiative strengthens social security and financial inclusion across both urban and rural areas.

questions.question: Which state’s Science City signed an MoU with CSIR–NIScPR to strengthen science communication and policy research?
questions.explanation: Andhra Pradesh is the state where the Science City collaborated with CSIR–NIScPR through a Memorandum of Understanding. This partnership is aimed at enhancing science communication and promoting research in Science, Technology, and Innovation policy. It focuses on evidence-based policymaking, capacity building, and public awareness of science. The initiative includes activities such as organising workshops, conducting joint research, and developing educational resources. It benefits students, researchers, and policymakers while aligning with sustainable development goals and strengthening scientific outreach across the state.

questions.question: What is the name of India’s largest collaborative capacity-building initiative launched by the Capacity Building Commission in April 2026?
questions.explanation: Sadhana Saptah is a nationwide capacity-building initiative launched by the Capacity Building Commission in April 2026. It is designed to strengthen governance by enhancing the skills and competencies of civil servants across India. The program involves participation from numerous ministries, states, and training institutions, making it one of the greatest collaborative efforts of its kind. Structured around themes like technology, tradition, and tangible outcomes, it aligns with the vision of Viksit Bharat 2047. The initiative also complements Mission Karmayogi by promoting role-based training and improving public service delivery.

questions.question: In which state was the Kaynes Semiconductor Plant inaugurated by the Prime Minister to boost India’s chip industry?
questions.explanation: Gujarat is the state where the Kaynes Semiconductor Plant was inaugurated in Sanand, marking a major step in strengthening India’s semiconductor ecosystem. The facility contributes to domestic chip production and supports industries such as electric vehicles, electronics, and industrial automation. It aligns with the India Semiconductor Mission and the ‘Make in India’ initiative, aiming to reduce dependence on imports and integrate India into global supply chains. The plant also highlights the country’s push toward technological advancement, export potential, and workforce development in the semiconductor sector.

questions.question: In which state is the Coal to Ammonium Nitrate project being developed under the agreement between BCGCL and MCL?
questions.explanation: Odisha is the state where the Coal to Ammonium Nitrate project is being developed following a land leasing agreement between Bharat Coal Gasification and Chemicals Limited (BCGCL) and Mahanadi Coalfields Limited (MCL). The project is located in Lakhanpur and focuses on converting coal into ammonium nitrate, a key chemical used in fertilizers and industrial explosives. This initiative supports India’s broader goal of reducing import dependency and enhancing self-reliance in the chemical and energy sectors through coal gasification technology, thereby contributing to both regional industrial growth and national economic objectives.

questions.question: Who has been appointed as the Director General of the Directorate General of Civil Aviation (DGCA)?
questions.explanation: Vir Vikram Yadav has been appointed as the Director General of the Directorate General of Civil Aviation (DGCA), replacing Faiz Ahmed Kidwai. A senior Indian Administrative Service officer from the Odisha cadre, he brings significant administrative experience to the role. Prior to this appointment, he served as Additional Secretary in the Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change. His appointment is part of a key administrative reshuffle approved by the Appointments Committee of the Cabinet. With his leadership, the DGCA is expected to further strengthen aviation safety, regulatory oversight, and operational efficiency in India’s rapidly growing civil aviation sector.

questions.question: When is World Autism Awareness Day observed globally to promote understanding and acceptance of individuals with Autism Spectrum Disorder?
questions.explanation: April 2 is observed globally as World Autism Awareness Day to foster understanding, promote acceptance, and support individuals living with Autism Spectrum Disorder. Established by the United Nations in 2007 and first observed in 2008, this day plays a crucial role in raising awareness and breaking social stigmas associated with autism. It also emphasises the importance of inclusion and equal opportunities for the neurodivergent community. While April 2 is the main observance day, the entire month is recognized as Autism Awareness Month, extending outreach efforts across schools, workplaces, and healthcare institutions.

questions.question: Which country launched the ICP mobile application to help identify venomous snakes and improve public safety?
questions.explanation: Costa Rica launched the ICP mobile application through the Universidad de Costa Rica’s Clodomiro Picado Institute to assist in identifying venomous snakes accurately. The app covers 25 venomous species and also provides information on commonly confused non-venomous species, reducing misidentification risks. It includes visual aids, first aid instructions for snake bites, and geographical logging features to help healthcare providers determine the species involved in incidents. This initiative enhances public awareness, promotes safety, and prevents unnecessary harm to harmless snakes by offering reliable, science-based information accessible on both Android and iOS platforms.

questions.question: Who has been appointed as the first woman Commissioner of the Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation?
questions.explanation: Ashwini Bhide has been appointed as the first woman Commissioner of the Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation, marking a historic milestone in the civic body's history. A 1995-batch Indian Administrative Service officer, she brings extensive administrative experience and is known for her significant contributions to Mumbai’s infrastructure development, particularly metro expansion projects. Her appointment reflects a broader initiative by the Maharashtra government to promote women into key leadership roles. With prior experience as Additional Municipal Commissioner, she possesses strong operational knowledge, ensuring continuity and effective governance in one of India’s largest civic bodies.

questions.question: Which country received 1,000 metric tonnes of rice from India as humanitarian aid to address food security challenges?
questions.explanation: Burkina Faso received the humanitarian aid from India in the form of 1,000 metric tonnes of rice. This assistance was aimed at addressing severe food insecurity affecting vulnerable communities and internally displaced persons in the region. The initiative reflects India’s commitment to its Humanitarian Assistance and Disaster Relief (HADR) framework and its role as a supportive partner in the Global South. Such efforts not only provide immediate nutritional relief but also strengthen diplomatic relations and promote welfare-focused cooperation with African nations beyond purely economic engagements.

questions.question: Who has assumed command as the General Officer Commanding-in-Chief of the Western Command of the Indian Army?
questions.explanation: Lieutenant General Pushpendra Pal Singh has taken charge as the General Officer Commanding-in-Chief of the Western Command, a crucial formation of the Indian Army. This command is responsible for safeguarding India’s western frontiers and ensuring operational preparedness in sensitive border areas. Headquartered at Chandimandir, the Western Command plays a pivotal role in national defense, particularly in the north-western region. His leadership involves overseeing military operations, maintaining readiness, and strengthening strategic defence mechanisms to uphold the country’s territorial integrity and respond effectively to any security challenges.

questions.question: Who has been appointed as the new Chief Executive Officer (CEO) of IndiGo?
questions.explanation: William Walsh has been appointed as the new Chief Executive Officer of IndiGo, bringing decades of experience in the global aviation industry. Currently serving as the Director General of the International Air Transport Association (IATA), he is expected to assume office by August 3, 2026, subject to regulatory approvals. His career began as a pilot before advancing into leadership roles, including CEO of British Airways and later heading International Airlines Group (IAG). His expertise in airline management and global operations is expected to support IndiGo’s expansion, strategic growth, and enhancement of customer experience.

questions.question: Who has been appointed as the Chairman and Managing Director (CMD) of Power Grid Corporation of India Limited?
questions.explanation: Burra Vamsi Rama Mohan has been appointed as the Chairman and Managing Director of Power Grid Corporation of India Limited, a key public sector enterprise in the power transmission sector. He assumed office on April 1, 2026, and his tenure is set to continue until July 31, 2030, or until further government directives. With over 33 years of professional experience, he has developed strong expertise across multiple domains, including project management, procurement, regulatory affairs, and telecommunications. His leadership is expected to strengthen operational efficiency and support the expansion of India’s power transmission infrastructure.

questions.question: Who has assumed command as the General Officer Commanding-in-Chief of the Southern Command of the Indian Army?
questions.explanation: Lieutenant General Sandeep Jain has taken over as the General Officer Commanding-in-Chief of the Southern Command on April 1, 2026. He succeeded Lieutenant General Dhiraj Seth, who moved to a senior position in New Delhi. An alumnus of the National Defence Academy, he was commissioned into the MAHAR Regiment in 1988 and currently serves as its Colonel. Over his distinguished career, he has contributed significantly to indigenous capability development and technological advancement within the Army. His service has been recognized with prestigious awards such as the Ati Vishisht Seva Medal and the Sena Medal.

questions.question: Who became England’s top-ranked female chess player, achieving significant national and global recognition?
questions.explanation: Bodhana Sivanandan has become England’s top-ranked female chess player, marking a historic achievement in her career. She surpassed four-time British Women's Champion Lan Yao and is currently the highest-rated female player across the United Kingdom. Her global standing has also improved significantly, as she is ranked among the top 100 female players by the International Chess Federation (FIDE). Known for her exceptional talent at a young age, she has defeated experienced Grandmasters and secured a Woman Grandmaster norm, highlighting her rapid rise and potential in international chess.

questions.question: Which state launched a free electricity scheme for weavers, benefiting over one lakh families?
questions.explanation: Andhra Pradesh launched a free electricity scheme aimed at supporting weaver families across the state, benefiting nearly 1.03 lakh households. The initiative covers both handloom and powerloom workers, providing 200 units and 500 units of free electricity per month, respectively. This measure is expected to significantly reduce operational costs and improve income stability, with estimated annual savings ranging from ₹8,000 to ₹21,000 per family. With a budget allocation of around ₹150 crore annually, the scheme reflects the government’s commitment to strengthening traditional industries and ensuring the welfare of artisans.

questions.question: Which country’s airport topped the Skytrax World Airport Awards 2026 rankings for the 14th time?
questions.explanation: Singapore’s Changi Airport secured the top position in the Skytrax World Airport Awards 2026, marking the 14th time it has achieved this distinction since 2000. Renowned as a major international hub in Southeast Asia, the airport is celebrated for its exceptional passenger experience, advanced infrastructure, and unique attractions such as The Jewel, which houses the world’s tallest indoor waterfall. Its consistent ranking reflects high standards in services like dining, entertainment, and connectivity. The recognition also highlights Singapore’s global leadership in aviation excellence and airport management.

questions.question: Who has taken charge as the Vice Chief of the Army Staff amid the Indian Army’s modernisation push?
questions.explanation: Lt Gen Dhiraj Seth has assumed the role of Vice Chief of the Army Staff, bringing with him nearly four decades of extensive military experience. His career includes leadership roles across diverse terrains, including desert operations and counter-insurgency missions in Jammu & Kashmir. He has also held key strategic and staff positions at Army Headquarters and served in international assignments such as a United Nations mission in Angola. Known for his strong academic background and excellence in military training, his appointment reflects the Army’s emphasis on experienced leadership to drive modernisation and enhance operational readiness.

questions.question: Which application will be used to map and locate authorised Aadhaar centres under the agreement between UIDAI and MapmyIndia?
questions.explanation: Mappls App will be used to map and locate authorised Aadhaar centres through a collaboration between the Unique Identification Authority of India (UIDAI) and MapmyIndia. The integration ensures accurate and official listings of Aadhaar service points across the country. Users will be able to search for centres based on specific services such as new enrollment, child enrollment, and updates to address or mobile numbers. This initiative enhances accessibility and convenience for citizens by providing reliable, service-specific location data and is expected to become fully operational in the coming months.

questions.question: Panchayats from which state won three National Satat Vikas Puraskar 2025 awards for contributions to sustainable development?
questions.explanation: Tripura has achieved national recognition as three of its Panchayats received the National Satat Vikas Puraskar 2025 for their outstanding work in sustainable development. Sepahijala District Panchayat secured the top position in the “Best District Panchayat” category, while Kanchabari Gram Panchayat ranked first in the “Healthy Panchayat” category. Baikunthapur Gram Panchayat earned third place in the “Women-Friendly Panchayat” category. These awards highlight effective grassroots governance and development initiatives. The recognition is accompanied by financial assistance from the central government to further strengthen local development and improve living standards in these regions.

questions.question: Which organisation launched the ‘Kar Saathi’ AI assistant and a new website to simplify the tax-filing process?
questions.explanation: Income Tax Department launched the ‘Kar Saathi’ AI-powered assistant along with a new official website to streamline and simplify the tax-filing process. This initiative aims to provide taxpayers with a centralised and user-friendly platform for accessing direct tax-related services and information. The AI chatbot offers round-the-clock assistance, helping users resolve queries efficiently. As part of broader administrative reforms, the move aligns with efforts to modernise tax systems, reduce complexity, and enhance transparency. The initiative also supports the government’s vision of a technology-driven tax framework under the upcoming Income Tax Act, 2025.

questions.question: Which state launched the ‘School Chalen Hum’ campaign for the academic year 2025-26 to improve student enrollment?
questions.explanation: Madhya Pradesh launched the ‘School Chalen Hum’ campaign to boost student enrollment and ensure that no child is left out of the education system. The initiative covers all districts and thousands of villages, aiming to enroll a large number of students in the academic year 2025-26. The campaign includes simplified admission processes, distribution of textbooks, and infrastructure improvements in schools. Additionally, the state is focusing on teacher recruitment, language inclusivity, and welfare schemes such as providing laptops, scooters, uniforms, and hostels to support students, particularly those from marginalised communities.

questions.question: Which vessel has been delivered to the Indian Navy as a next-generation anti-submarine warfare shallow water craft?
questions.explanation: INS Malwan is a next-generation anti-submarine warfare shallow water craft delivered to the Indian Navy to strengthen coastal defence. Built by Cochin Shipyard Limited with over 80% indigenous content, it reflects India’s push toward self-reliance in defence manufacturing. Designed for operations in shallow coastal waters, the vessel is equipped with advanced sonar systems, torpedoes, and surveillance capabilities to detect and neutralise underwater threats. It is part of a planned fleet of eight such vessels aimed at replacing older corvettes and enhancing maritime security, particularly in sensitive littoral regions.

questions.question: Who has been appointed as the Secretary of the Ministry of Information & Broadcasting in April 2026?
questions.explanation: Shri Chanchal Kumar has been appointed as the Secretary of the Ministry of Information & Broadcasting, assuming charge on April 1, 2026. A 1992-batch IAS officer from the Bihar cadre, he has held several important positions in both central and state governments. His prior roles include serving as Secretary in the Ministry of Civil Aviation and the Ministry of Development of North Eastern Region, as well as Managing Director of NHIDCL. In Bihar, he has worked closely with the Chief Minister in key administrative roles. His vast experience is expected to contribute significantly to policy implementation and governance in the ministry.

questions.question: Where was INS Taragiri commissioned as part of the Indian Navy’s Project 17A stealth frigate program?
questions.explanation: Visakhapatnam is the location where INS Taragiri, the fifth Project 17A stealth frigate of the Indian Navy, was officially commissioned. The ceremony took place at the Naval Dockyard, highlighting the city’s importance as a key naval base on India’s eastern coast. Designed by the Navy’s Warship Design Bureau and built by Mazagon Dock Shipbuilders Limited, the vessel reflects India’s progress in indigenous defence manufacturing. With advanced stealth features and multi-role combat capabilities, the commissioning strengthens India’s maritime security and enhances the operational readiness of its naval forces.

questions.question: How many medals has India assured at the Asian Boxing Championships 2026 after its boxers reached the semifinals?
questions.explanation: 3 Medals have been assured for India at the Asian Boxing Championships 2026 as three Indian boxers—Nikhat Zareen, Priya, and Preeti Pawar—secured their spots in the semifinals. In boxing tournaments, reaching the semifinals guarantees at least a bronze medal, ensuring podium finishes for all three athletes. This achievement highlights the strong performance of Indian boxers on the continental stage and reflects the effectiveness of training and selection processes managed by the Boxing Federation of India. It also showcases India’s growing prominence in international amateur boxing competitions.

questions.question: What was India’s global rank in the renewable energy market in 2025 according to the IRENA report?
questions.explanation: 3rd is India’s global rank in the renewable energy market in 2025 as per the IRENA Renewable Capacity Statistics 2026 report. This achievement reflects India’s rapid expansion in renewable energy capacity, which reached 250.5 GW. The growth was largely driven by significant additions in solar and wind energy, including 37 GW of solar capacity and a record increase in wind power. India now stands behind only China and the United States in renewable energy capacity, highlighting its strong commitment to sustainable energy development and its growing role in the global transition to clean energy.

questions.question: Which state emerged as the overall champion at the inaugural Khelo India Tribal Games 2026?
questions.explanation: Karnataka emerged as the overall champion at the inaugural Khelo India Tribal Games 2026 by securing the highest number of gold medals. The state achieved an impressive tally of 23 gold, 8 silver, and 7 bronze medals, totalling 38 medals. Karnataka’s dominance was particularly evident in swimming, where its athletes performed exceptionally well. The event saw participation from 30 states and Union Territories, showcasing a wide pool of tribal talent across multiple sports disciplines. The achievement highlights Karnataka’s strong sports infrastructure and commitment to nurturing talent at the grassroots level.

questions.question: In which region is the Mission Mitra high-altitude experiment being conducted to simulate deep space conditions for Gaganyaan astronauts?
questions.explanation: Ladakh has been chosen as the location for the Mission Mitra high-altitude experiment due to its extreme environmental conditions, including low oxygen levels and freezing temperatures. These conditions closely resemble aspects of space, making it an ideal terrestrial analogue for astronaut training. The mission, led by ISRO’s Human Space Flight Centre, aims to assess human adaptability, endurance, and performance in challenging environments. This initiative supports India’s Gaganyaan program by preparing astronauts for real space missions, enhancing their ability to operate effectively under stress and in isolated conditions.

questions.question: Which submarine was commissioned as India’s third indigenous nuclear-powered ballistic missile submarine in April 2026?
questions.explanation: INS Aridhaman was commissioned as India’s third indigenous nuclear-powered ballistic missile submarine, marking a significant milestone in the country’s defence capabilities. It belongs to the Arihant-class submarines and was developed under the Advanced Technology Vessel (ATV) project. Built at the Ship Building Centre in Visakhapatnam, the submarine strengthens India’s Nuclear Triad by enabling sea-based nuclear deterrence. With enhanced size and firepower, it can carry advanced missiles like the K-15 and K-4. This development reflects India’s growing self-reliance in defence technology and its focus on strengthening maritime and strategic security.

questions.question: In which city will animal welfare committees be set up across all districts to prevent cruelty to animals?
questions.explanation: New Delhi will see the establishment of animal welfare committees across all its districts as part of a government initiative to strengthen monitoring and prevent cruelty to animals. These district-level bodies will function under the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals Act, 1960, and will be led by respective District Magistrates to ensure effective implementation. The move also includes restructuring existing institutions to improve efficiency. With support from the state-level Animal Welfare Board, these committees will enhance coordination, provide better enforcement, and ensure quicker responses to cases of animal cruelty.

questions.question: Where is the new 1,00,000-seater cricket stadium being planned by the Mumbai Cricket Association?
questions.explanation: Navi Mumbai has been selected as the location for a new world-class cricket stadium with a seating capacity of 1,00,000, making it significantly larger than the existing Wankhede Stadium. The Mumbai Cricket Association is working in coordination with CIDCO to acquire suitable land for the project. This initiative aims to address the growing demand for larger sporting venues and enhance infrastructure for hosting major cricket events. The development of such a large stadium is expected to boost sports culture, attract international matches, and strengthen Navi Mumbai’s status as an emerging urban and sporting hub.

questions.question: Which state has signed a Letter of Intent with Starlink India to pilot satellite-based internet services in remote areas?
questions.explanation: Meghalaya has signed a Letter of Intent with Starlink India to introduce satellite-based internet services aimed at improving connectivity in remote and hilly regions. The initiative uses Low-Earth Orbit satellites to overcome the challenges posed by difficult terrain, where traditional infrastructure is hard to establish. Initially, a pilot phase will assess the performance and reliability of the technology before wider implementation. The project is expected to benefit sectors such as education, healthcare, disaster management, and economic development, while also enhancing communication in border and underserved areas.

questions.question: When is the International Day for Mine Awareness and Assistance in Mine Action observed annually?
questions.explanation: April 4 is observed annually as the International Day for Mine Awareness and Assistance in Mine Action. The day focuses on raising awareness about the dangers posed by landmines, unexploded ordnance, and improvised explosive devices, which continue to threaten civilian lives even after conflicts end. Established by the United Nations, it emphasises the importance of mine clearance, victim assistance, and global cooperation. The observance also highlights the need for sustained investment in mine action initiatives, which are essential for restoring safe living conditions, supporting humanitarian efforts, and enabling long-term peace and development.

questions.question: As of March 28, 2026, which country has enforced a new law banning children under 16 from accessing major social media platforms?
questions.explanation: As of March 28, 2026, Indonesia implemented a significant regulation prohibiting children under 16 from accessing major social media platforms such as YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, and Facebook. The move is aimed at protecting millions of young users from risks including cyberbullying, harmful content, scams, and excessive digital exposure. This makes Indonesia the first country in Southeast Asia to take such strict action. The decision reflects growing global concerns over children’s mental health and online safety, while also encouraging healthier offline activities despite challenges in enforcement and compliance.

questions.question: On which date is the Foundation Day of the Reserve Bank of India observed every year?
questions.explanation: The Foundation Day of the Reserve Bank of India is observed on April 1 each year, marking its establishment in 1935 under the RBI Act of 1934. This day highlights the central bank’s crucial role in managing India’s monetary policy, controlling inflation, regulating the banking system, and ensuring financial stability. Over time, the RBI has expanded its functions to include digital payment security and financial innovation. Observing this day also emphasizes the institution’s continued importance in addressing modern economic challenges such as currency fluctuations, global uncertainties, and maintaining overall economic stability in India.

questions.question: What was the percentage growth of India’s industrial output in February 2026 according to the Index of Industrial Production (IIP)?
questions.explanation: India’s industrial output recorded a growth of 5.2% in February 2026, indicating a modest improvement compared to the previous month. This growth was largely driven by the manufacturing sector, which plays a dominant role in the Index of Industrial Production (IIP). While manufacturing showed strong recovery, other sectors such as mining and electricity displayed mixed trends, slightly limiting overall momentum. The data released by the National Statistics Office reflects a gradual industrial recovery despite challenges like rising input costs and global geopolitical tensions affecting production and profitability across industries.

questions.question: Who became the most-capped overseas player in IPL history with 190 matches?
questions.explanation: Sunil Narine holds the record for the most matches played by an overseas player in IPL history, reaching 190 appearances. He surpassed Kieron Pollard, who previously held the record with 189 matches. Narine achieved this milestone while playing for Kolkata Knight Riders, the only team he has represented in the league. Since his debut in 2012, he has been a key all-rounder, contributing significantly with both bat and ball. His consistency, match-winning performances, and ability to perform under pressure have made him one of the most valuable players in IPL history.

questions.question: What is the projected GDP growth rate for India in FY2026-27 as estimated by ICRA?
questions.explanation: The projected GDP growth rate for India in FY2026-27 is estimated at 6.5%, indicating a slowdown compared to the current fiscal year’s higher growth rate. This moderation is attributed to rising global crude oil prices, geopolitical tensions in West Asia, and supply chain disruptions. These factors contribute to increased inflation, higher production and transportation costs, and reduced consumer spending. Additionally, the widening current account deficit reflects higher import bills, especially for energy resources. Despite these challenges, the Indian economy remains resilient, but external pressures are expected to influence overall economic performance in the coming fiscal year.

questions.question: Which type of missile is the ASRAAM equipped on MiG-29 fighter jets classified as?
questions.explanation: ASRAAM (Advanced Short Range Air-to-Air Missile) is classified as an air-to-air missile, designed specifically for targeting enemy aircraft during flight. It uses advanced infrared heat-seeking technology and operates on a fire-and-forget principle, allowing pilots to launch it and focus on other maneuvers. This makes it extremely effective in close-range aerial combat or dogfights. Its integration into aircraft like the MiG-29 enhances operational efficiency, improves engagement range, and strengthens air superiority capabilities, reflecting a major advancement in modern aerial warfare technology.

questions.question: Who has been appointed as the Director of BRIC-NCCS Pune?
questions.explanation: Dr Thomas Pucadyil has been appointed as the Director of BRIC-NCCS Pune, bringing extensive expertise in cell biology and research innovation. He previously served as a professor at IISER Pune, where he built a strong research foundation. Known for his work on membrane biology and cellular processes, he has received prestigious recognitions such as the Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar Prize. His leadership is expected to enhance the institution’s research capabilities, particularly in areas like cancer biology, microbiology, and immunology. This appointment reflects India’s growing focus on advancing biomedical research and strengthening its global scientific presence.

questions.question: Which state celebrates Rongali Bihu as the New Year festival?
questions.explanation: Assam is the state where Rongali Bihu, also known as Bohag Bihu, is widely celebrated as the Assamese New Year. Observed on April 5 in 2026, this festival marks the arrival of spring and holds great cultural and agricultural significance. It symbolises joy, renewal, and prosperity for the farming community. The celebrations include traditional dances, songs, and rituals such as exchanging the Gamocha as a sign of respect. People dress in traditional attire like Mekhela Chador, and community feasts further strengthen social bonds, making it one of the most important festivals of the region.

questions.question: Which company has signed an MoU with NSIL for the development of space-grade solar panels?
questions.explanation: Dhruva Space, a Hyderabad-based aerospace company, has signed a Memorandum of Understanding with NewSpace India Limited (NSIL) to collaborate on space-grade solar panels. This partnership focuses on the design, manufacturing, testing, and supply of solar panels for satellite applications. Dhruva Space will benefit from NSIL’s expertise in program management and quality assurance, which are crucial for global space missions. The collaboration aims to strengthen India’s position in the international space market, especially as global demand for satellite components continues to grow, and to support the expansion of India’s space technology capabilities.

questions.question: In which state were ATL Sarthi and the Mentor India Academy launched to promote school-to-startup innovation?
questions.explanation: Telangana is the state where ATL Sarthi and the Mentor India Academy were launched under the Atal Innovation Mission of NITI Aayog. This initiative aims to strengthen innovation at the school level by providing structured mentorship and institutional support to hundreds of Atal Tinkering Labs. The program introduces a cluster-based mentorship model that connects schools with higher education institutions and industry experts. It focuses on nurturing young innovators, enhancing teacher capabilities, and creating a strong pipeline from ideation to real-world applications, contributing to the vision of a developed and innovation-driven India by 2047.

questions.question: On which date is the International Day of Sport for Development and Peace (IDSDP) celebrated globally every year?
questions.explanation: April 6 is observed every year as the International Day of Sport for Development and Peace, emphasizing the powerful role of sports in uniting people across cultures and communities. The day was proclaimed by the United Nations General Assembly in 2013 and has been officially celebrated since 2014. It highlights how sports contribute to social inclusion, gender equality, youth empowerment, and the promotion of human rights. Through various global events and activities, this day encourages the use of sport as a tool to build bridges, break barriers, and foster peace and development worldwide.

questions.question: When is National Maritime Day observed in India?
questions.explanation: April 5 is observed every year as National Maritime Day in India to recognize the importance of the maritime sector in the nation’s development and global trade. The date commemorates the historic voyage of the SS Loyalty in 1919, the first Indian-owned ship that sailed from Mumbai to London. This day highlights the vital contributions of seafarers, port authorities, and maritime organizations in ensuring smooth international trade and connectivity. It also reflects India’s rich maritime heritage and emphasizes the sector’s role in economic growth and progress.

questions.question: Who won the gold medal in the long jump at the inaugural Indian Athletics Series 2026 held in Bengaluru?
questions.explanation: Murali Sreeshankar, a prominent Indian long jumper, secured the gold medal at the inaugural Indian Athletics Series 2026 held in Bengaluru. He delivered an outstanding performance by consistently jumping beyond the 8.00-meter mark in all six attempts, also surpassing the Asian Games qualifying standard of 7.91 meters. His achievement highlights his excellent form at the start of the season. The event was part of a newly introduced series by the Athletics Federation of India to promote competitive athletics, and it plays a crucial role in athlete selection for major international events like the Asian Games.

questions.question: In which state was the 47th Raising Day of Project Chetak celebrated at Bikaner?
questions.explanation: Rajasthan is the state where the 47th Raising Day of Project Chetak was celebrated at Bikaner on April 4, 2026. Project Chetak, under the Border Roads Organisation, plays a crucial role in developing and maintaining infrastructure in India’s western border regions. Established in 1980, the project has significantly contributed to strengthening connectivity and supporting national security. It covers a vast network of over 4,000 kilometres of roads across Rajasthan, Punjab, and parts of Gujarat, ensuring efficient movement for defence forces and promoting regional development in strategically important areas.

questions.question: Which organisation has partnered with IGX to launch natural gas derivatives in India?
questions.explanation: NSE, or the National Stock Exchange of India, has partnered with the Indian Gas Exchange Limited (IGX) to introduce natural gas derivatives based on domestic pricing. This initiative marks a significant step in India’s financial and energy markets, as it will be the first time derivatives are linked to a domestic benchmark rather than international indices. The contracts will be based on the Gas IndeX of India (GIXI), ensuring transparency and real-time pricing. This move is expected to enhance risk management, improve market efficiency, and attract broader participation from investors and stakeholders.

questions.question: Where has Microsoft established a ‘Skill Centre’ to enhance student employability in emerging technologies?
questions.explanation: Chandigarh University is the institution where Microsoft has established a state-of-the-art Skill Centre aimed at enhancing student employability in advanced technological domains. This collaboration focuses on providing certifications in high-demand areas such as Artificial Intelligence and Cloud Computing. The initiative includes access to thousands of learning modules, virtual labs, and specialized certifications like Azure Fundamentals and Power BI. It aims to prepare students for real-world challenges and industry requirements, making them job-ready. Additionally, the program supports online degree courses and helps position the region as a hub for digitally skilled professionals.+

questions.question: Who has been appointed as the Brand Ambassador for Census 2027 in India?
questions.explanation: Sudarsan Pattnaik, a globally recognized sand artist, has been appointed as the Brand Ambassador for Census 2027 by the Government of India. Known for his impactful sand art that conveys social messages, he will play a key role in spreading awareness about the importance of the census. A Padma Shri awardee and Guinness World Record holder, Pattnaik’s creative approach is expected to encourage public participation. Census 2027 is significant as it will be India’s first digital census, incorporating modern technology such as self-enumeration through an online portal for improved efficiency and accuracy.

questions.question: What is the Digital Life Certificates (DLC) Campaign 4.0 recognised as in India?
questions.explanation: Pensioner Welfare Initiative is the recognition given to DLC Campaign 4.0, which has become the largest campaign for pensioners in India. Conducted by the Department of Pensions and Pensioners’ Welfare, it achieved massive outreach by generating 1.91 crore Digital Life Certificates between April 2025 and March 2026. The campaign introduced advanced Face Authentication Technology, enabling elderly pensioners to submit certificates easily from home. With extensive coverage across 2,000 locations and support from multiple stakeholders, it ensured accessibility, especially for senior citizens, and marked a major step in digital governance and inclusive service delivery.

questions.question: On which date is World Health Day observed globally every year?
questions.explanation: April 7 is observed annually as World Health Day to mark the founding of the World Health Organization in 1948. The day highlights global health issues and promotes awareness about key public health challenges. In 2026, the theme “Together for health. Stand with science” emphasises the importance of scientific collaboration in improving global health outcomes. Various international events, including forums and summits, are organised to address health concerns and strengthen partnerships. The observance serves as a reminder of the need for accessible healthcare and coordinated global efforts to tackle emerging health threats.

questions.question: Which state government launched a special campaign to create a comprehensive Farmer Registry in April 2026?
questions.explanation: Uttar Pradesh launched a statewide campaign on April 7, 2026, to create a comprehensive Farmer Registry aimed at ensuring transparent and efficient delivery of agricultural benefits. The initiative involves setting up registration camps at Gram Sachivalayas across the state, where local officials like Gram Pradhans and Lekhpals assist farmers. The campaign also focuses on building a reliable digital database to address land record issues and streamline direct financial assistance. With millions of farmers already linked to PM-Kisan, this initiative strengthens governance, improves data accuracy, and enhances the effectiveness of welfare schemes.

questions.question: Who released the “Market for Textiles and Clothing: National Household Survey 2024” report in April 2026?
questions.explanation: Giriraj Singh, the Union Minister of Textiles, released the National Household Survey 2024 report, which provides key insights into India’s textiles and clothing market. The report highlights significant growth in the sector, with the market size expanding substantially over the past 15 years. It also emphasizes the role of household demand, rising per capita consumption, and changing consumer preferences. The findings indicate strong demand for man-made fibers and sustainable textiles, along with increasing adoption of technical textile products. This report serves as an important resource for policymakers and industry stakeholders to guide future strategies and development.

questions.question: What is the name of the tri-service seminar scheduled to be conducted from April 9-10, 2026?
questions.explanation: Ran Samwad is the name of the tri-service seminar scheduled for April 9-10, 2026, aimed at strengthening coordination among the Indian Army, Navy, and Air Force. This initiative focuses on enhancing jointness and inter-service synergy, which are crucial for modern warfare and integrated military operations. Conducted under the Ministry of Defence, the seminar provides a platform for discussing strategies related to integrated theatre commands and evolving security challenges. Such collaborative efforts help improve the operational efficiency and preparedness of India’s armed forces in dealing with complex defence scenarios.

questions.question: Who laid the foundation stones for new medical facilities at Army hospitals in Delhi on April 6, 2026?
questions.explanation: Rajnath Singh, the Defence Minister of India, laid the foundation stones for several advanced medical facilities at the Army Hospital (Research and Referral) and Base Hospital in Delhi. The event was part of the 262nd Army Medical Corps Raising Day celebrations. The initiative includes the establishment of specialised centres such as ophthalmology, oncology, and joint replacement units, along with the expansion of hospital capacity. These developments aim to enhance healthcare services for armed forces personnel and improve emergency response capabilities, reflecting the government’s focus on strengthening military medical infrastructure.

questions.question: Which state’s High Court released an AI policy in 2026 banning the use of AI in judgment drafting?
questions.explanation: Gujarat is the state where the High Court introduced an Artificial Intelligence policy in 2026 that strictly prohibits the use of AI in drafting judgments and making judicial decisions. The policy ensures that critical legal processes such as sentencing, bail decisions, and the evaluation of evidence remain entirely under human authority. While AI is allowed for limited administrative purposes like legal research and document preparation, strict safeguards have been implemented to protect sensitive data and maintain judicial integrity. This move aims to prevent risks like bias, inaccuracies, and over-reliance on technology in the justice system.

questions.question: When is Prevention of Blindness Week observed in 2026?
questions.explanation: April 1 to April 7 is observed as Prevention of Blindness Week in 2026, focusing on raising awareness about eye health and preventing vision loss. The campaign particularly targets glaucoma, a condition known as the “silent thief of sight” because it often develops without noticeable symptoms until significant damage occurs. The week emphasises the importance of early detection through regular eye check-ups, especially for high-risk groups such as older adults and individuals with diabetes. It also promotes access to eye care services and educates people about preventing irreversible blindness through timely medical intervention.

questions.question: Who was appointed as the Secretary of the Department of Land Resources in April 2026?
questions.explanation: Narendra Bhooshan, a senior IAS officer of the 1992 Uttar Pradesh cadre, assumed charge as the Secretary of the Department of Land Resources on April 6, 2026. With over three decades of administrative experience, he has held several key positions at both state and central levels. His previous roles include Additional Chief Secretary for Energy and Technical Education in Uttar Pradesh, as well as leadership positions in infrastructure, science and technology, and urban governance. His extensive experience is expected to contribute significantly to land resource management and rural development initiatives in India.

questions.question: Which space agency conducted the Artemis II mission that broke the Apollo 13 distance record?
questions.explanation: NASA conducted the Artemis II mission, which set a new record for the farthest distance travelled by humans from Earth, surpassing the Apollo 13 mission’s record from 1970. The mission used the Orion spacecraft and carried a four-member crew on a lunar flyby, reaching a peak distance of 252,752 miles. This achievement marks a significant milestone in space exploration and is part of the broader Artemis program, which aims to establish a sustainable human presence on the Moon and eventually enable missions to Mars.

questions.question: Which Indian Navy ship arrived at Male, Maldives, on April 06, 2026, under the IOS SAGAR initiative?
questions.explanation: INS Sunayna is a Saryu-class offshore patrol vessel of the Indian Navy that arrived at Male as part of its operational deployment under the SAGAR initiative. Commissioned in October 2013 and built by Goa Shipyard Limited, the vessel plays a vital role in maritime security and surveillance. Its deployment reflects India’s commitment to regional cooperation, particularly under the Neighbourhood First policy and MAHASAGAR vision, aimed at ensuring security and growth across the Indian Ocean region through collaborative maritime efforts.

questions.question: Who became India’s first openly queer Member of Parliament after taking oath in the Rajya Sabha in April 2026?
questions.explanation: Menaka Guruswamy made history by becoming India’s first openly queer Member of Parliament after taking oath in the Rajya Sabha in April 2026. A distinguished senior advocate of the Supreme Court of India, she played a key role in the landmark 2018 case that led to the decriminalisation of homosexuality by reading down Section 377 of the IPC. Representing West Bengal as a member of the All India Trinamool Congress, her achievement marks a significant step toward inclusivity and representation of LGBTQ+ individuals in India’s political landscape.

questions.question: Where is India’s first indigenously developed Prototype Fast Breeder Reactor (PFBR) located?
questions.explanation: Kalpakkam is the location of India’s first indigenously developed 500 MWe Prototype Fast Breeder Reactor (PFBR), which recently attained criticality. Developed by Bharatiya Nabhikiya Vidyut Nigam Ltd (BHAVINI), the reactor marks a major milestone in India’s nuclear power programme. It represents the second stage of the three-stage nuclear strategy, aimed at utilising plutonium and eventually thorium for sustainable energy production. The reactor is designed to produce more fuel than it consumes and includes advanced safety features, showcasing India’s progress in nuclear technology and self-reliance.

questions.question: Who became the world’s first quadruple amputee archer to win an international title in 2026?
questions.explanation: Payal Nag made history by becoming the world’s first quadruple amputee archer to win an international title at the World Para Archery Series Final in Bangkok in April 2026. She secured a gold medal in her senior international debut, defeating fellow Indian archer Sheetal Devi. Despite severe physical challenges, she uses a custom prosthetic arm and a unique shooting technique involving her shoulder and mouth. Her achievement highlights extraordinary determination and innovation, inspiring athletes worldwide and bringing recognition to India in para sports.

questions.question: Who assumed the role of Managing Director (MD) and Chief Executive Officer (CEO) of Yes Bank on April 6, 2026?
questions.explanation: Vinay Muralidhar Tonse took charge as the Managing Director and CEO of Yes Bank on April 6, 2026, succeeding Prashant Kumar, who completed his tenure. With over 35 years of experience in the banking and financial services sector, he has held several key leadership positions at State Bank of India, including Managing Director (Retail Business & Operations) and MD & CEO of SBI Mutual Funds. His appointment ensures experienced leadership and continuity in the functioning and strategic direction of the bank.

questions.question: Who assumed charge as the Secretary of the Department of Chemicals and Petrochemicals (DCPC) in April 2026?
questions.explanation: Shri Tejveer Singh, a 1994-batch Indian Administrative Service (IAS) officer from the Punjab cadre, assumed charge as the Secretary of the Department of Chemicals and Petrochemicals (DCPC) in April 2026. He has held several key administrative positions, including Additional Chief Secretary in Punjab’s Technical Education and Industrial Training Department, and Principal Secretary to the Chief Minister. His extensive administrative experience across various roles, including as District Magistrate, equips him to handle responsibilities related to policy formulation and development in the chemical and petrochemical sectors.

questions.question: What is the revised GDP growth forecast for India for FY27 as projected by Morgan Stanley?
questions.explanation: Morgan Stanley revised India’s GDP growth forecast for FY27 to 6.2%, lowering it from the earlier estimate of 6.5%. This revision reflects concerns over geopolitical tensions in West Asia and increasing global energy prices, particularly crude oil. Higher oil prices can raise import bills and inflation, affecting economic growth. The report also highlighted a rise in retail inflation and a widening current account deficit. Such projections are important indicators for policymakers and investors to assess economic stability and future growth prospects.

questions.question: In which year was the Biological Diversity Act enacted in India?
questions.explanation: The Biological Diversity Act was enacted in 2002 to conserve India’s rich biodiversity, promote sustainable use of its components, and ensure fair and equitable sharing of benefits arising from the use of biological resources. The Act provides a legal framework for protecting biological diversity and associated knowledge. It led to the establishment of institutions like the National Biodiversity Authority, which plays a key role in regulating access to biological resources and advising the government. The Act also mandates proper documentation and preservation of newly discovered species through designated repositories.

questions.question: Which state declared cancer as a notifiable disease to establish a statewide surveillance system?
questions.explanation: Telangana declared cancer a notifiable disease to strengthen its public health monitoring system. This move mandates all healthcare providers, including hospitals and diagnostic labs, to report cancer cases within a month. The initiative aims to create a centralized cancer registry, helping authorities track incidence and prevalence effectively. The Mehdi Nawaz Jung Institute of Oncology in Hyderabad serves as the nodal agency for data validation and coordination. This step enhances early detection, better resource allocation, and supports national-level cancer control strategies through systematic data collection and reporting.

questions.question: Who became the first Indian woman to cycle to the Mount Everest Base Camp?
questions.explanation: Divya Singh created history by becoming the first Indian woman to cycle to the Mount Everest Base Camp. A 28-year-old teacher from Gorakhpur, Uttar Pradesh, she completed this challenging expedition in 14 days. The journey began in Kathmandu and passed through difficult terrains such as Namche Bazaar and Lobuche before reaching the base camp at an altitude of 17,560 feet. Her determination was evident as she carried her bicycle on her shoulders in impassable regions, showcasing resilience, endurance, and inspiring achievement in adventure sports.

questions.question: In which state was the Yoga Mahotsav–2026 organised by the Ministry of Ayush?
questions.explanation: The Yoga Mahotsav–2026 was organized in Maharashtra, specifically at Lonar in the Buldhana district. The event marked the beginning of the 75-day countdown to the International Day of Yoga 2026. It was held at a geologically significant site and witnessed a large gathering performing yoga, even setting a record in the Asia Book of Records. Organised by the Ministry of Ayush through the Morarji Desai National Institute of Yoga, the event also promoted various yoga protocols and campaigns to encourage daily practice and improve public health.

questions.question: In which country is the joint military exercise Cyclone-IV being conducted in April 2026?
questions.explanation: Egypt is hosting the 4th edition of the joint military exercise Cyclone-IV, where the Indian Army Special Forces are participating alongside Egyptian Special Forces. The exercise is being conducted at Anshas from 09 to 17 April 2026 and focuses on enhancing operational coordination in desert and semi-desert environments. It aims to improve interoperability, joint mission planning, and tactical capabilities between the two nations. This bilateral exercise strengthens defence cooperation and strategic ties. Earlier editions were held alternately, with the previous one conducted in India, highlighting the growing military collaboration between both countries.

questions.question: Which organisation released the report titled “From Borrowers to Builders: Women and India’s Evolving Credit Market” in April 2026?
questions.explanation: NITI Aayog released the second edition of the report focusing on women’s participation in India’s evolving credit market. The report highlights significant growth in credit access among women, with total outstanding credit rising to ₹76 lakh crore by 2025. It also emphasizes increased credit penetration, higher participation in commercial lending, and strong regional growth trends in states like Bihar and Uttar Pradesh. Developed in collaboration with organisations such as TransUnion, CIBIL and MicroSave Consulting, the report reflects expanding financial inclusion and the growing role of women in India's formal credit ecosystem.

questions.question: Which Indian Navy sail training ship participated in the ‘Escale à Sete’ maritime festival in France in April 2026?
questions.explanation: INS Sudarshini, a sail training ship of the Indian Navy, took part in the biennial ‘Escale à Sète’ maritime festival held in France. The event marked the 400th anniversary of the French Navy and is considered one of the largest maritime gatherings in the Mediterranean region. During the festival, the ship and its crew participated in various activities, including competitions and cultural exchanges. The Sudarshini rowing team even secured a bronze medal. The ship is also on the Lokayan 26 mission, which aims to strengthen international maritime cooperation and relations.

questions.question: In which city is the second edition of the International SMOPS-2026 conference being held in April 2026?
questions.explanation: The International Conference on Spacecraft Mission Operations (SMOPS-2026) is being conducted in Bangalore from April 8 to 10, 2026. The conference focuses on innovative approaches to spacecraft mission management, including the integration of artificial intelligence and machine learning for autonomous operations. It is jointly organised by ISRO, the Astronautical Society of India, and the International Academy of Astronautics. The event brings together experts from leading global space agencies such as NASA, ESA, and JAXA to discuss advancements in mission design, cybersecurity, and space domain awareness, reinforcing Bangalore’s status as a major hub for space research and technology in India.

questions.question: Which city topped the national pollution index in India for March 2026 as per CREA rankings?
questions.explanation: Gurugram secured the top position as the most polluted city in India for March 2026, according to the Centre for Research on Energy and Clean Air (CREA). It recorded a high monthly average PM2.5 level of 116 µg/m³, indicating hazardous air quality conditions. Haryana had a significant presence in the rankings, contributing several cities among the most polluted. The findings emphasise the ongoing challenges of air pollution in urban and industrial regions. Efforts under the National Clean Air Programme aim to reduce particulate matter levels, but the data highlight the need for stronger implementation and monitoring measures.

questions.question: Which state launched the ‘Majha Gaon, Arogyasampann Gaon’ rural healthcare initiative in April 2026?
questions.explanation: Maharashtra launched the ‘Majha Gaon, Arogyasampann Gaon’ initiative with a budget of ₹65.25 crore to improve rural healthcare delivery. The programme emphasises preventive healthcare, focusing on sanitation, clean drinking water, nutrition, and disease control, including mental health and lifestyle-related illnesses. It adopts a decentralised administrative structure with committees at state, district, and village levels to ensure effective implementation. Villages meeting specific health benchmarks are recognised as ‘Arogyasampann Gaon’. The initiative aligns with the broader objective of enhancing public health infrastructure and awareness, especially in rural areas, marking its launch on World Health Day.

questions.question: What is the name of the new AI model introduced by Meta to power its AI assistant?
questions.explanation: Muse Spark is the latest artificial intelligence model launched by Meta as part of its new Superintelligence Labs initiative. It is designed to power the Meta AI assistant and assist users with a variety of everyday tasks, such as estimating calories from food images, visualising objects in different settings, and answering questions across multiple subjects. Despite being a compact and fast model, it demonstrates the ability to handle complex queries. While it has received mixed feedback from experts regarding performance benchmarks, Meta continues to improve its capabilities and plans to expand its usage across platforms like WhatsApp, Instagram, and Facebook.

questions.question: Which bank launched the AI-powered conversational platform ‘bob SAMVAD’ for multilingual communication in April 2026?
questions.explanation: Bank of Baroda introduced the ‘bob SAMVAD’ platform as an AI-driven solution to enhance customer interaction at its branches. The platform enables real-time communication in 22 languages using advanced features like voice-to-text and text-to-speech conversion. Initially deployed across 250 branches in multiple states, it aims to improve accessibility for customers with diverse linguistic backgrounds. Developed in-house, the system ensures low-latency responses for smooth communication. This initiative reflects the bank’s focus on digital innovation and customer-centric services, strengthening its position as a leading public sector bank in India.

questions.question: In which state is the Kalai-II Hydro Electric Project being constructed on the Lohit River?
questions.explanation: Arunachal Pradesh is the location of the Kalai-II Hydro Electric Project, which has been approved with a significant investment of ₹14,105.83 crore. The project is situated in the Anjaw district on the Lohit River, a major tributary of the Brahmaputra. With a total installed capacity of 1200 MW, it is expected to generate substantial annual energy, contributing to the regional power supply. Implemented through a joint venture between THDC India Limited and the state government, the project also includes infrastructure development like roads and bridges, while providing economic benefits such as free power allocation to the state.

questions.question: Which country launched the world’s first commercial Upper 6GHz (U6GHz) network in April 2026?
questions.explanation: The UAE became the first country to launch a commercial Upper 6GHz (U6GHz) network, marking a major milestone in telecommunications innovation. Operated under the Telecommunications and Digital Government Regulatory Authority (TDRA), the network uses the 6425–7125 MHz spectrum, often referred to as the “Golden Spectrum” due to its optimal balance of coverage and capacity. It delivers ultra-fast 5G-Advanced speeds, including up to 10Gbps downlink and 1Gbps uplink, enabling advanced digital services and AI-driven applications. Developed with global partners like Huawei and Nokia, the rollout highlights the UAE’s leadership in next-generation connectivity.

questions.question: In which city was India’s first Regional Passport Office to launch Braille script and sign language services for differently-abled applicants?
questions.explanation: Bhopal became the first city in India where the Regional Passport Office introduced Braille script and sign language services to enhance accessibility for differently-abled applicants. The initiative includes Braille booklets, signage for visually impaired individuals, and sign language video resources for hearing and speech-impaired users. QR codes have also been integrated for easy digital access to instructions. Additionally, a dedicated grievance redressal system ensures the timely resolution of issues. This step marks a significant advancement in inclusive governance and citizen-centric service delivery within the passport system.

questions.question: Which fintech startup entered the unicorn club in April 2026 after securing $280 million in pre-IPO funding?
questions.explanation: KreditBee achieved unicorn status in April 2026 after raising $280 million in a pre-IPO funding round, reaching a valuation of $1.5 billion. The company has shown strong financial performance, reporting ₹2,700 crore in revenue and ₹473 crore in net profit for FY25. Its Assets Under Management (AUM) grew significantly to ₹15,000 crore in FY26. The funding will support expansion in secured and MSME lending segments. Additionally, the company is preparing for an IPO, including merging its tech and NBFC entities, marking a significant milestone in its growth journey.

questions.question: Which country signed a currency swap agreement with the United Arab Emirates (UAE) valued at AED 20 billion in April 2026?
questions.explanation: Bahrain entered into a currency swap agreement with the United Arab Emirates (UAE) on April 9, 2026, with a total value of AED 20 billion (equivalent to BHD 2 billion). This agreement, set for a five-year period, aims to strengthen financial cooperation between the two nations. It involves the exchange of UAE Dirham and Bahraini Dinar to provide liquidity in local currencies. The initiative supports smoother cross-border trade, encourages the use of national currencies in transactions, and enhances regional monetary stability within the Gulf Cooperation Council framework.

questions.question: On which date is World Homoeopathy Day observed in India to commemorate the birth anniversary of Dr Samuel Hahnemann?
questions.explanation: World Homoeopathy Day is observed annually on April 10 in India to honour the birth anniversary of Dr Samuel Hahnemann, the founder of homoeopathy. The day highlights the importance and contributions of homoeopathy in healthcare. Various events, seminars, and awareness programs are conducted to promote its role in sustainable health. Homoeopathy has a long history in India, dating back to the early 19th century, and is supported by government initiatives such as the National AYUSH Mission to integrate it into mainstream healthcare systems.

questions.question: Who was appointed as the Chairperson of the Nasscom Foundation in April 2026?
questions.explanation: UB Pravin Rao was appointed as the Chairperson of the Nasscom Foundation in April 2026, succeeding Rostow Ravanan. He brings over 35 years of extensive experience in global operations and large-scale transformation. Rao previously served as the Chief Operating Officer (COO) at Infosys from 2014 to 2021. His long association with Nasscom includes roles such as Vice-Chairperson and Chairman. Under his leadership, the foundation is expected to align with the government’s vision of Viksit Bharat, focusing on leveraging technology and ICT initiatives for social development and inclusive growth across India.

questions.question: Which Indian Union Territory includes the Doda region, where a Doppler weather radar and seismological observatory are being established?
questions.explanation: The Doda region is part of Jammu & Kashmir, a Union Territory in northern India characterized by mountainous terrain and high seismic vulnerability, falling under Seismic Zones 4 and 5. Due to its eco-fragile nature, the government is strengthening disaster preparedness by installing a Doppler weather radar for real-time weather monitoring and a seismological observatory for earthquake tracking. These initiatives enhance early warning systems, improve forecasting in remote areas, and contribute to minimising risks associated with natural disasters in the region.

questions.question: Which bank partnered with the Government e-Marketplace (GeM) to provide credit support to sellers under the GeM Sahay initiative?
questions.explanation: Punjab National Bank (PNB) partnered with the Government e-Marketplace (GeM) to enhance credit access for platform sellers through the GeM Sahay initiative. Under this collaboration, PNB provides unsecured short-term loans against confirmed purchase orders generated on the GeM portal. This financing mechanism helps address working capital needs and improves liquidity for Micro, Small, and Medium Enterprises (MSMEs), startups, and other emerging businesses. The initiative also integrates financial services into the digital procurement ecosystem, ensuring the timely execution of government orders and strengthening the overall efficiency of public procurement in India.

questions.question: Where was the 25th Foundation Day of the National Scheduled Tribes Finance and Development Corporation (NSTFDC) celebrated on April 10, 2026?
questions.explanation: The National Scheduled Tribes Finance and Development Corporation (NSTFDC) celebrated its 25th Foundation Day on April 10, 2026, marking its Silver Jubilee year. The event took place at Vishwa Yuva Kendra in New Delhi, which also serves as the headquarters of the organisation. NSTFDC operates under the Ministry of Tribal Affairs and plays a crucial role in providing concessional financial assistance to Scheduled Tribes for income-generating activities. The celebration highlighted the organization’s contributions toward socio-economic development and empowerment of tribal communities across India over the past 25 years.

questions.question: Which company launched the Unit Linked Insurance Plan (ULIP) named Promise4Wealth to offer life insurance and wealth creation solutions?
questions.explanation: Canara HSBC Life Insurance introduced the ULIP product Promise4Wealth to combine life insurance coverage with investment opportunities. The plan offers multiple fund options, including equity, debt, and balanced funds, allowing policyholders to tailor their investments based on risk appetite. It also includes features like a safety switch option to secure gains, loyalty additions to boost returns, and return of mortality charges at maturity. Additionally, flexible withdrawal options such as systematic withdrawal plans and milestone withdrawals help meet financial goals, making it a comprehensive financial planning solution.

questions.question: Which country was elected by acclamation to several subsidiary bodies of the United Nations Economic and Social Council (ECOSOC)?
questions.explanation: India was elected by acclamation to multiple subsidiary bodies of the United Nations Economic and Social Council (ECOSOC), reflecting its growing global influence and active participation in international governance. These bodies include the Commission on Science and Technology for Development and the Committee on Non-Governmental Organisations. Additionally, India secured a position in the Committee for Programme and Coordination for the term 2027–2029. This election highlights India’s commitment to global development, multilateral cooperation, and its role in shaping policies related to science, technology, and social and economic progress worldwide.

questions.question: India signed the Punatsangchhu-II export tariff protocol with which country in April 2026?
questions.explanation: In April 2026, India entered into an agreement with Bhutan to sign the Punatsangchhu-II export tariff protocol and establish a framework for reactive energy accounting. The Punatsangchhu-II hydroelectric project, with a capacity of 1,020 MW, plays a crucial role in bilateral energy cooperation, with Bhutan exporting surplus electricity to India. This agreement strengthens the long-standing partnership between the two countries in the hydropower sector. Additionally, both nations continue to collaborate on other projects such as Punatsangchhu-I, reflecting their shared commitment to sustainable energy development and regional cooperation.

questions.question: Who was appointed as the Managing Director (MD) and Chief Executive Officer (CEO) of the Open Network for Digital Commerce (ONDC) in April 2026?
questions.explanation: Vibhor Jain assumed the role of Managing Director and Chief Executive Officer of the Open Network for Digital Commerce (ONDC) on April 7, 2026. He succeeded Thampy Koshy, who stepped down in April 2025. Before this appointment, Jain served as the Chief Operating Officer and had also taken on responsibilities as acting CEO, demonstrating his leadership within the organisation. ONDC, established as a not-for-profit entity under the Ministry of Commerce and Industry, aims to create an open and interoperable digital commerce ecosystem in India, enhancing accessibility and competition across platforms.

questions.question: Who was appointed as the UT-ORNL Governor’s Chair for Quantum Devices to lead advanced research initiatives?
questions.explanation: Deep Jariwala, an Indian-origin scientist, was appointed as the UT-ORNL Governor’s Chair for Quantum Devices, a prestigious joint position between the University of Tennessee Knoxville and Oak Ridge National Laboratory. This role involves leading cutting-edge research in quantum materials, microelectronics, and computing systems. His work will also focus on optoelectronic systems and advanced device architectures for next-generation sensing technologies. The appointment reflects ongoing efforts to attract global scientific talent and strengthen collaboration between academic and national research institutions in the field of quantum science and technology.

questions.question: What percentage of the Sundarbans mangrove forest has lost its capacity to recover from environmental stress between 2000 and 2024?
questions.explanation: A recent research study published in April 2026 highlights a concerning decline in the resilience of the Sundarbans mangrove ecosystem. It estimates that around 10-15% of the forest has lost its ability to recover effectively from environmental stress over the period from 2000 to 2024. This decline is attributed to multiple factors, including cyclonic disturbances, rising salinity due to reduced freshwater inflow, and human activities like shrimp farming and deforestation. The weakening resilience threatens biodiversity, including key species, and undermines the ecological stability of this critical mangrove habitat.

questions.question: In which Indian state did the CAG audit find that around 160,000 PVTG individuals were excluded from welfare schemes as of March 2024?
questions.explanation: A Comptroller and Auditor General (CAG) audit conducted between July 2024 and January 2025 revealed significant gaps in the implementation of welfare schemes for Particularly Vulnerable Tribal Groups (PVTGs) in Odisha. Despite various initiatives like the Odisha PVTG Empowerment and Livelihood Improvement Programme (OPELIP), about 54% of the PVTG population, roughly 160,000 individuals, remained excluded from benefits. The state has the highest number of PVTGs in India, making such exclusions a major concern. Issues like lack of access in newly identified villages and non-operational agencies contributed to the problem, highlighting administrative and implementation challenges.

questions.question: In which city was Vantara University, dedicated to wildlife conservation and veterinary sciences, launched in April 2026?
questions.explanation: In April 2026, Anant Ambani announced the establishment of Vantara University, a unique global institution focused on wildlife conservation, animal welfare, and veterinary sciences. The university is located in Jamnagar, Gujarat, which is also home to the Vantara wildlife conservation initiative developed by Reliance Industries. This initiative aims to provide advanced education and research opportunities in conservation science. The project draws inspiration from historic centers of learning like Nalanda University, combining ancient ideals of knowledge with modern scientific approaches to address global environmental and wildlife challenges.

questions.question: Which institution won the 6th edition of the international debate competition Hermes’ Dialogue 6.0 held in April 2026?
questions.explanation: The 6th edition of Hermes’ Dialogue 6.0, an international debate competition organised by BIMTECH on April 9, 2026, saw participation from teams representing multiple countries. The competition revolved around the theme of prioritizing energy independence amid geopolitical uncertainty. Team LeBroom from IIM Rohtak secured the first position, outperforming other notable teams such as Team Magnus from FORE School of Management and Team Strategy from SRCC. This achievement highlights IIM Rohtak’s strong presence in academic and debate forums at both national and international levels.

questions.question: In which country were over 200 ancient archaeological sites spanning 6,000 years discovered in the Eretrian plain of Evia in April 2026?
questions.explanation: Greece witnessed a significant archaeological breakthrough in April 2026 with the discovery of over 200 ancient sites in the Eretrian plain of Evia. Using advanced technologies like LiDAR and GIS, researchers mapped around 30 square kilometres, uncovering evidence of continuous human habitation spanning 6,000 years. The sites include ancient farms, quarries, and road networks, reflecting socio-economic development across different historical eras such as the Mycenaean, Roman, and Ottoman periods. This discovery provides valuable insights into long-term settlement patterns and highlights the importance of modern technology in archaeological research.

questions.question: What is the revised economic growth forecast for India for the fiscal year 2026-27 as projected by the World Bank?
questions.explanation: The World Bank revised India’s economic growth forecast for the fiscal year 2026-27 to 6.6%, up from its earlier estimate of 6.3%. This upward revision reflects strong and resilient domestic demand, which continues to support economic expansion despite global uncertainties. India is also expected to grow at a higher rate of 7.6% in 2025-26, reinforcing its position as the primary driver of growth in the South Asian region. While the broader regional outlook shows a slight slowdown, India’s stable performance highlights its economic strength and importance in maintaining regional growth momentum.

questions.question: What was the approximate weight of the simulated Crew Module used in the Second Integrated Air Drop Test (IADT-02) for the Gaganyaan mission?
questions.explanation: The Second Integrated Air Drop Test (IADT-02) conducted by ISRO on April 10, 2026, involved a simulated Crew Module designed for the Gaganyaan mission. The module weighed approximately 5.7 tonnes, which closely matches the mass of the G1 uncrewed mission module. This test was crucial for validating the parachute-based deceleration system, ensuring safe landing during future missions. The module was lifted to an altitude of 3 km using an Indian Air Force Chinook helicopter before being dropped. The successful test confirmed the readiness of critical systems required for India’s first human spaceflight mission.

questions.question: Who was appointed as the Managing Director & Chief Executive Officer of the Indian Digital Payment Intelligence Corporation (IDPIC) in April 2026?
questions.explanation: K. Satyanarayana Raju was appointed as the Managing Director and Chief Executive Officer of the Indian Digital Payment Intelligence Corporation (IDPIC) on April 10, 2026. He brings extensive experience in the banking sector, having previously served as the MD & CEO of Canara Bank and held leadership roles in institutions like BoB Financial Solutions. IDPIC, established in 2025 as a not-for-profit entity, plays a crucial role in strengthening India’s digital payment ecosystem by using artificial intelligence to detect and prevent fraud in real time, thereby enhancing financial security and trust.

questions.question: Who was appointed as the Chairman and Managing Director (CMD) of Bharat Petroleum Corporation Limited (BPCL) effective November 4, 2026?
questions.explanation: Sanjay Khanna assumed the role of Chairman and Managing Director of Bharat Petroleum Corporation Limited (BPCL) effective November 4, 2026.
