questions.question: Which Indian state celebrates its Statehood Day on 1st December and became the 16th state of India in 1963?
questions.explanation: Nagaland celebrates its Statehood Day on 1st December each year, commemorating its recognition as the 16th state of India in 1963 following the enactment of the State of Nagaland Act, 1962. The occasion also marks the beginning of the Hornbill Festival, a major cultural event showcasing the state’s tribal heritage, folk traditions, and indigenous arts. Nagaland’s formation followed years of administrative restructuring and negotiation, culminating in its integration as a full-fledged state. Known for its rich biodiversity, vibrant tribal culture, and scenic landscapes, Nagaland continues to play an important role in promoting ecological conservation and cultural preservation in Northeast India.

questions.question: Who has assumed charge as the Controller Warship Production & Acquisition (CWP&A)?
questions.explanation: Vice Admiral Sanjay Sadhu, a highly experienced naval officer with over 38 years of service, has taken charge as the Controller Warship Production & Acquisition. His extensive career includes significant roles on major Indian Navy ships such as INS Viraat, INS Brahmaputra, and INS Dunagiri, as well as leadership contributions to major acquisition programs like the Vikramaditya and the ATV Program. He succeeds Vice Admiral Rajaram Swaminathan, who oversaw the induction of eight warships during his tenure.

questions.question: In which city was the 60th DGP–IGP Conference 2025 chaired by Prime Minister Narendra Modi?
questions.explanation: The 60th DGP–IGP Conference 2025 was chaired by Prime Minister Narendra Modi in Raipur, the capital city of Chhattisgarh. The event brought together India’s top police leaders, intelligence agencies, and security experts under the broader theme of “Viksit Bharat, Surakshit Bharat.” Held at the IIM campus in Naya Raipur, the conference focused on key issues such as internal security reforms, forensic and technology-driven policing, women’s safety initiatives, and the long-term Vision 2047 roadmap for modernizing Indian policing. The venue underscored Chhattisgarh’s growing significance in national-level security discussions and developmental strategies.

questions.question: How many new Raorchestes bush frog species were recently discovered across North-East India?
questions.explanation: A total of 13 new Raorchestes bush frog species were identified across eight states in North-East India, marking a major advancement in biodiversity research for the region. Arunachal Pradesh contributed six of these discoveries while Meghalaya added three, with the rest spread across other northeastern states. The findings were validated through a combination of DNA analysis, morphological assessments, and bioacoustic studies. Many of the newly documented species were located in ecologically rich areas such as Namdapha, Eaglenest, and Narpuh wildlife sanctuaries. This discovery also highlights the ecological importance of the Raorchestes genus found across mountainous regions of South Asia, Southeast Asia, and southern China.

questions.question: Who has been appointed as the Managing Director and Chief Knowledge Officer of the World Bank Group?
questions.explanation: Paschal Donohoe has been appointed as the Managing Director and Chief Knowledge Officer of the World Bank Group, bringing with him over twenty years of experience across public administration, economic policy, and the private sector. His background includes serving as Ireland’s Minister for Finance and holding the influential role of President of the Eurogroup, where he played a major part in steering EU financial coordination during challenging periods. With additional corporate experience from Procter & Gamble, Donohoe is well-positioned to lead the World Bank’s knowledge initiatives, strengthen global cooperation, and enhance evidence-based solutions for development challenges across emerging and developing economies.

questions.question: In which country was the critically endangered Cuban gar recently documented?
questions.explanation: The critically endangered Cuban gar has been recently documented in Cuba, specifically within the Zapata Swamp, a UNESCO Biosphere Reserve known for its rich yet fragile ecosystem. This predatory fish faces multiple threats including habitat degradation, overfishing, pollution, and the spread of invasive species. One major invasive competitor, the African walking catfish introduced in 1999, has intensified predation and resource competition, accelerating the decline of the Cuban gar. The ecological imbalance caused by invasives poses a severe risk to Cuba’s endemic species, making conservation efforts increasingly urgent.

questions.question: Which airport has become India’s first water-positive airport?
questions.explanation: Indira Gandhi International Airport in Delhi has achieved the distinction of becoming India’s first water-positive airport among facilities handling over 40 million passengers annually. This recognition reflects its ability to replenish more water than it consumes through advanced sustainability initiatives. The airport has installed 625 rainwater harvesting systems, two massive underground reservoirs with a combined storage capacity of 9 million litres, and a highly efficient 16.6 MLD zero-liquid-discharge sewage treatment plant. These efforts enable extensive recycling and reuse of water for operations such as irrigation, HVAC systems, and sanitation. By adopting smart systems and efficient infrastructure, IGI sets a national benchmark for sustainable airport management.

questions.question: In which city did the ISRO Chief inaugurate the Ananth Centre of Excellence for Navigation (ACEN)?
questions.explanation: The Ananth Centre of Excellence for Navigation (ACEN), inaugurated by the ISRO Chief, is located in Thiruvananthapuram. This centre marks India’s first private-sector navigation innovation hub, established to boost indigenous capabilities in navigation technologies. By developing advanced navigation sensors, AI-based fusion systems, and enhancing the use of the NavIC system, ACEN significantly reduces reliance on foreign technologies. It also focuses on conducting maintenance, repair, and overhaul activities within India, strengthening national security and operational readiness. The centre aligns with India’s broader goals of technological independence, innovation, and the Atmanirbhar Bharat mission, supporting future advancements in defence, space, and civilian navigation applications.

questions.question: On which date is World Computer Literacy Day observed globally?
questions.explanation: World Computer Literacy Day is observed every year on December 2 to emphasise the importance of digital education and equitable access to technology. Established in 2001 by NIIT Limited, the day initially aimed at improving computer skills among women and children but has since expanded to over 30 countries. In 2025, its relevance is even more significant due to the increasing dependence on digital platforms for communication, banking, education, and employment. The observance encourages workshops, training programs, and awareness campaigns that help bridge the digital divide and empower people with essential technological skills for personal and economic growth.

questions.question: On which date is the International Day for the Abolition of Slavery observed annually?
questions.explanation: The International Day for the Abolition of Slavery is observed each year on December 2. This date was established by the UN General Assembly in 1986 to reinforce global commitment to ending contemporary forms of slavery, including human trafficking, sexual exploitation, and forced labor. It also commemorates the adoption of the 1949 Convention on the Suppression of Trafficking and Exploitation of Prostitution. Over time, the observance has served as a reminder for nations to strengthen policies, raise awareness, and support victims, contributing to the ongoing global fight to eradicate all forms of slavery.

questions.question: Where was the 50th Anniversary event of the Biological Weapons Convention (BWC) 2025 held?
questions.explanation: The 50th Anniversary event of the Biological Weapons Convention (BWC) 2025 took place in New Delhi, reflecting the growing role of the Global South in global biosecurity discussions. The event’s theme, “Strengthening Biosecurity for the Global South,” emphasised the need for enhanced cooperation, capacity-building, and preparedness among developing nations. The BWC itself is a critical international agreement that prohibits the development, acquisition, stockpiling, transfer, and use of biological and toxin weapons, forming a key pillar of global disarmament efforts. Its foundation traces back to the 1925 Geneva Protocol, making its anniversary a significant milestone for international security.

questions.question: What rank did India achieve in its debut participation at World Skills Asia 2025?
questions.explanation: India secured the 8th rank in its first-ever participation at World Skills Asia 2025, marking a significant milestone in the nation’s skill development journey. The event featured over 500 competitors across 44 different skill categories, creating a vibrant platform for global exchange, collaboration, and showcasing talent. India’s performance included winning one Silver, two Bronze, and three Medallions for Excellence. This achievement was made possible through the efforts of the Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship, NSDC, and WorldSkills India, demonstrating the country’s growing commitment to skill advancement and international competitiveness.

questions.question: On which date is National Pollution Prevention Day observed in India?
questions.explanation: National Pollution Prevention Day is observed every year on December 2 in India to honour the memory of the thousands of people who lost their lives in the 1984 Bhopal Gas Tragedy. The disaster occurred due to the leakage of the toxic chemical Methyl Isocyanate (MIC) from a pesticide plant, making it one of the world’s most devastating industrial pollution incidents. This observance serves as a reminder of the need for strict safety regulations, responsible industrial practices, and heightened public awareness to prevent such tragedies in the future.

questions.question: Who has taken additional charge as the Director General of the Border Security Force (BSF)?
questions.explanation: Chief Praveen Kumar, who currently serves as the Director General of the Indo-Tibetan Border Police (ITBP), has taken additional charge as the Director General of the Border Security Force (BSF). His appointment followed the retirement of Daljit Singh Chawdhary and was formalised through an order issued by the Ministry of Home Affairs. A 1993-batch IPS officer from the West Bengal cadre, Kumar has extensive experience in security operations, including service in the Intelligence Bureau and leadership roles in Naxal-affected regions. His proven expertise is expected to strengthen India’s border management and enhance coordination across security agencies.

questions.question: In which country is Mount Semeru, the active stratovolcano mentioned, located?
questions.explanation: Mount Semeru is situated in Indonesia, a nation recognised for having one of the highest concentrations of active volcanoes in the world—over 120 in total. This is due to its position along major tectonic plate boundaries, including the Indo-Australian and Sunda Plates, which contribute to frequent seismic and volcanic activity. As part of the Pacific Ring of Fire, Indonesia experiences continuous geological dynamism. Mount Semeru, the tallest peak in Java at 3,676 meters, exemplifies this active landscape. Its periodic eruptions impact nearby communities, making its monitoring crucial for disaster preparedness and regional safety.

questions.question: Who has assumed the position of Director General (Inspection & Safety) of the Indian Air Force on 01 December 2025?
questions.explanation: Air Marshal Tejbir Singh has taken over as the Director General (Inspection & Safety) of the Indian Air Force, bringing with him nearly four decades of rich experience. His 37-year career includes significant command and staff appointments, such as Air Attaché to Bangladesh and Senior Directing Staff at the National Defence College. With over 7000 flying hours and a key role in inducting the C-130J ‘Super Hercules’ into IAF operations, he has contributed extensively to operational capability and training reforms. His leadership is further distinguished by prestigious honours, including the Vayu Sena Medal and the Ati Vishisht Seva Medal.

questions.question: Which organisation successfully tested the high-speed indigenous fighter jet escape system?
questions.explanation: DRDO successfully carried out a high-speed rocket-sled trial of an indigenous fighter jet escape system at the Rail Track Rocket Sled facility in Chandigarh. This system is crucial for safeguarding pilots during emergencies, and the test validated essential components such as canopy separation, ejection sequencing, and safe recovery. The trial involved collaboration with HAL and ADA, reinforcing the coordinated effort behind India’s aviation safety advancements. Dynamic tests like these replicate real-world flight conditions more accurately than static trials, enabling engineers to ensure the system’s reliability. The achievement strengthens India’s defence self-reliance and places the country among a select group capable of testing such advanced escape technologies.

questions.question: Which telecom operator has partnered with NHAI to deploy a safety alert system for highways?
questions.explanation: Jio has partnered with NHAI to introduce a telecom-based highway safety alert system designed to improve real-time communication for road users. The system will send warnings through SMS, WhatsApp, or voice calls about accident-prone areas, fog-affected stretches, and cattle-frequent zones. Using Jio’s existing 4G and 5G infrastructure, the initiative avoids the need for additional roadside hardware, making it efficient and quickly scalable. It also integrates seamlessly with platforms such as Rajmargyatra and the 1033 emergency helpline. A pilot is being launched in select regions, with an ambition to expand nationwide by including more telecom operators for broader coverage.

questions.question: Which country approved an agreement allowing Russia to establish its first-ever naval base on African soil?
questions.explanation: Sudan granted Russia permission to establish its first naval base on the African continent, marking a significant geopolitical shift in the Red Sea region. The base, positioned near Port Sudan, gives Russia strategic access to one of the world’s most crucial maritime corridors, connecting the Red Sea to the Suez Canal—an area handling nearly 12% of global shipping. The agreement allows Russia to station personnel, deploy naval vessels including nuclear-powered ships, and maintain a long-term presence through a 25-year pact with automatic renewals. Despite Sudan’s internal political instability, both nations view the arrangement as mutually advantageous for military cooperation and regional influence.

questions.question: Which bank appointed Harmanpreet Kaur as its first-ever female brand ambassador?
questions.explanation: Punjab National Bank selected Harmanpreet Kaur, captain of the Indian women’s cricket team, as its first female brand ambassador, marking a significant milestone in the bank’s branding and customer outreach efforts. The announcement was made at the bank’s New Delhi corporate office during an event symbolically titled “Banking On Champions.” Senior leadership attended the ceremony, highlighting the importance of the collaboration. Harmanpreet unveiled several new products, including PNB’s first metal credit card, an upgraded digital platform, and initiatives promoting solar solutions and bullion trading. This partnership reflects PNB’s broader focus on empowerment, modernisation, and innovation-driven financial services.

questions.question: Where has the BSF begun deploying its new anti-tunnelling system to curb cross-border smuggling and infiltration?
questions.explanation: The anti-tunnelling system has been deployed along the Punjab–Jammu Border, an area known for challenges such as weapon and drug smuggling, as well as attempts at terrorist infiltration. The system’s ability to generate real-time alerts strengthens surveillance and enhances the BSF’s operational effectiveness. This deployment forms part of a broader security strategy demonstrated during the BSF’s Diamond Jubilee, which highlighted several major operations, including anti-drone measures, large-scale seizures, and the arrest of intruders. By integrating advanced detection technologies, the BSF aims to create a more secure and better-monitored border environment.

questions.question: Who assumed charge as LIC’s Managing Director on December 1, 2025?
questions.explanation: Ramakrishnan Chander took over as the Managing Director of LIC, bringing with him decades of experience since joining the organisation in 1990. Over the years, he has contributed to several major segments including marketing, pensions, and group schemes, which helped shape his leadership abilities. LIC, being India’s largest insurer and its most influential institutional investor, plays a crucial role in the nation’s financial ecosystem. With its headquarters in Mumbai and administrative oversight under the Ministry of Finance, the organisation continues to be significant in the insurance and investment landscape, making leadership transitions like this highly noteworthy.

questions.question: By what percentage did India’s FDI inflow increase in the first half of FY 2025-26 compared to the previous year?
questions.explanation: The FDI inflow during the first half of FY 2025-26 reached $50.36 billion, marking a 16% increase over the $43.37 billion received in the same period the previous year. This growth represents the highest-ever FDI recorded for the first half of any fiscal year in India. Alongside this rise, the government also pointed to stronger repatriation patterns, an increase in outward direct investment, and the expansion of India’s network of free trade and preferential trade agreements. Major pacts such as the EFTA agreement, which promises large investment commitments and job creation, further reflect the country’s expanding global economic engagement.

questions.question: Which country is participating with India in the joint military exercise ‘Ekuverin’ held in Kerala?
questions.explanation: The ‘Ekuverin’ exercise involves military personnel from India and the Maldives, reflecting a long-standing defence partnership built over years of collaboration. This edition includes 45 participants from India’s Garhwal Rifles and an equal number from the Maldives National Defence Force, working together to strengthen coordination in counter-insurgency and counter-terrorism operations. The training covers diverse terrains such as jungles, semi-urban zones, and coastal regions. Conducted alternately in both countries since 2009, the exercise highlights mutual trust, operational cooperation, and India’s continued commitment to its “Neighbourhood First” policy, ensuring regional stability and stronger bilateral ties.

questions.question: On which date is the International Day of Persons with Disabilities observed each year?
questions.explanation: The International Day of Persons with Disabilities is observed annually on December 3, a date dedicated to promoting equality, dignity, and opportunities for persons with disabilities across the world. The focus of the 2025 observance is on fostering disability-inclusive societies, underscoring that genuine social progress cannot be achieved without ensuring full participation of persons with disabilities in all aspects of life. The day encourages reflection on longstanding challenges such as poverty, employment discrimination, limited social protection, and lack of accessible care systems. It also highlights global efforts like the UN Disability Inclusion Strategy, which seeks to integrate disability rights into every level of UN action and policymaking.

questions.question: What was the year-on-year growth percentage recorded in Aadhaar authentications in November 2025?
questions.explanation: The figure 8.5% represents the year-on-year growth in Aadhaar authentications during November 2025, marking the highest monthly authentication volume of the fiscal year at 231 crore. This growth reflects the increasing reliance on Aadhaar-based digital infrastructure across various sectors. A major factor in this surge was the rapid adoption of face authentication, which accounted for nearly 60% of pensioners’ Digital Life Certificates, demonstrating how technology is aiding service delivery. Additionally, the rise in e-KYC usage to 47.19 crore transactions underlines Aadhaar’s expanding role in banking and financial services, further contributing to the overall growth momentum.

questions.question: Which Indian state added five new products to its Geographical Indications (GI) portfolio, taking its total to 74?
questions.explanation: Tamil Nadu has expanded its GI portfolio to 74 by securing GI tags for five culturally significant products—Woraiyur cotton sari, Kavindapadi jaggery powder, Namakkal soapstone cookware, Thooyamalli rice, and Ambasamudram wooden toys. Each of these products reflects the state’s deep-rooted heritage across textiles, agriculture, traditional crafts, and artisanal skills. GI recognition plays a crucial role in protecting unique regional identities, enhancing market value, and supporting rural livelihoods. By obtaining these tags, Tamil Nadu strengthens its position as one of India’s leading states in preserving traditional knowledge, promoting cultural diversity, and empowering artisan and farmer communities through legal and economic recognition.

questions.question: Who has been appointed as the new Executive Director of the Reserve Bank of India effective December 1, 2025?
questions.explanation: Usha Janakiraman has taken charge as the Executive Director of the Reserve Bank of India, bringing with her more than thirty years of diverse experience within the central bank. Her background spans crucial departments such as regulation, public debt management, external investments, banking supervision, and currency management. This broad exposure equips her to lead the Department of Supervision, where she will focus on strengthening risk assessment, analytical frameworks, and vulnerability evaluation across regulated financial entities. Her appointment reflects RBI’s continuous effort to bolster supervisory systems, enhance risk governance, and adopt data-driven regulatory strategies, making this update especially important for those preparing for banking and regulatory examinations.

questions.question: Where was the CII IndiaEdge 2025 Industry Forum on Reforms & Sustainable Growth held?
questions.explanation: The CII IndiaEdge 2025 Industry Forum on Reforms & Sustainable Growth took place in New Delhi, bringing together key industry leaders, policymakers and experts to discuss a wide range of reforms essential for the country’s economic progress. The discussions focused on labour reforms, sustainable growth initiatives, and measures to boost competitiveness across vital sectors. Ministers Mansukh Mandaviya and Bhupender Yadav emphasised the significance of new labour codes, social security expansion and gig-worker welfare. Additionally, the forum highlighted the importance of tourism, skill development and modernisation as drivers of employment and long-term economic resilience.

questions.question: In which regions has Bharat Taxi begun its pilot trials?
questions.explanation: Bharat Taxi has initiated its pilot trials in Delhi and Gujarat as part of a transformative shift toward a cooperative, driver-owned ride-hailing model. Supported by the Union Ministry of Cooperation and National e-Governance Division, the platform aims to create an alternative to conventional aggregators by offering zero-commission earnings, no-surge transparent pricing, and democratic participation for drivers, who are recognised as stakeholders rather than just service providers. The early trials include beta testing of the mobile app, rapid onboarding of over 51,000 drivers, and active operations in Delhi and the Saurashtra region. These efforts mark an important step in promoting cooperative-driven digital platforms under the “Sahakar Se Samriddhi” vision.

questions.question: When is the International Day Against Unilateral Coercive Measures observed?
questions.explanation: The International Day Against Unilateral Coercive Measures is observed on December 4, following a resolution adopted by the UN General Assembly in June 2025. The day draws global attention to the negative humanitarian, economic, and legal impacts of unilateral sanctions imposed by one state on another outside the mandate of international law and the UN Charter. Such measures—whether trade embargoes, asset freezes, or financial restrictions—can severely affect access to essential services like healthcare, food, and housing, especially in developing nations. By recognizing this day, the international community aims to promote multilateral dialogue, uphold human rights, protect state sovereignty, and discourage coercive economic practices that undermine global peace and equitable development.

questions.question: Which international space agency partnered with ISRO to develop the NISAR satellite?
questions.explanation: NASA collaborated with ISRO to jointly develop the NISAR satellite, a pioneering Earth-observation mission designed to capture high-quality polarimetric and interferometric data using advanced microwave imaging in both L-band and S-band. With a mission life of five years, it is engineered to study critical environmental aspects such as land and ice erosion, land ecosystems, and marine regions. The mission supports research areas of mutual importance to the United States and India, enabling scientists from both nations to better understand planetary changes, natural hazards, and climate-related transformations through continuous, global-scale monitoring.

questions.question: In which city was the Regional AI Impact Conference 2025 held?
questions.explanation: The Regional AI Impact Conference 2025 took place in Shillong, Meghalaya, as part of a nationwide series of events leading up to the India–AI Impact Summit 2026. The conference focused on expanding AI access across India through the IndiaAI Mission, which has invested over ₹10,300 crore to build AI infrastructure, including onboarding 38,000 GPUs and establishing more than 600 AI and data labs across the country. Shillong’s selection underscores the government’s commitment to decentralizing AI development and ensuring that regions like the Northeast benefit from enhanced computing resources, skill-development initiatives, and emerging AI-driven opportunities.

questions.question: Which bank, along with SBI, signed an MoU to collaborate on a Centre of Excellence in Strategic Partnership for project financing?
questions.explanation: Bank of India partnered with the State Bank of India to establish a Centre of Excellence in Strategic Partnership aimed at strengthening project financing capabilities. This collaboration is designed to enhance leadership, innovation and coordinated expertise in financing large-scale projects across sectors. By combining resources and focusing on teamwork, the two institutions aim to improve strategic decision-making and create more efficient frameworks for evaluating and supporting major developmental initiatives. The partnership underscores the growing need for robust financial mechanisms in infrastructure development and highlights the important role that collaborative banking models can play in advancing national economic growth.

questions.question: When is Indian Navy Day observed?
questions.explanation: Indian Navy Day is observed on December 4 to honour the heroic achievements of the Indian Navy, particularly the success of Operation Trident during the 1971 Indo-Pakistan War. On this day, Indian missile boats launched a decisive attack that neutralised significant Pakistani naval assets, marking a major strategic victory. The 2025 celebrations are being held in Thiruvananthapuram, featuring a large maritime demonstration at Shankhumukham, with the presence of President Droupadi Murmu and Navy Chief Admiral Tripathi. The observance also reflects the Navy’s ethos and commitment, symbolised by its motto “Shaṁ No Varunaḥ,” invoking the protection of the sea god Varuna.

questions.question: Who has been appointed as the new Chairman of HSBC, succeeding Mark Tucker?
questions.explanation: Brendan Nelson has been appointed as the new Chairman of HSBC, succeeding Mark Tucker, who stepped down after an impactful eight-year tenure. Nelson, who had been serving as interim chairman since October 2025, brings extensive experience in financial auditing and governance from his earlier senior roles at KPMG. His appointment signals a return to internal board leadership for the bank. As chairman, he will work closely with CEO Georges Elhedery to strengthen HSBC’s Asia-first strategic focus, navigate evolving geopolitical and financial challenges, and oversee governance until a new Audit Committee chair is appointed following the release of HSBC’s 2025 financial results.

questions.question: Which mobile security and anti-fraud application was at the center of the withdrawn mandatory pre-installation directive?
questions.explanation: Sanchar Saathi was the application involved in the government’s withdrawn directive that initially required smartphone manufacturers to pre-install it on all devices. Developed by the Department of Telecommunications, the app is designed to combat cyber fraud, mobile theft, SIM-related misuse, and unauthorised connections. Despite its strong security benefits—such as tracing stolen phones, disconnecting fraudulent mobile connections, and blocking scam attempts—the mandatory installation raised widespread concerns regarding privacy, potential snooping, and lack of stakeholder consultation. As a result, the government opted for a voluntary model, reinforcing its commitment to user choice, transparency, and safeguarding digital rights while continuing to promote cybersecurity awareness.

questions.question: Who recently assumed charge as the Railway Board Member (Finance)?
questions.explanation: Aparna Garg, a seasoned IRAS officer from the 1987 batch, has taken charge as the Member (Finance) of the Railway Board. With more than 36 years of experience, she has served in several key roles such as Divisional Railway Manager at Mysore, Chief Financial Advisor at the Rail Wheel Factory, and Director General of IRIFM. She is also a Chevening Fellow with an Advanced Master’s degree in Transport Economics and executive training from reputed global institutions. Her extensive background and leadership capabilities have made her well-suited for this prestigious position.

questions.question: On which date is International Cheetah Day observed?
questions.explanation: International Cheetah Day is observed on December 4 to highlight the urgent need for global cheetah conservation. With an estimated population of only around 7,100 remaining in the wild, the species faces significant threats such as habitat loss, human–wildlife conflict and declining prey base. The observance began in 2010, initiated by Dr. Laurie Marker, whose work with Khayam — a cheetah she trained for rewilding in Namibia — inspired the movement. The day also aligns with broader conservation initiatives, such as the International Big Cat Alliance launched by India in 2023, aimed at safeguarding major big cat species worldwide.

questions.question: Which global technology company collaborated with NITI Aayog to launch a national roadmap aimed at making India a top-3 quantum economy by 2047?
questions.explanation: The roadmap reflects a strategic partnership in which IBM plays a central role in guiding India’s long-term quantum ambitions. With its expertise in quantum hardware, software, and research ecosystems, IBM contributes significantly to shaping pathways for indigenous capability building, talent development, and large-scale deployment of quantum technologies. The collaboration strengthens India’s efforts to expand quantum applications across defence, healthcare, logistics, finance, and energy. By combining IBM’s global experience with India’s research strengths and policy support, the initiative is designed to help the country achieve global competitiveness and emerge as a top-3 quantum economy by 2047.

questions.question: In which city is Australia’s Victoria University planning to open its first India campus by 2026?
questions.explanation: Australia’s Victoria University is set to open its first Indian campus in Gurugram, a major city in the Delhi NCR region known for its expanding educational and technological infrastructure. This development marks a significant milestone under India’s National Education Policy reforms, which now allow top foreign universities to establish campuses in the country. The Gurugram campus, expected to be operational by mid-2026, will offer globally aligned programs in Business, Information Technology, and Research. By bringing its unique Block Model of teaching to India, the university aims to provide high-quality, affordable international education, reduce overseas expenses for students, and strengthen India’s global academic collaborations.

questions.question: What is Fitch Ratings’ revised GDP growth forecast for India for FY26?
questions.explanation: Fitch Ratings has upgraded India’s GDP growth forecast for FY26 to 7.4%, reflecting strong consumer demand, rising confidence, and the positive impact of GST reforms. This revision follows India’s impressive 8.2% growth in the second quarter of FY26, which marked the fastest expansion in six quarters. The updated forecast indicates a more robust economic outlook driven primarily by private consumption. Fitch also noted a narrowing gap between nominal and real GDP due to stable inflation levels, making the growth more sustainable. While momentum may moderate later due to base effects, the 7.4% projection underscores India’s strong economic fundamentals.

questions.question: Which organization holds a 51% stake in the joint venture that forms TOKIO General Insurance Company?
questions.explanation: IFFCO-TOKIO General Insurance Company is a long-standing joint venture created in 2000, where the Indian Farmers Fertilizer Cooperative (IFFCO) holds a majority stake of 51%, partnered with Japan’s Tokio Marine Group, which owns the remaining 49%. The organization has focused on making insurance affordable and accessible since its inception. On its 25th anniversary, it expanded this mission by collaborating with cooperatives to distribute micro insurance products to underserved communities. This approach supports IRDAI’s ‘Insurance for All by 2047’ goal by improving insurance penetration in rural and semi-urban regions, leveraging cooperative networks to increase awareness, coverage, and financial protection for low-income groups.

questions.question: Who became the third cricketer to take 600 competitive T20 wickets?
questions.explanation: Sunil Narine achieved a remarkable milestone by becoming the third cricketer ever to reach 600 competitive T20 wickets, a feat accomplished while playing in the ILT20 for the Abu Dhabi Knight Riders. He reached this landmark during a match against the Sharjah Warriorz in Abu Dhabi. To commemorate his extraordinary achievement, his team presented him with a special jersey featuring the number “600.” This accomplishment highlights his long-standing impact in global T20 cricket, his mastery as a bowler, and his consistent ability to deliver breakthroughs across leagues around the world.

questions.question: Which organization, along with Hitachi MGRM Net, launched the MStar Global AI Connect platform?
questions.explanation: Atal Innovation Mission partnered with Hitachi MGRM Net to develop the MStar Global AI Connect platform, an initiative aimed at boosting nationwide innovation. The platform is designed to connect schools, mentors, incubators, and industry stakeholders, enabling a seamless pipeline from school-level creativity to startup ecosystems and further into market-ready innovations. By facilitating these linkages, the initiative aims to foster large-scale entrepreneurship, fuel technological advancements, and support the broader goal of transforming India into a developed nation. The focus on collaboration makes AIM a central driver in nurturing the next generation of innovators.

questions.question: On which date is International Volunteer Day 2025 celebrated?
questions.explanation: International Volunteer Day 2025 is observed on December 5, a date dedicated to honouring the contributions of volunteers worldwide and their impact on sustainable development. The 2025 celebration carries added significance as it launches the International Year of Volunteers for Sustainable Development (IVY 2026), a global initiative proclaimed by the UN General Assembly. The day underscores the importance of volunteers of all ages, backgrounds, and skill levels, emphasizing that every contribution has the potential to create meaningful change. Events across countries, including the global launch at the UN General Assembly Hall, highlight volunteerism’s role in strengthening communities and advancing development goals.

questions.question: Who received the National Award for Individual Excellence for innovation in disability empowerment?
questions.explanation: Prateek Madhav, Co-Founder and CEO of the Assistive Technology Foundation (ATF), was honoured with the National Award for Individual Excellence by the Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities under the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment. The award was presented by President Droupadi Murmu, recognizing his impactful contributions to the assistive technology landscape in India. His efforts have enabled over one million persons with disabilities by strengthening the AT ecosystem, supporting more than 500 assistive technology startups, and accelerating numerous ventures focused on inclusion. This recognition highlights his dedication to advancing disability empowerment on a national scale.

questions.question: Who became the first three-time winner of the Indian Golf Premier League (IGPL) Tour?
questions.explanation: Gaganjeet Bhullar secured his record third IGPL Tour title with an impressive overall score of 11-under, demonstrating exceptional consistency across four rounds. His performance included rounds of 71, 67, and 67, highlighted by a remarkable hole-in-one that boosted his lead. Despite a strong challenge from rising golfer Raghav Chugh, who finished just one stroke behind, Bhullar’s composed and high-quality play in the final stages ensured his historic victory. Achieving this milestone in Ahmedabad reinforces his status as one of India’s most accomplished professional golfers and underscores his dominance in the IGPL.

questions.question: On which date is World Soil Day 2025 observed?
questions.explanation: World Soil Day 2025 is observed on December 5, a day dedicated to raising global awareness about the crucial role of soils in sustaining life and supporting healthy ecosystems. The 2025 theme, “Healthy Soils for Healthy Cities,” emphasizes the importance of urban soils and encourages governments, planners, communities, and citizens to recognize how soil health influences resilience, sustainability, and overall urban well-being. The observance highlights soil’s role in food production, water regulation, climate mitigation, and environmental stability. It also calls for better soil management practices and urges cities to adopt green, soil-friendly infrastructure to build more sustainable and livable urban environments.

questions.question: In which city was the 3rd RESOLVE–2025 international insolvency convention organized by the ICAI?
questions.explanation: The 3rd RESOLVE–2025 international convention on insolvency resolution and valuation was organized by the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India in Mumbai. This event brought together more than 40 speakers across 19 sessions and attracted over 500 participants, making it one of the largest gatherings in India focused on insolvency, resolution, and valuation. The convention emphasized global best practices, future strategies, and the theme of enabling resolution while maximizing value. Hosting the event in Mumbai, a major financial hub, provided an ideal environment for professionals and experts to collaborate, exchange insights, and strengthen the insolvency ecosystem.

questions.question: Which organisation released the first clinical guideline for GLP-1 drugs for chronic obesity management?
questions.explanation: WHO introduced its first clinical guideline for the use of GLP-1 medications such as semaglutide and tirzepatide to support long-term obesity management. These medicines, added to the Essential Medicines List in 2025, are recommended alongside lifestyle interventions that include dietary improvements, increased physical activity, and sustained medical follow-up. WHO advised caution regarding the use of these drugs during pregnancy due to insufficient data. With over one billion people worldwide affected by obesity and millions of deaths occurring annually, the guideline aims to provide structured, evidence-based global direction for managing this growing public health challenge.

questions.question: Which company signed an MoU with NTPC Mining Limited to jointly explore copper and critical mineral projects?
questions.explanation: Hindustan Copper Ltd entered into a strategic partnership with NTPC Mining Limited to advance the exploration and development of copper and other critical mineral resources. This collaboration is designed to enhance India’s resource and energy security by promoting joint investments in mining, processing, and related technological capabilities. As global demand for critical minerals grows due to their importance in renewable energy, electric mobility, and advanced manufacturing, such alliances help position India to meet future industrial requirements. The agreement, signed in Kolkata in the presence of senior leadership from both organizations, marks a significant step toward strengthening domestic mineral self-reliance.

questions.question: Which state has mandated thermal power plants to co-fire 5–7% bamboo biomass or charcoal as part of its 2025 Bamboo Industry Policy?
questions.explanation: Maharashtra has introduced a significant policy requiring all thermal power plants in the state to co-fire 5–7% bamboo biomass or charcoal. This initiative is part of the 2025 Bamboo Industry Policy, which aims to reduce carbon emissions, diversify the state’s energy mix, and promote sustainable alternatives to traditional fuels. Backed by substantial financial commitments, including a ₹1,534 crore plan for 2025–30 and long-term incentives worth ₹11,797 crore, the policy supports the development of bamboo markets and rural employment. Bamboo, known for its rapid growth and carbon absorption capabilities, is being positioned as a key driver of green energy transition and decarbonisation efforts.

questions.question: In which country has India set up a fully operational field hospital under Operation Sagar Bandhu?
questions.explanation: India set up a fully equipped field hospital in Mahiyanganaya, Sri Lanka, to provide trauma care and emergency medical support following the devastation caused by Cyclone Ditwah. The deployment included a 25-member Indian team comprising medical professionals and engineers, ensuring both healthcare delivery and assistance in restoring essential connectivity. Indian Air Force C-17 aircraft also transported Bailey bridges to support infrastructure rehabilitation. This initiative demonstrates India’s commitment to regional humanitarian aid, strengthening bilateral ties while responding swiftly to urgent rescue and relief requirements in a neighbouring country experiencing significant casualties and ongoing distress.

questions.question: Who has become both an investor and global brand ambassador for Perplexity AI?
questions.explanation: Cristiano Ronaldo has taken on a dual role as both an investor and global brand ambassador for Perplexity AI, strengthening his presence in the technology and innovation space. As part of this collaboration, he introduced the Ronaldo Hub, an AI-powered personalised fan platform offering exclusive photos, career insights, and interactive content. His involvement boosts Perplexity’s global visibility as it positions itself as a next-generation AI search and assistant platform competing with major players. Ronaldo’s influence, worldwide recognition, and strong fan following further help expand the platform’s reach and impact in the tech sector.

questions.question: Which country is partnering with India in the Harimau Shakti 2025 military exercise held in Rajasthan?
questions.explanation: Malaysia is participating with India in the Harimau Shakti 2025 military exercise, marking the fifth edition of this bilateral defence engagement. Conducted at the Mahajan Field Firing Range in Rajasthan, the exercise involves the Dogra Regiment of the Indian Army and the 25th Royal Malaysian Army. Their joint training focuses on counter-terrorism operations such as cordon-and-search drills, heliborne missions, and casualty evacuation techniques. The exercise aims to strengthen interoperability, enhance the exchange of tactical knowledge, and deepen defence cooperation between the two nations. This collaboration contributes to regional stability and reinforces long-term strategic ties.

questions.question: Which organization signed an MoU with Sagarmala Finance Corporation Ltd to boost financial support for India’s maritime manufacturing sector?
questions.explanation: BEML entered into a significant partnership with Sagarmala Finance Corporation Ltd to strengthen India’s maritime manufacturing capabilities. The collaboration aims to unlock dedicated financial support that can enhance domestic production and decrease reliance on imports. This move is aligned with national efforts to build a robust maritime ecosystem backed by advanced technology and sustainable financing. Additionally, a separate tripartite MoU involving HD Korea Shipbuilding and HD Hyundai Samho focuses on developing next-generation cranes, further contributing to the modernization of India’s maritime infrastructure. The combined agreements are expected to create long-term benefits for the sector.

questions.question: By how much did the MPC reduce the repo rate to bring it down to 5.25%?
questions.explanation: The Monetary Policy Committee reduced the repo rate by 25 basis points, bringing it down to 5.25%. This rate cut comes at a time when inflation has eased significantly to 2.2% and GDP growth in Q2 has reached a robust 8%, creating a favourable economic environment often described as a “goldilocks” phase. With retail inflation remaining below 4% for several months, the RBI aims to support economic activity while ensuring price stability. Additionally, planned liquidity measures such as ₹1 lakh crore OMO purchases and a $5 billion USD/INR swap are expected to maintain adequate liquidity in the financial system.

questions.question: Which organization, alongside Northern Coalfields Ltd, contributed funds for upgrading Eklavya Model Residential Schools, specifically sanctioning ₹73 lakh for five schools in Arunachal Pradesh?
questions.explanation: Oil India Ltd played a key role in supporting the enhancement of tribal education by sanctioning ₹73 lakh for upgrading five Eklavya Model Residential Schools in Arunachal Pradesh. This contribution forms part of a broader initiative aimed at improving digital learning facilities, skill development opportunities, and essential infrastructure in tribal residential schools across India. Alongside this, Northern Coalfields Ltd provided substantial funding for similar improvements in Uttar Pradesh and Madhya Pradesh. The combined efforts of these organizations help strengthen the government’s mission to ensure quality education, modern facilities, and better opportunities for tribal students nationwide.

questions.question: Which Indian company was recognised in the 2025 Global Top 100 Corporate Startup Stars list by ICC and Mind the Bridge?
questions.explanation: Bharat Petroleum Corporation Ltd earned a distinguished position in the 2025 Global Top 100 Corporate Startup Stars list, making it the only Indian company to receive this honour. The recognition highlights the company’s strong commitment to innovation through its Ankur initiative, which actively supports around 30 startups working in clean technology, smart solutions, and sustainable energy. This achievement demonstrates BPCL’s strategic focus on fostering an open innovation culture, encouraging collaboration with emerging ventures, and accelerating technological advancements. Being acknowledged in Paris on a global stage underscores BPCL’s growing influence and leadership in promoting forward-looking, environmentally responsible business practices.

questions.question: Who has been appointed as the new Chief Medical Officer of the National Comprehensive Cancer Network (NCCN)?
questions.explanation: The National Comprehensive Cancer Network announced a major leadership change with the appointment of Dr Renuka Iyer as its new Chief Medical Officer. She brings over two decades of experience in oncology, clinical research, and academic medicine, particularly in the field of gastrointestinal cancers. Her background includes significant contributions to cancer guideline development, immunotherapy research, and evidence-based practice. As CMO, she will guide the development and updating of NCCN’s widely used clinical practice guidelines, oversee educational initiatives, and support global collaborations aimed at improving cancer care standards. Her expertise positions her to play a central role in advancing NCCN’s mission worldwide.

questions.question: Which payments bank became the first to receive RBI’s in-principle approval to convert into a Small Finance Bank (SFB)?
questions.explanation: Fino Payments Bank achieved a major milestone by becoming the first payments bank in India to secure the Reserve Bank of India’s in-principle approval to transition into a Small Finance Bank. This approval allows it to overcome the limitations of the payments bank model, such as the inability to lend or accept deposits above ₹2 lakh. By moving toward SFB status, Fino can expand its services, enter the lending market, and serve a broader range of customers, especially in underserved and rural regions. The shift is expected to enhance financial inclusion while strengthening Fino’s long-term growth, competitiveness, and operational capabilities.

questions.question: Which state launched the upgraded e-Swathu 2.0 digital platform for rural property regularisation and online e-khata services?
questions.explanation: Karnataka introduced e-Swathu 2.0 as a major step toward digitising rural property records and improving service delivery across gram panchayats. The platform aims to regularise around 95 lakh rural properties by bringing them under the tax framework, which is expected to generate up to ₹2,000 crore in additional revenue for the state. It simplifies access to property documents such as e-khata Forms 11A and 11B, eliminates the need for villagers to visit panchayat offices, and provides support through dedicated helplines and Bapuji Centres. The initiative reflects Karnataka’s push for transparency, efficiency, and rural empowerment through digital governance.

questions.question: When is Armed Forces Flag Day 2025 observed in India?
questions.explanation: Armed Forces Flag Day is observed every year on December 7 to honour the courage, dedication, and sacrifices of India’s military personnel. The day serves as a powerful reminder of the responsibility citizens share in supporting both serving soldiers and veterans, including war widows, disabled soldiers, and families of martyrs. It is also an occasion to raise funds for the Armed Forces Flag Day Fund, which provides medical care, rehabilitation, education, and welfare assistance. Through contributions, symbolic flag distributions, and awareness activities, the day strengthens national unity and expresses collective gratitude to those who safeguard the nation.

questions.question: Which company agreed to acquire Warner Bros Discovery’s studios and streaming business in a $72 billion deal?
questions.explanation: Netflix secured a landmark $72 billion agreement to acquire Warner Bros Discovery’s studios and streaming operations, marking one of the most transformative deals in entertainment history. By winning a competitive bidding battle against major rivals, Netflix gains control of world-renowned franchises such as Game of Thrones, DC Comics, and the Harry Potter universe. This acquisition strengthens its shift from a content-licensing platform to an integrated studio powerhouse with global production capabilities. The move also expands Netflix’s subscriber ecosystem by integrating HBO Max’s massive user base, positioning the company to further dominate the streaming market while navigating anticipated regulatory scrutiny in the U.S. and Europe.

questions.question: Which country won its first-ever Sultan Azlan Shah Cup title in 2025 by defeating India 1-0 in the final?
questions.explanation: Belgium secured its maiden Sultan Azlan Shah Cup title in 2025 with a narrow 1-0 victory over India in the final held in Ipoh, Malaysia. The match was tightly contested, with Belgium creating more scoring opportunities and taking the lead through a goal by Thibeau Stockbroekx in the 34th minute. India fought hard until the final whistle, supported by strong goalkeeping efforts, but could not find an equaliser. This victory marked a historic milestone for Belgium, especially considering it was only their second appearance in the tournament, showcasing their rapid progress in world hockey.

questions.question: Who has been appointed as the next director of Mossad, set to assume the role in June 2026?
questions.explanation: Roman Gofman has been selected to lead Mossad during a period of heightened regional tensions and evolving security challenges. A seasoned military commander, he has held key leadership positions within the Israel Defense Forces, including command roles across multiple regions and service as military secretary to the Prime Minister. His operational experience, resilience after being wounded during the 2023 Hamas attack, and close involvement in strategic decision-making contributed to his selection. His appointment represents a rare shift from traditional intelligence leadership to a military-rooted command, signalling Israel’s intent to strengthen operational readiness and reorganise intelligence priorities for emerging threats.

questions.question: Where will India host the 20th session of the UNESCO Inter-governmental Committee for the Safeguarding of the Intangible Cultural Heritage in December 2025?
questions.explanation: The 20th session of the UNESCO Inter-governmental Committee for the Safeguarding of the Intangible Cultural Heritage is scheduled to be held at the Red Fort in New Delhi, a site that holds immense historical and cultural significance for India. As a UNESCO World Heritage Site, the Red Fort serves not only as a symbol of India's architectural legacy but also as a backdrop that links the country’s tangible heritage with global efforts to preserve living cultural traditions. Hosting the session here highlights India’s growing leadership in cultural diplomacy, its commitment to heritage preservation, and its active involvement in promoting global cooperation through UNESCO’s cultural initiatives.

questions.question: In which city was the EARTH Summit 2025 inaugurated by Amit Shah?
questions.explanation: The EARTH Summit 2025 was inaugurated in Gandhinagar, a key administrative and economic centre in Gujarat known for hosting major national conferences and government initiatives. The event marked an important step toward strengthening India’s rural and cooperative sectors through the launch of more than 13 new digital services under the Sahakar Sarathi initiative. By choosing Gandhinagar as the venue, the organisers highlighted the city’s growing role as a hub for agricultural innovation, cooperative development, and policy-driven technological reforms. The summit also introduced cooperative taxi and insurance schemes, further demonstrating the city’s importance in shaping strategies for rural empowerment and digital transformation.

questions.question: Which city will host the 7th India International Seaweed Expo & Summit in January 2026?
questions.explanation: The 7th India International Seaweed Expo & Summit, scheduled for January 29–30, 2026, will take place in Kochi, a city emerging as a major center for India’s blue economy initiatives. The event will bring together global delegates, research institutions and industry leaders to discuss innovations in seaweed farming, processing, and value addition. With participation from countries such as Brazil, Sri Lanka, Sweden and the Netherlands, the summit aims to strengthen collaboration and support coastal livelihoods. Hosting the expo enhances Kochi’s position as a hub for marine research, sustainable aquaculture and industrial applications tied to the growing seaweed sector.

questions.question: Who received the inaugural FIFA Peace Prize during the 2026 World Cup draw ceremony held in Washington, D.C.?
questions.explanation: Donald Trump was honoured with the first FIFA Peace Prize during the 2026 FIFA World Cup draw ceremony at the Kennedy Center in Washington, D.C., on 5 December 2025. The award was introduced as part of FIFA’s new social responsibility programme aimed at recognising individuals who contribute to global peace and unity through diplomacy and influence. Trump was credited by FIFA for his alleged role in easing international tensions, including disputes involving India–Pakistan, Israel–Iran, Congo, and others. However, the decision drew significant controversy, as critics questioned both the validity of his peace-related claims and FIFA’s increasingly political associations.

questions.question: Who has taken additional charge as the Chairman and Managing Director (CMD) of THDC India Limited?
questions.explanation: Sipan Garg assumed additional charge as the CMD of THDC India Limited on November 16, 2025, after the sudden demise of R. K. Vishnoi. With over 24 years of experience in finance, taxation, accounts, and commercial operations in the power sector, he brings strong leadership and financial expertise to the role. Garg continues to serve as Director (Finance), a position he has held since August 2024, and his prior roles as CFO at two NTPC subsidiaries further strengthen his credentials. His appointment ensures leadership continuity at a crucial time for THDC, especially as the company expands its renewable and clean energy initiatives.

questions.question: On which date is International Civil Aviation Day 2025 observed?
questions.explanation: International Civil Aviation Day is observed annually on December 7 to emphasize the vital role of civil aviation in connecting nations and driving global development. The day also highlights ICAO’s continued commitment to its 2025 theme, “Safe Skies. Sustainable Future: Together for All.” This theme underscores the aviation sector’s dedication to maintaining high safety standards, promoting environmental sustainability, and fostering international cooperation. By observing this date, the global community reaffirms the importance of building a resilient, eco-friendly, and innovative air transport system that supports future generations while honouring the legacy of the Chicago Convention.

questions.question: On which date is Bodhi Day 2025, marking the Buddha’s enlightenment, observed?
questions.explanation: Bodhi Day 2025 is observed on December 8 by Buddhist communities worldwide. This day commemorates Siddhartha Gautama’s attainment of enlightenment under the Bodhi tree in Bodh Gaya, India, more than 2,500 years ago. The observance emphasizes meditation, chanting, lighting lamps, acts of generosity, and decorating Bodhi trees to reflect on spiritual awakening. It highlights the core teachings of Buddhism, including the Four Noble Truths and the Noble Eightfold Path, promoting self-awareness, compassion, and moral discipline. Bodhi Day serves as a spiritual reminder of liberation through insight and the journey from ignorance to wisdom.

questions.question: What is the name of the spiral galaxy discovered by Indian scientists using the James Webb Space Telescope?
questions.explanation: Indian astronomers Rashi Jain and Yogesh Wadadekar discovered the Alaknanda Galaxy using the James Webb Space Telescope. This spiral galaxy, located in the Abell 2744 cluster, existed when the universe was just 1.5 billion years old and exhibits well-formed spiral arms, challenging previous assumptions that early galaxies were small and chaotic. Its rapid star formation rate, approximately 63 solar masses per year, indicates accelerated development compared to the Milky Way. Naming the galaxy after the Himalayan river Alaknanda symbolically connects it to Indian tradition and highlights the significant contribution of Indian researchers to global astrophysics and our understanding of early cosmic evolution.

questions.question: Which company is launching the AI-powered tax research platform ‘Tax Pragya’ in India?
questions.explanation: Deloitte India is set to launch ‘Tax Pragya,’ an AI-driven platform designed to transform tax research by providing near-instant analysis of over a million tax-related court judgments and two decades of internal knowledge. The platform aims to significantly reduce the time tax professionals spend on legal research, offering actionable insights for both direct and indirect taxes. Its features include real-time updates on legal amendments, predictive litigation analysis, and future AI-generated tax opinions. The phased rollout begins on December 9, 2025, initially serving 500 clients, and will eventually expand to MSMEs and SMEs across India, enhancing decision-making and efficiency in tax consulting.

questions.question: Which Indian cricketer scored his maiden ODI century against South Africa in 2025, becoming the 6th Indian to hit centuries in all formats?
questions.explanation: Yashasvi Jaiswal achieved a remarkable milestone by scoring his maiden ODI century during the third ODI against South Africa on December 6, 2025. This century completed his set of hundreds across all three international formats—Tests, ODIs, and T20Is—making him the 6th Indian to do so. Known for his aggressive yet composed batting, Jaiswal has already amassed seven Test centuries and a T20I century. His achievement underscores his versatility and adaptability across formats, highlighting him as one of India’s most promising young cricketers with the potential to play key roles in future international tournaments.

questions.question: Which institution partnered with NMDC to enhance cybersecurity and AI/ML integration in mining operations?
questions.explanation: IIT Kanpur has partnered with the National Mineral Development Corporation (NMDC) to strengthen cybersecurity and integrate AI/ML technologies in mining operations. The collaboration focuses on conducting risk assessments, providing policy support, improving security operations, and enhancing incident response capabilities. Additionally, the partnership includes training programs and innovation projects, as well as joint research and pilot solutions aimed at increasing NMDC’s technological readiness. This initiative not only advances digital security in mining but also promotes the adoption of cutting-edge technologies in one of India’s key industrial sectors, reflecting a significant step toward modernization and efficiency.

questions.question: Which Indian state became the first to fully digitise its electoral rolls under the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) programme?
questions.explanation: Rajasthan has achieved a historic milestone by becoming the first Indian state to complete 100% digitisation of its voter rolls under the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) programme. This initiative ensures that all voter details are electronically maintained, mapped, and verified, enhancing accuracy and reducing manual errors. With 97% of voter mapping completed, Rajasthan leads the nation in digital electoral management. The digitisation streamlines verification, improves transparency, reduces electoral fraud, and facilitates easier access for voters. Dedicated efforts by Booth Level Officers and local staff played a key role in achieving this success, setting a benchmark for other states.

questions.question: Who became the fourth Indian cricketer to surpass 20,000 international runs during the 3rd ODI vs South Africa in 2025?
questions.explanation: Rohit Sharma achieved the milestone of 20,000 international runs on December 6, 2025, during a high-pressure ODI against South Africa in Visakhapatnam. This achievement makes him only the fourth Indian to reach this elite club, following Sachin Tendulkar, Virat Kohli, and Rahul Dravid. Rohit’s remarkable career includes over 500 international appearances, 50 centuries, and more than 11,500 runs in ODIs alone. Known for his elegant strokeplay and explosive performances, he has been a cornerstone of India’s batting lineup, consistently delivering match-winning innings and setting new standards of consistency and longevity in modern cricket.

questions.question: Which country has launched a 5-year nationwide livestock vaccination programme aimed at protecting millions of animals from major diseases by 2029?
questions.explanation: Tanzania has initiated a comprehensive 5-year livestock vaccination programme aiming to vaccinate 19 million cattle, 17 million goats and sheep, and 40 million chickens by 2029. The initiative targets prevention of major animal diseases such as anthrax, Foot-and-Mouth Disease (FMD), and Rift Valley Fever, with the goal of halving livestock mortality. By incorporating ear-tagging for traceability and deploying veterinary teams to remote pastoral areas, the programme supports rural livelihoods, enhances food security, strengthens export potential, and boosts climate resilience. This nationwide effort positions Tanzania as a leader in livestock health management in the region.

questions.question: Who won the 2025 Formula 1 World Championship after finishing third in the Abu Dhabi Grand Prix?
questions.explanation: Lando Norris clinched his first Formula 1 World Championship in a dramatic finale at the 2025 Abu Dhabi Grand Prix, finishing third in the race but securing the championship by a narrow two-point margin over Max Verstappen. At 26 years old, he became the 11th British F1 world champion and McLaren’s first drivers’ title since 2008. Norris’ consistent performance throughout the season, including key podium finishes and strategic racing, allowed him to overcome challenges and demonstrate mental resilience. His triumph marks a historic moment for British motorsport and cements his status as a rising legend in Formula 1.

questions.question: Where is the 11th India International Science Festival (IISF) 2025 being held?
questions.explanation: The 11th edition of the India International Science Festival (IISF) 2025 is taking place in Panchkula, Haryana, from December 6 to 9, 2025. The festival, themed “Vigyan Se Samruddhi: for Aatmanirbhar Bharat,” showcases India’s achievements in science, technology, and innovation while promoting scientific temper and self-reliance. With over 150 technical sessions across fields such as AI, quantum technology, biotechnology, and climate science, IISF 2025 is expected to host more than 40,000 participants, including scientists, students, and industry leaders. The event emphasizes collaboration between scientific institutions and society and highlights India’s progress in cutting-edge technologies.

questions.question: Which country will host the 2nd WHO Global Summit on Traditional Medicine in December 2025?
questions.explanation: India will host the 2nd WHO Global Summit on Traditional Medicine from 17–19 December 2025 at Bharat Mandapam in New Delhi. The event will be co-hosted by the Ministry of Ayush and the World Health Organization, reflecting India’s growing leadership in global traditional medicine systems. With participation expected from over 100 countries, the summit will focus on scientific validation, integrative healthcare, biodiversity protection and digital innovation. India’s long-established Ayush systems and the WHO Global Centre for Traditional Medicine in Jamnagar further reinforce the nation’s influential role. A dedicated Ashwagandha session will also highlight India’s contributions to modern traditional-medicine research.

questions.question: Which Indian state set a Guinness World Record by installing 45,911 off-grid solar agricultural pumps in just 30 days?
questions.explanation: Maharashtra achieved a remarkable milestone by installing 45,911 off-grid solar agricultural pumps within a span of only 30 days, setting a Guinness World Record. This accomplishment highlights the state’s leadership in renewable-energy-driven farming and its commitment to reducing dependence on traditional electricity sources. The installations were carried out under PM-KUSUM and the state’s Magel Tyala Saur Krushi Pump Yojana, both designed to provide clean, reliable irrigation for farmers. This initiative not only boosts agricultural productivity but also strengthens climate resilience, cuts grid load, and supports India’s long-term clean-energy and sustainability goals.

questions.question: Where was the world’s highest war memorial inaugurated in honour of the soldiers who died in the 2020 clash?
questions.explanation: The world’s highest war memorial was inaugurated at Galwan, located along the Durbuk–Shyok–DBO Road in Ladakh. This memorial honours the twenty Indian soldiers who lost their lives during the 2020 clash with Chinese troops. Designed with a granite trishul-damru structure, it includes an eternal flame, the national flag and twenty bronze statues representing the fallen soldiers. The site further features a museum and digital gallery developed under the Bharat Ranbhoomi Darshan initiative. To make the remote and high-altitude destination more accessible, additional visitor facilities have been created, enhancing both tourism and public remembrance.

questions.question: Who was unanimously elected as the Michigan Republican Party Co-Chair?
questions.explanation: Sunny Reddy, an Indian American entrepreneur, was unanimously chosen as the Michigan Republican Party Co-Chair, marking a significant moment of representation for the Indian diaspora in U.S. politics. His selection highlights his strong grassroots leadership, effective donor outreach and respected standing within the community. The unanimous consent for his nomination reflects broad confidence in his ability to contribute meaningfully to the party’s strategic direction. His influence and integrity have been widely acknowledged, making his election an important development for both the GOP and the broader Indian American community.

questions.question: In which state did the 6th National EMRS Cultural & Literary Festival ‘Udbhavam 2025’ conclude at KL University?
questions.explanation: The 6th National EMRS Cultural & Literary Festival ‘Udbhavam 2025’ was held at KL University, located in Andhra Pradesh. The event brought together 1,558 tribal students from 22 states to participate in a diverse range of cultural, literary and artistic competitions. Spanning three days and featuring 49 competitive events, it was organised by the National Education Society for Tribal Students (NESTS) with strong support from APTWREIS. The festival not only celebrated tribal heritage and creativity but also aimed to empower students by building their confidence, leadership qualities and national presence.

questions.question: Which international organization recognised UPI as the world’s largest real-time payment system in its June 2025 report?
questions.explanation: The International Monetary Fund (IMF) recognised India’s Unified Payments Interface (UPI) as the world’s largest real-time payment system in its June 2025 report titled “Growing Retail Digital Payments (The Value of Interoperability).” This acknowledgment highlights India’s leadership in the global fintech ecosystem and underscores the massive scale of UPI, which accounts for 49% of all global real-time digital transactions. The recognition demonstrates the success of India’s digital infrastructure, government-led initiatives and the collaborative efforts of institutions like NPCI and RBI. It also reinforces UPI’s role as a model for affordable, interoperable and scalable digital payment systems worldwide.

questions.question: In which state was Mission Watershed PUNARUTTHAN launched?
questions.explanation: Mission Watershed PUNARUTTHAN, along with the Watershed Mahotsav, was launched in Nagaland with the goal of rejuvenating water bodies, restoring degraded land and promoting efficient water-harvesting systems through community participation. The initiative operates under the Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana (PMKSY), under which 14 projects have been approved and ₹140 crore sanctioned. As part of the mission’s progress, 555 watershed structures have been renovated, benefiting over 6,500 farmers. The broader objective is to strengthen water security in the Northeast, supported by 90% central assistance, while advancing climate-resilient development across the region.

questions.question: Which global semiconductor company signed an MoU with Tata Electronics to explore chip manufacturing and packaging in India?
questions.explanation: Intel signed a Memorandum of Understanding with Tata Electronics to explore semiconductor chip manufacturing and advanced packaging in India. The collaboration focuses on leveraging Tata’s upcoming Dholera chip fabrication facility in Gujarat and the Guwahati OSAT unit in Assam. Both entities aim to strengthen India’s semiconductor value chain, support domestic chip production and contribute to global supply chain resilience at a time when demand for AI-driven technologies is rising rapidly. The partnership also includes potential work on advanced packaging technologies and AI-based PC solutions. Intel’s CEO Lip-Bu Tan’s visit to India and meetings with national leaders further highlight the strategic importance of this initiative.

questions.question: On which date is International Anti-Corruption Day observed in 2025?
questions.explanation: International Anti-Corruption Day in 2025 is observed on December 9, a day dedicated to raising global awareness about the need to combat corruption and promote integrity across societies. The 2025 theme, “Uniting with Youth Against Corruption: Shaping Tomorrow's Integrity,” emphasises the crucial role young people play in driving ethical governance. Through technology, education and social media, youth are encouraged to challenge corrupt practices and create transparent systems. Various organizations, including UNODC and UNDP, host events such as webinars, workshops and awareness drives to strengthen collective action against corruption and inspire long-term positive change.

questions.question: On which date is the International Day of Commemoration and Dignity of the Victims of Genocide observed each year?
questions.explanation: The International Day of Commemoration and Dignity of the Victims of the Crime of Genocide is observed every year on December 9. This date aligns with the adoption of the Genocide Convention on 9 December 1948, reinforcing the global commitment to preventing and punishing the crime of genocide. The observance provides an opportunity to honour victims, reflect on past atrocities, and build stronger mechanisms for justice, accountability and early prevention. In 2025, the day marks its 10th anniversary, prompting renewed focus on combating incitement, strengthening legal frameworks and addressing emerging threats such as digital hate speech and ethnic violence.

questions.question: Which city ranked as the most polluted city in India in November 2025?
questions.explanation: Ghaziabad emerged as the most polluted city in India in November 2025, recording a PM2.5 concentration of 224 µg/m³, which placed it above all other cities during that period. Delhi followed closely with a PM2.5 level of 215 µg/m³ after a significant rise from October. Uttar Pradesh dominated the list overall, with six of the top ten polluted cities, while Haryana contributed three and Delhi one. According to the Centre for Research on Energy and Clean Air, the region experienced almost no ‘safe AQI day’. Although the impact of stubble burning was relatively lower than the previous year, pollution levels remained alarmingly high across several regions.

questions.question: Which country will host the Squash World Cup 2025 for the third consecutive time at SDAT Stadium, Chennai?
questions.explanation: India is set to host the Squash World Cup 2025 from December 10–14 at SDAT Stadium, Chennai, marking the third consecutive time the country has organized this prestigious tournament. The event will feature 12 nations, including top squash teams like Egypt and Malaysia. India’s strong infrastructure, the support of the Squash Rackets Federation of India, and Chennai’s reputation as the “Home of Indian Squash” contribute to its recurring role as host. The tournament highlights India’s growing prominence in international squash, its commitment to promoting the sport, and its aim to improve its global ranking, building on a third-place finish in 2023.

questions.question: Who was named TIME’s 2025 CEO of the Year for his leadership at YouTube?
questions.explanation: Neal Mohan, the Indian-origin CEO of YouTube, was recognized as TIME’s 2025 CEO of the Year for his calm, strategic, and creator-focused leadership. Since taking over as CEO in 2023, Mohan has driven innovations such as YouTube Shorts, YouTube TV expansion, and enhanced monetization tools for creators, while prioritizing digital wellbeing and content moderation. His recognition highlights the global impact of Indian-origin leaders in technology, underscores ethical and user-centric leadership in digital platforms, and serves as an inspiration for aspiring professionals in AI, media, and technology sectors.

questions.question: On which date is International Animal Rights Day 2025 observed?
questions.explanation: International Animal Rights Day is observed on December 10 to highlight that both humans and animals deserve dignity, protection, and ethical treatment. Aligning it with Human Rights Day reinforces the shared principles of compassion and justice for all living beings.
