Established in 1998 by the organisation Uncaged to mark the 50th anniversary of the Universal Declaration of Human Rights, the day emphasises freedom from cruelty, calls attention to global exploitation and suffering, and advocates stronger welfare standards. It serves as a reminder that animals, as sentient beings, must be included in moral and legal considerations.

questions.question: On which date is Human Rights Day 2025 observed?
questions.explanation: Human Rights Day is observed globally on December 10, commemorating the adoption of the Universal Declaration of Human Rights in 1948. The 2025 theme, “Our Everyday Essentials,” highlights the fundamental rights that every individual is entitled to, including safety, food, shelter, freedom of expression, and participation in society. The day is marked by worldwide events and campaigns that aim to raise awareness, encourage civic engagement, and reinforce human dignity through community-driven initiatives. It serves as a reminder of the ongoing need to uphold and protect universal human rights amid rising global uncertainties.

questions.question: Which Indian state introduced its first Gen-Z Post Office Extension Counter?
questions.explanation: Kerala has launched its first Gen-Z Post Office Extension Counter at CMS College, Kottayam, designed entirely by students to create a modern, student-centric postal experience. The counter combines functional postal services with innovative community spaces, including eco-friendly seating, vertical gardens, charging stations, and a recreation zone. Equipped with MPCM facilities, packaging support, and a MyStamp printer, the initiative aims to blend traditional postal services with contemporary, sustainable design. This development reflects Kerala’s commitment to innovation, sustainability, and engaging younger generations in public service experiences.

questions.question: Which state hosted the Rising Global Summit that resulted in major investment commitments including 35 MoUs worth ₹2.43 lakh crore?
questions.explanation: Telangana hosted the Rising Global Summit to accelerate economic growth and position itself as a hub for advanced industries. The summit saw the signing of 35 MoUs worth ₹2.43 lakh crore and secured a ₹75,000 crore investment from Brookfield/Axis Ventures for Bharat Future City. These commitments reflect the state’s focus on deep tech, green energy, aerospace, and digital infrastructure, demonstrating investor confidence. The event underscores Telangana’s vision of becoming a next-generation technology and industrial hub, aligning with its long-term economic target of achieving a $3-trillion economy by 2047, supported by strategic government initiatives and robust policy frameworks.

questions.question: Where is the Global AI Show 2025, themed “AI: 2031”, positioning itself as a major innovation hub?
questions.explanation: The Global AI Show 2025 highlights how Abu Dhabi is emerging as a powerful centre for technological advancement, supported by strong venture capital activity, IPO pathways, and a robust investment environment. With a focus on six AI pillars, talent development, ethical governance, and government-enabled collaborations, the event brings together innovators, policymakers, and industry leaders. It showcases the city’s commitment to advancing accessible AI tools, strengthening global partnerships, and shaping West Asia’s expanding role in next-generation technologies, firmly positioning Abu Dhabi as a leading global innovation hub.

questions.question: Where were 35 captive-reared critically endangered vultures approved for release from the Rani Breeding Centre?
questions.explanation: The release of 35 critically endangered vultures into Kaziranga marks a major step in restoring populations that have suffered severe declines due to diclofenac poisoning and slow natural recovery. The site chosen lies in the 6th Addition area under the Bishwanath Wildlife Division, providing a secure habitat for acclimatisation. Supported by the Bombay Natural History Society, a soft-release environment was prepared to help the birds gradually adjust to the wild. This initiative highlights the importance of Assam as a remaining stronghold for vulture conservation and demonstrates a coordinated national effort to rebuild the species’ fragile population.

questions.question: Which country declared a state of emergency after cigarette-smuggling balloons from Belarus repeatedly disrupted its airspace?
questions.explanation: Lithuania imposed a state of emergency after numerous smuggler balloons originating from Belarus created repeated airspace disruptions, even forcing temporary closure of Vilnius airport. The government viewed these incursions as a form of hybrid attack, prompting the need for military assistance to support police and border forces. Positioned in the Baltic region with Vilnius as its capital and led by President Gitanas Nausėda, Lithuania responded decisively to protect national security, maintain stability, and reinforce control over its territorial airspace during a period of heightened regional tension.

questions.question: Which company announced a record US$17.5 billion investment in India to expand AI infrastructure, skilling, and digital sovereignty?
questions.explanation: Microsoft has committed US$17.5 billion for 2026–2029 to strengthen India’s AI ecosystem, marking its largest-ever investment in Asia. The investment focuses on three pillars: building hyperscale AI infrastructure with the new India South Central cloud region, integrating AI into public platforms like e-Shram and National Career Service to benefit over 310 million informal workers, and skilling 20 million Indians by 2030 through initiatives like ADVANTA(I)GE India. Additionally, Microsoft is enhancing digital sovereignty with Sovereign Public and Private Cloud offerings, ensuring localized compliance, security, and AI-driven productivity solutions, positioning India as a global AI hub.

questions.question: Which institution has extended a ₹1,685.27 crore long-term loan to support major transmission and infrastructure projects under the MoU with OPTCL in Odisha?
questions.explanation: NABARD has provided significant financial support to Odisha’s power sector by extending a long-term loan of ₹1,685.27 crore to OPTCL. This initiative represents NABARD’s first-ever project financing to a State PSU within the state, marking an important milestone in its efforts to strengthen infrastructure development. The loan, offered at a concessional interest rate of 7.75%, is aimed at enabling large-scale transmission upgrades and improving the reliability of Odisha’s electricity network. By facilitating affordable funding, NABARD plays a crucial role in accelerating the state’s long-term power sector modernization and overall economic progress.

questions.question: Which country’s National Olympic Committee signed an MoU with the Indian Olympic Association to enhance bilateral sports cooperation?
questions.explanation: Italy, through its Italian National Olympic Committee, entered into an MoU with the Indian Olympic Association to strengthen sports cooperation between the two nations. The partnership focuses on key areas such as athlete training, access to world-class infrastructure, and advancement in sports science. It also promotes sharing of expertise and enables mutual access to elite training facilities and high-performance centres for athletes, coaches, and specialists. This collaboration aims to enhance sporting excellence, support talent development, and build long-term strategic ties that benefit both countries across multiple sporting disciplines.

questions.question: What is the upgraded FY25-26 growth forecast for India according to the Asian Development Bank?
questions.explanation: The Asian Development Bank has revised India’s FY25-26 growth outlook upward to 7.2%, reflecting confidence in the country’s strong economic performance during the July–September period and improved prospects for the full fiscal year. This upgraded estimate highlights India’s role as a major contributor to Asia-Pacific’s growth, which has also been raised to 5.1%. The positive adjustment underscores the momentum driven by robust domestic demand, improved investment climate, and ongoing structural reforms. While the projection for FY26-27 remains stable at 6.5%, the current upward revision indicates sustained economic resilience and a favourable medium-term growth trajectory.

questions.question: Who has been appointed as the new Prime Minister of the Czech Republic after forming a coalition with two eurosceptic parties?
questions.explanation: Andrej Babis has been appointed as the Prime Minister of the Czech Republic after his ANO party successfully formed a coalition with two eurosceptic groups. His political stance includes a stronger nationalist approach and a campaign focused on reducing aid to Ukraine. The coalition emphasises that the European Union must respect national sovereignty and operate within defined limits. This appointment marks a significant shift in Czech politics, particularly given Babis’s alignment with positions often associated with Donald Trump. His leadership is expected to influence the country’s direction on EU relations and foreign policy in the coming years.

questions.question: Who won the UNEP Champions of the Earth 2025 Award for climate leadership?
questions.explanation: Supriya Sahu, serving as the Additional Chief Secretary to the Government of Tamil Nadu, received the prestigious UNEP Champions of the Earth 2025 Award for her groundbreaking climate leadership. Recognized in the Inspiration and Action category, she has led transformative initiatives across sustainable cooling, heat resilience, and ecosystem restoration. Her efforts have generated millions of green jobs, enhanced forest cover, and strengthened climate resilience for millions of people in Tamil Nadu. By integrating community participation with innovative environmental solutions, she has positioned the state as a global frontrunner in adaptation and climate governance. Her contributions illustrate the impact of bold, localized climate action on global sustainability.

questions.question: Which company has launched the tirzepatide-based once-weekly injectable drug Yurpeak for obesity and type-2 diabetes management in India?
questions.explanation: Cipla has launched Yurpeak, a tirzepatide-based injectable designed for weekly use to help manage both obesity and type-2 diabetes. This development follows regulatory approval for the underlying molecule and positions Cipla as the distributor and promoter of the second tirzepatide brand available in India. The introduction of this therapy is significant because metabolic disorders such as obesity and diabetes are rapidly increasing across the country. By offering advanced treatment options, Cipla aims to support improved clinical outcomes, enhance patient access to cutting-edge therapies, and contribute to addressing India’s pressing public health challenges.

questions.question: On which specific calendar date is UNICEF Foundation Day observed annually, as noted for the year 2025?
questions.explanation: UNICEF Foundation Day 2025 is observed on December 11, marking 79 years since the organization’s establishment. The day serves as a global reminder of the ongoing need to safeguard children’s rights, well-being, and dignity. It highlights UNICEF’s long-standing mission of supporting children through emergencies, conflicts, climate-related challenges, and developmental barriers. Celebrating this day reinforces the importance of strong healthcare, nutrition, education, and protection systems that benefit children worldwide. Beyond commemorating history, the observance encourages collective responsibility and inspires action toward building a safer, more equitable future for every child, regardless of background or circumstance.

questions.question: Which brand has renewed its partnership as the Official Regional Sponsor of the Argentina Football Association for the 2026 World Cup period?
questions.explanation: Amul has extended its sponsorship with the Argentina Football Association for another season, continuing a relationship that began in 2022. This renewal highlights the brand’s growing presence in international sports, particularly as the first Indian regional sponsor in Argentine football history. The association has now reached its fourth year, showcasing strong collaboration between Amul and the reigning world champions. By maintaining this partnership through the 2026 World Cup period, Amul reinforces its global visibility and deepens its connection with football audiences worldwide.

questions.question: For what purpose has the Sujalam Bharat App been launched by the Union Jal Shakti Minister?
questions.explanation: The Sujalam Bharat App has been launched to strengthen and modernize rural water management across India. Developed under the Ministry of Jal Shakti, it enables real-time monitoring, geo-referencing of water infrastructure, and transparent tracking of village water supply systems. The platform helps communities understand their water sources, supply reliability, and infrastructure health while promoting active participation in the management of drinking water schemes. With features like the Sujal Gaon ID and integration with advanced GIS tools, the app supports better planning, maintenance, and long-term sustainability. Its goal is to make rural water services more efficient, accountable, and citizen-centric under the Jal Jeevan Mission.

questions.question: Which institution has launched India’s first incubator-linked deep tech venture capital fund with a ₹250-crore corpus?
questions.explanation: IIT Bombay, through its Society for Innovation and Entrepreneurship (SINE), has introduced India’s first incubator-linked deep tech venture capital fund with a total corpus of ₹250 crore. The fund aims to support around 25–30 early-stage startups, with each receiving up to ₹15 crore in investment. Its focus spans several high-impact sectors such as artificial intelligence, advanced computing, manufacturing technologies, novel materials, space, defence, nuclear technology, climate solutions, and healthcare innovations. This initiative is designed to strengthen India’s deep tech ecosystem by nurturing breakthrough ideas at the pre-seed and seed stages, helping startups accelerate development and scale.

questions.question: On which date is International Mountain Day 2025 observed?
questions.explanation: International Mountain Day 2025 is observed on December 11 and carries heightened significance because it aligns with the UN’s declaration of 2025 as the International Year of Glaciers’ Preservation. The day highlights the critical importance of glaciers for water, agriculture, food security, energy production, and ecological balance. With glaciers melting at record rates due to climate change, the observance emphasizes the need for global action to protect mountain ecosystems and support vulnerable mountain communities. The theme, “Glaciers matter for water, food and livelihoods in mountains and beyond,” reinforces how deeply interconnected glaciers are with human survival and environmental stability.

questions.question: What is the name of the AI framework developed to decode internal cancer-cell processes and predict tumour behaviour and growth patterns?
questions.explanation: OncoMark is an advanced artificial intelligence framework designed to analyze and interpret the internal processes of cancer cells. By decoding these complex biological mechanisms, it can forecast tumour behaviour and growth patterns with greater accuracy. Developed through collaborative research efforts and published in the journal Communications Biology, this tool helps bridge existing gaps in measuring key hallmarks of cancer during diagnosis. Its predictive capabilities support more personalized cancer treatment strategies, enabling clinicians to tailor therapies based on tumour characteristics, thereby improving diagnostic precision and potential treatment outcomes for cancer patients.

questions.question: Which company introduced the ‘Claim Kavach’ programme to provide structured assistance and simplify the motor insurance claims process for customers?
questions.explanation: Policybazaar launched the Claim Kavach programme as a customer-focused initiative aimed at reducing the complexity involved in motor insurance claims. Through this service, Policybazaar offers step-by-step guidance, assigns a dedicated claims manager, and provides a 24×7 helpline to support customers throughout the claims journey. The programme assists with claim filing, documentation, and coordination with garages and surveyors while promoting a digital and hassle-free process. Additionally, Policybazaar has an escalation team that intervenes in cases of delays or disputes by working closely with insurers, thereby improving transparency, efficiency, and customer confidence in claim settlements.

questions.question: Which CRPF officer from Haryana was awarded the Union Home Minister’s Efficiency Medal for exemplary service, leadership, and operational excellence?
questions.explanation: Dinesh Khatak, a senior officer of the Central Reserve Police Force from Jind district in Haryana, was conferred the Union Home Minister’s Efficiency Medal in recognition of his outstanding contributions to national security. His career is marked by exemplary leadership, operational excellence, and disciplined service across some of the most sensitive regions of the country. He has served extensively in Jammu and Kashmir during challenging periods, contributed significantly to counter-insurgency training at CIAT Shivpuri, and is currently posted in the Naxal-affected Bijapur district. The award reflects both his personal dedication and the crucial role of the CRPF in maintaining internal security.

questions.question: At which stadium were special stands named in honour of Indian cricket icons Yuvraj Singh and Harmanpreet Kaur?
questions.explanation: Mullanpur Stadium, officially known as the Maharaja Yadavindra Singh International Cricket Stadium in New Chandigarh, became the venue where stadium stands were named after Yuvraj Singh and Harmanpreet Kaur. This honour recognized their extraordinary contributions to Indian cricket, spanning iconic World Cup performances and inspirational leadership. The inauguration took place ahead of an international T20 match, adding to the stadium’s significance as it hosted its first men’s international fixture. The tribute reflects Punjab’s growing sports culture and commitment to celebrating cricketing excellence while strengthening modern cricket infrastructure in the state.

questions.question: Which Indian para-swimmer won two gold medals in the 50m Butterfly and 50m Backstroke events on the opening day of the Asian Youth Para Games 2025?
questions.explanation: Abdul Quadir Indori emerged as a standout performer for India at the Asian Youth Para Games 2025 held in Dubai by securing two gold medals on the very first day of competition. He topped the podium in both the 50m Butterfly and 50m Backstroke events, underlining his versatility and competitive excellence in para-swimming. His achievement reflects the growing depth and quality of India’s youth para-sports ecosystem. Such performances not only boost India’s medal tally but also inspire young athletes with disabilities, showcasing the country’s increasing investment, training standards, and international competitiveness in para-sports.

questions.question: Which city was the central location where a metro-based campaign was conducted to promote women’s health, safety, mental well-being, TB awareness, and compliance with the PC & PNDT Act?
questions.explanation: The month-long campaign was carried out on a major metro network operating in the national capital region, making New Delhi the focal point of this initiative. As the seat of the Union Government, New Delhi is a strategic location for public awareness drives launched by the Union Health Ministry in collaboration with global organizations such as the WHO. The city’s extensive metro network enables wide outreach among daily commuters, ensuring effective dissemination of messages related to women’s health, safety, mental health, tuberculosis awareness, and legal compliance. This initiative also aligns with broader national programs like Ayushman Bharat, emphasizing the role of healthy women in nation-building.

questions.question: Which institution is responsible for running the ATMAN 3.0 accelerator programme focused on advancing research-driven HealthTech innovation and startup readiness?
questions.explanation: IIT Bombay is the institution overseeing the ATMAN 3.0 accelerator programme through its Technology Innovation Hub for Translational Research on Internet of Things. This eight-week HealthTech-focused accelerator is designed to support promising startups by enhancing their research capabilities, technological validation, and market preparedness. The programme concludes with a Demo Day, where selected startups pitch to potential investors. Backed by the National Mission on Interdisciplinary Cyber-Physical Systems and the Department of Science and Technology, the initiative aims to bridge the gap between academic research and real-world healthcare solutions, while also providing significant seed funding opportunities to high-performing startups.

questions.question: Which institution is responsible for running the ATMAN 3.0 accelerator programme focused on advancing research-driven HealthTech innovation and startup readiness?
questions.explanation: IIT Bombay is the institution overseeing the ATMAN 3.0 accelerator programme through its Technology Innovation Hub for Translational Research on Internet of Things. This eight-week HealthTech-focused accelerator is designed to support promising startups by enhancing their research capabilities, technological validation, and market preparedness. The programme concludes with a Demo Day, where selected startups pitch to potential investors. Backed by the National Mission on Interdisciplinary Cyber-Physical Systems and the Department of Science and Technology, the initiative aims to bridge the gap between academic research and real-world healthcare solutions, while also providing significant seed funding opportunities to high-performing startups.

questions.question: Which banking institution was honoured as the Global Bank of the Year 2025 by The Banker, recognizing excellence in digital innovation, financial performance, and global leadership?
questions.explanation: DBS was awarded the Global Bank of the Year 2025 by The Banker, a respected publication of the Financial Times Group, during the Bank of the Year Awards held in London. Headquartered in Singapore, DBS stood out among nearly 300 banks from over 130 countries due to its strong financial performance, strategic resilience, and leadership in digital banking. This achievement marked its third win in this prestigious category, following earlier titles in 2018 and 2021. The recognition further strengthened DBS’s global reputation, as it simultaneously held top honours from both The Banker and Euromoney.

questions.question: On which date is International Universal Health Coverage Day observed every year to emphasize the right to quality and affordable healthcare for all?
questions.explanation: International Universal Health Coverage Day is observed annually on December 12 to highlight the global commitment to ensuring that everyone can access essential health services without facing financial hardship. The date marks the adoption of a landmark United Nations General Assembly resolution in 2012 that urged countries to accelerate progress toward universal health coverage. Later, the UN officially proclaimed the observance in 2017. The day serves as a global platform to raise awareness about health inequities, promote affordable healthcare systems, and encourage governments to invest in strong, inclusive, and resilient health systems aligned with the Sustainable Development Goals.

questions.question: Who has been appointed as the next Chief Executive Officer of The Coca-Cola Company, effective from 31 March 2026?
questions.explanation: Henrique Braun has been elected as the Chief Executive Officer of The Coca-Cola Company, with his appointment taking effect on 31 March 2026. He will succeed James Quincey, who will move into the role of Executive Chairman after nearly a decade as CEO. Braun brings nearly 30 years of experience at Coca-Cola, having served in key leadership roles across multiple global markets, including Latin America, Greater China, South Korea, and international development. His background as Executive Vice President and Chief Operating Officer positions him to drive innovation, consumer-centric strategies, and global growth for the company.

questions.question: Which city has emerged as the leading contributor in Uttar Pradesh for rooftop solar installations under the PM Surya Ghar Free Electricity Scheme?
questions.explanation: Lucknow has taken the lead in Uttar Pradesh in terms of rooftop solar installations under the PM Surya Ghar Free Electricity Scheme. With over 62,000 rooftop solar setups, the city has played a key role in pushing the state beyond the milestone of three lakh installations. The scheme, launched in 2024, aims to provide affordable and clean energy by offering subsidies that enable households to generate their own electricity and receive up to 300 free units per month. Lucknow’s performance highlights effective implementation, public participation, and growing awareness of renewable energy benefits.

questions.question: On which date is the International Day of Neutrality observed worldwide to highlight the role of neutrality in promoting peace and diplomacy?
questions.explanation: December 12 is observed globally as the International Day of Neutrality, emphasizing the importance of impartiality in international relations and conflict resolution. The day was officially designated by the United Nations General Assembly through Resolution 71/275, adopted in 2017. Neutrality encourages countries to avoid participation in conflicts, remain impartial, and support peaceful dialogue, mediation, and humanitarian efforts. The observance is closely linked to the UN Charter’s principles of peaceful dispute settlement and non-use of force. By promoting neutrality, the UN highlights its value in preventive diplomacy, peacebuilding, and achieving sustainable development goals worldwide.

questions.question: Which premier Indian institute is jointly hosting the Global AI Conclave in Chennai along with the India AI Mission?
questions.explanation: IIT Madras is jointly hosting the Global AI Conclave in Chennai in collaboration with the India AI Mission, highlighting India’s growing role in shaping responsible artificial intelligence governance. The conclave focuses on advancing safe, trusted, and inclusive AI frameworks that are both globally interoperable and locally relevant. It brings together policymakers, industry leaders, academics, and civil society representatives to discuss AI safety, governance models, and collaborative initiatives such as an AI Safety Commons for the Global South. The event also serves as a key precursor to the India-AI Impact Summit 2026.

questions.question: Who has been appointed as the new Head of Public Policy at Meta India?
questions.explanation: Meta India has appointed Aman Jain as its new Head of Public Policy, reflecting the company’s focus on strengthening engagement with India’s evolving digital and regulatory environment. With over 20 years of experience across government roles and global technology firms, Jain is well positioned to lead Meta’s policy strategy in the country. In his role, he will oversee government and regulatory engagement, guide discussions on digital safety, data governance, competition, and artificial intelligence, and become part of Meta’s India leadership team, reporting to the Asia Pacific policy leadership.

questions.question: Which Indian state is set to host Asia’s largest Global Capability Centre being developed by Brookfield with a $1 billion investment?
questions.explanation: Maharashtra is emerging as a major destination for global investments, with Brookfield announcing a $1 billion project to build Asia’s largest Global Capability Centre in Mumbai’s Powai. Spread across 6 acres with 2 million square feet of Grade-A workspace, the campus will support a multinational bank on a long-term lease and is expected to generate over 30,000 jobs by 2029. The project aligns with Maharashtra’s dedicated GCC policy, which focuses on attracting large-scale investments, strengthening infrastructure, and creating high-skilled employment opportunities across advanced technology and financial services sectors.

questions.question: What is the new name given to the MGNREGS after the Union Cabinet approved its reform?
questions.explanation: The Union Cabinet has approved a significant reform of India’s flagship rural employment programme by renaming MGNREGS as Poojya Bapu Grameen Rozgar Yojana. Along with the renaming, the scheme has been strengthened by increasing the guaranteed wage employment from 100 days to 125 days per household each year. This move aims to enhance rural livelihood security and provide greater employment opportunities in rural areas. Despite the changes, the scheme continues to be implemented and overseen by the Ministry of Rural Development, ensuring continuity in administration and objectives.

questions.question: In which year has the Union Cabinet approved the conduct of India’s next national census as a fully digital exercise?
questions.explanation: The Union Cabinet has approved the conduct of the Census of India in the year 2027, marking a significant milestone as it will be the country’s first completely digital census. This will be the 16th national census and the 8th since independence. Scheduled in two phases, the houselisting and housing census will take place from April to September 2026, followed by population enumeration in February 2027. The digital approach is expected to improve data accuracy, speed of collection, accessibility, and policy relevance while covering the entire population of the country.

questions.question: Who has been appointed as the new Managing Director and Chief Executive Officer of PNB Housing Finance?
questions.explanation: PNB Housing Finance has appointed Ajai Kumar Shukla as its new Managing Director and Chief Executive Officer, marking a key leadership transition for the company. With extensive experience in banking and financial services, Shukla is expected to strengthen the organisation’s growth strategy, enhance operational efficiency, and support long-term expansion in India’s housing finance market. His expertise in retail lending, credit operations, governance, and strategic planning positions him well to lead the company amid rising housing demand and increasing competition, while reinforcing confidence among investors, customers, and regulatory stakeholders.

questions.question: Which country will host the first Commonwealth Kho Kho Championship scheduled for March 9–14, 2026?
questions.explanation: India is set to host the inaugural Commonwealth Kho Kho Championship in March 2026, marking a historic moment for the traditional Indian sport on the global stage. The event will be held from March 9 to March 14 and is expected to see participation from more than 24 nations across five continents, highlighting the sport’s expanding international appeal. The championship will feature 16 men’s teams and 16 women’s teams, underlining a strong emphasis on gender inclusivity and competitive excellence in Kho Kho.

questions.question: Which city has unveiled the world’s largest statue of football legend Lionel Messi?
questions.explanation: Kolkata, often referred to as the football capital of India, has unveiled a massive 70-foot iron statue of Lionel Messi, making it the largest statue of the Argentine football icon in the world. The statue has been installed at Lake Town in South Dum Dum and was created by the Sree Bhumi Sporting Club. This initiative highlights the city’s deep-rooted passion for football and its admiration for international football stars. Adding to its global significance, Lionel Messi himself is set to virtually inaugurate the statue, drawing international attention.

questions.question: Which Indian state has achieved a major environmental milestone by getting its first Ramsar Site with the declaration of Kopra Reservoir?
questions.explanation: Chhattisgarh has marked an important achievement in environmental conservation with the declaration of Kopra Reservoir as its first Ramsar Site. Located in the Bilaspur district, Kopra Reservoir is a freshwater wetland system formed through a mix of natural processes and human-made structures. The reservoir is mainly rain-fed and supplemented by small seasonal streams, which help maintain consistent water availability throughout the year. Its recognition under the Ramsar Convention highlights the ecological significance of the wetland and strengthens efforts toward wetland conservation and sustainable water management in the state.

questions.question: Which bank has acquired a 50% stake in the Indian Digital Payment Intelligence Corporation (IDPIC) to combat digital payment frauds?
questions.explanation: SBI has taken a strategic step to strengthen India’s digital payment ecosystem by acquiring a 50% stake in the Indian Digital Payment Intelligence Corporation (IDPIC). The bank invested ₹10 crore to acquire 1 crore shares in this not-for-profit entity, which has an authorised capital of ₹500 crore. IDPIC is designed to function as a unified fraud-detection platform that enables real-time data sharing and collective intelligence among stakeholders. This initiative aims to prevent digital payment frauds, enhance customer protection, and build greater trust in digital transactions across the country.

questions.question: Which country is hosting the 33rd Southeast Asian Games that began on 9th December?
questions.explanation: Thailand is hosting the 33rd edition of the Southeast Asian Games, which officially began on 9th December. The multi-sport event is being held across Bangkok and Chonburi province, with the opening ceremony taking place at the Rajamangala National Stadium. More than 13,000 athletes from 11 Southeast Asian nations are participating, competing across 50 medal sports that include both Olympic disciplines and traditional regional games. Hosting the SEA Games highlights Thailand’s strong sporting infrastructure and its role in promoting regional unity, cultural exchange, and athletic excellence.

questions.question: What is the name of India’s first AI-powered platform launched for cybercrime investigations in Maharashtra?
questions.explanation: MahaCrimeOS AI is India’s first artificial intelligence–based platform developed specifically to support cybercrime investigations. The platform was unveiled in Maharashtra and has already been implemented in 23 police stations in Nagpur, with plans to expand its coverage to around 1,100 police stations across the state. By leveraging AI capabilities, the system is designed to enhance efficiency, data analysis, and investigative accuracy in handling cybercrime cases. This initiative reflects Maharashtra’s broader vision of adopting advanced AI solutions across sectors and positioning itself as a leading AI hub in India.

questions.question: On which date is National Energy Conservation Day observed in India every year?
questions.explanation: National Energy Conservation Day is observed annually in India on December 14 to promote awareness about the importance of energy efficiency and sustainable energy use. The observance is guided by the Bureau of Energy Efficiency (BEE) under the Ministry of Power. It highlights the need to reduce energy wastage amid rising demand and limited resources. The day encourages citizens, particularly students and youth, to adopt energy-saving habits in daily life. Through campaigns, competitions, workshops, and awards, the observance supports India’s broader goals of energy security, environmental protection, and sustainable development.

questions.question: Which country won the FIH Men’s Junior Hockey World Cup 2025 by defeating Spain in the final?
questions.explanation: Germany emerged as the champion of the 2025 FIH Men’s Junior Hockey World Cup held in Chennai and Madurai, India. They secured their eighth Junior Hockey World Cup title by defeating Spain 3–2 in a shoot-out after a 1–1 draw in regular time. The tournament highlighted Germany’s dominance in junior hockey, showcasing their strong defensive play and high-speed transitions. India claimed the bronze medal after a remarkable comeback against Argentina. This victory further solidifies Germany’s position as the most successful team in the history of the Men’s Junior Hockey World Cup.

questions.question: Which organization signed an MoU with the Department of Posts to expand mutual fund access across India?
questions.explanation: The Department of Posts partnered with BSE, Asia’s oldest stock exchange, to distribute mutual funds through India Post’s extensive network. This initiative leverages BSE StAR MF, India’s largest mutual fund platform, to enable last-mile financial inclusion, especially in rural and semi-urban areas. Postal employees will be trained and certified as mutual fund distributors, assisting citizens with transactions and investor guidance. The MoU, valid from 12 December 2025 to 11 December 2028, aims to improve financial literacy, provide access to formal investment products, and reduce reliance on informal or unregulated channels.

questions.question: Who has been appointed as the new CEO of BMW to lead the company through its electric mobility transition?
questions.explanation: Milan Nedeljković has been appointed as the new CEO of BMW, taking over from long-serving chief Oliver Zipse. With a career at BMW spanning three decades, Nedeljković brings extensive technical expertise and global production leadership, making him well-suited to guide the company through increasing competition and the shift to electric vehicles. His leadership will be critical for executing BMW’s next-generation all-electric “Neue Klasse” models and optimizing manufacturing efficiency. The transition reflects BMW’s strategic focus on innovation, cost management, and maintaining its global market position amid the rapidly evolving automotive sector.

questions.question: Which country’s regulatory authority has qualified the first AI-powered tool to accelerate drug trials for severe fatty liver disease?
questions.explanation: The United States has taken a major step in integrating artificial intelligence into healthcare regulation through its Food and Drug Administration (FDA). The FDA qualified AIM-NASH, the first AI-powered tool designed to assist in assessing severe fatty liver disease during drug trials. This qualification enables faster, more consistent evaluation of liver biopsy data, helping reduce delays, variability, and costs in clinical research. By supporting the development of treatments for metabolic dysfunction-associated steatohepatitis (MASH), the decision highlights the growing role of AI in modern drug development and reflects strong regulatory confidence in AI-assisted diagnostics.

questions.question: What was India’s retail inflation (CPI) in November 2025?
questions.explanation: India’s Consumer Price Index (CPI) retail inflation increased slightly to 0.71% in November 2025, up from 0.25% in October. The rise was primarily due to easing food deflation, which moderated from -5.02% to -3.91%. While rural inflation turned positive at 0.10% and urban inflation increased to 1.4%, the overall CPI inflation reflects a modest uptick driven by seasonal increases in vegetables, pulses, fruits, eggs, and meat & fish. The moderation of the base effect contributed to this rise, signaling a gradual recovery in price levels after a period of very low inflation.

questions.question: Which global e-commerce company signed a Memorandum of Understanding with Gati Shakti Vishwavidyalaya to promote shared learning and academic innovation?
questions.explanation: Amazon has signed a Memorandum of Understanding with Gati Shakti Vishwavidyalaya to strengthen collaboration in learning, research, and innovation within the logistics and warehousing sectors. The partnership focuses on developing industry-oriented academic programs, updating curriculum content, and undertaking joint research initiatives. A key feature of the collaboration is the establishment of an Amazon Chair Professorship at the university, dedicated to data-driven warehousing research. By combining GSV’s academic expertise with Amazon’s industry experience, the initiative aims to enhance practical skills, encourage innovation, and support India’s efforts to improve logistics efficiency and infrastructure development.

questions.question: Which Indian state launched Mission Punarutthan during the Watershed Mahotsav 2025 to restore traditional water bodies and strengthen watershed systems?
questions.explanation: Nagaland launched Mission Punarutthan during the Watershed Mahotsav 2025 to promote water security, restore natural springs, and strengthen watershed systems across villages. The initiative emphasises community-led conservation, where local residents actively participate in protecting water bodies. Supported by schemes like MGNREGA and PMKSY, the program aims to improve soil health, increase water availability, and enhance rural livelihoods. Nagaland’s efforts include repairing water-harvesting structures, reviving natural springs, and benefiting thousands of farmers, thereby contributing to sustainable development and climate resilience in the state.

questions.question: In which city did India launch its first indigenous hydrogen fuel cell passenger vessel for commercial service?
questions.explanation: India’s first indigenous hydrogen fuel cell passenger vessel began commercial operations in Varanasi, specifically at Namo Ghat. The 24-meter catamaran, built by Cochin Shipyard Ltd. and owned by the Inland Waterways Authority of India, uses a Low Temperature Proton Exchange Membrane (PEM) fuel cell system, producing zero emissions and offering a sustainable transport solution along the Ganga. This initiative improves river-based mobility, reduces road congestion, supports eco-friendly tourism, and positions Varanasi as a leader in adopting futuristic green technologies under India’s Maritime Vision 2030 and Amrit Kaal Vision 2047.

questions.question: On which date is the International Day Against Colonialism in All Its Forms and Manifestations observed by the United Nations?
questions.explanation: The United Nations has officially designated December 14 as the International Day Against Colonialism in All Its Forms and Manifestations through Resolution A/RES/80/106. First observed in 2025, the day reinforces the global commitment to ending colonialism and promoting the principles of sovereignty, self-determination, and human dignity. The observance builds upon the 1960 Declaration on the Granting of Independence to Colonial Countries and Peoples and highlights that colonialism, in political, economic, or cultural forms, continues to hinder development and equality. The day also supports the UN’s broader decolonization agenda under the Fourth International Decade for the Eradication of Colonialism (2021–2030).

questions.question: What was India’s global rank in the AI domain according to Stanford University’s Global AI Vibrancy Index?
questions.explanation: India secured the third position globally in Stanford University’s Global AI Vibrancy Index, reflecting its rapid progress in the artificial intelligence sector. This ranking represents a significant improvement from earlier years, as India had been placed seventh in 2023 before climbing to third in 2024. The index evaluates countries based on their competitiveness in AI, including research output, innovation, talent, and industry adoption. Achieving the third rank places India just behind the United States and China, highlighting its growing influence and capability in the global AI landscape.

questions.question: Which country won the WSF Squash World Cup 2025 for the first time in the tournament’s history?
questions.explanation: India achieved a landmark milestone by winning the WSF Squash World Cup 2025, marking its first-ever title in the history of the tournament. The historic victory came after a dominant 3–0 win over top-seeded Hong Kong in the final, held at the Express Avenue Mall in Chennai. This triumph highlights India’s growing strength and consistency in international squash. The WSF Squash World Cup is a prestigious global team event governed by the World Squash Federation, and winning it reflects India’s rising stature on the world squash stage.

questions.question: Which international financial institution approved a USD 240 million loan for the expansion of the Chennai Metro Rail network?
questions.explanation: The Asian Development Bank approved a USD 240 million loan to support the expansion of the Chennai Metro Rail network as part of a larger USD 780 million financing facility. This funding aims to improve urban mobility through the development of new metro lines and stations while promoting inclusivity, safety, and climate resilience. The project focuses on cleaner and more reliable public transport, disaster-resistant infrastructure, and long-term financial sustainability. ADB’s involvement reflects its broader role in supporting India’s urban infrastructure, low-carbon development, and inclusive growth objectives.

questions.question: By which year does Google plan to deploy prototype satellites for its Project Suncatcher initiative?
questions.explanation: Google’s Project Suncatcher is a long-term research initiative aimed at developing solar-powered data centres in space to meet rising AI-driven computing demands while reducing environmental impact. As part of this ambitious plan, Google intends to deploy prototype satellites by 2027. These satellites will form a distributed computing network powered entirely by solar energy, using advanced technologies such as Tensor Processing Units and laser-based optical communication links. The 2027 timeline reflects the complexity of developing space-ready hardware, ensuring radiation resistance, and establishing reliable inter-satellite communication systems for large-scale computing in orbit.

questions.question: What is the revised Foreign Direct Investment (FDI) limit in insurance companies approved by the Union Cabinet under the Insurance Amendment Bill, 2025?
questions.explanation: The Insurance Amendment Bill, 2025 introduces a major reform by increasing the permissible FDI limit in insurance companies to 100%. This change reflects the government’s intention to open the sector fully to foreign investment, which is expected to bring in substantial capital inflows. Higher foreign participation can enhance competition, encourage innovation, and improve the quality and reach of insurance services in India. The reform aligns with the regulatory framework governed by the Insurance Act, LIC Act, and IRDAI Act, strengthening the sector’s growth potential.

questions.question: Who secured a golden double in the Women’s and Junior Women’s Skeet events at the 68th National Shooting Championship Competitions?
questions.explanation: Raiza Dhillon delivered an exceptional performance at the 68th National Shooting Championship Competitions by winning gold medals in both the Women’s Skeet and Junior Women’s Skeet events. Competing at the Karni Singh Shooting Range in Tughlaqabad, the Olympian demonstrated consistency, precision, and composure under pressure. In the Women’s Skeet final, she scored 56 to clinch the top position. Achieving a golden double at a national-level championship highlights her technical excellence and strong competitive mindset, further establishing her as one of India’s prominent shooters in the skeet discipline.

questions.question: What is the name of the Indian Navy’s second MH-60R helicopter squadron to be commissioned at INS Hansa, Goa?
questions.explanation: The Indian Navy is set to commission INAS 335, known as the Ospreys, as its second squadron of MH-60R Seahawk multi-role helicopters at INS Hansa in Goa. This induction represents a significant step in strengthening India’s naval aviation capabilities. The MH-60R helicopters are equipped with advanced sensors, weapons, and avionics, enabling them to perform critical roles such as anti-submarine warfare, anti-surface warfare, maritime surveillance, and search and rescue. The squadron’s commissioning enhances maritime domain awareness and supports India’s broader naval modernisation and operational readiness efforts.

questions.question: Which institution conducted India’s first dedicated clinical trial of an advanced brain stent under the GRASSROOT trial?
questions.explanation: AIIMS Delhi played a pioneering role by conducting India’s first dedicated clinical trial of an advanced brain stent under the GRASSROOT trial. The trial evaluated the safety and efficacy of the indigenously developed Supernova stent for treating severe strokes, particularly large vessel occlusion cases. Conducted across multiple medical centres, the study produced high-quality clinical evidence that led to CDSCO approval based solely on domestic data. This achievement strengthened India’s medical research ecosystem, reduced reliance on foreign trials, and supported national initiatives such as Make in India and Atmanirbhar Bharat in the medical devices sector.

questions.question: Who was elected as the first woman President of the Press Club of India in its history?
questions.explanation: Sangeeta Barooah Pisharoty was elected as the first woman President of the Press Club of India, marking a historic milestone in the country’s media landscape. A senior journalist with extensive experience in political and investigative reporting, her election represents a breakthrough in gender representation within media leadership. Her panel secured a clean sweep in the 2025 elections with an overwhelming mandate, reflecting strong support from the journalistic community. Her leadership is expected to strengthen press freedom, promote ethical journalism, and address key concerns such as journalists’ rights, professional safety, and media independence in a rapidly evolving digital environment.

questions.question: What position did India secure in the Asia Power Index 2025 among Asia’s strongest nations?
questions.explanation: India achieved the 3rd position in the Asia Power Index 2025, marking a significant milestone in its regional and global standing. Published by the Lowy Institute, the index evaluates countries based on their ability to influence the Indo-Pacific through economic strength, military capability, diplomacy, and future resources. By crossing the 40-point threshold for the first time, India entered the category of a “Major Power,” placing it just behind the United States and China. This ranking reflects sustained progress in economic growth, defence preparedness, diplomacy, and long-term strategic potential.

questions.question: Which team secured its maiden Tennis Premier League title in Ahmedabad?
questions.explanation: GS Delhi emerged victorious by delivering a dominant performance in the Tennis Premier League final held in Ahmedabad. The team defeated Yash Mumbai Eagles with a convincing scoreline of 51–36 to claim their first-ever TPL title. A key contributor to this success was Belgian player Sofia Costoulas, who remained unbeaten and registered a commanding win in the women’s singles match. The mixed doubles pair of Costoulas and Jeevan Nedunchezhiyan further strengthened the team’s position by securing a decisive win, ensuring a comprehensive and memorable championship triumph for GS Delhi.

questions.question: In which state has India’s first wildlife-safe road on National Highway 45 been introduced by NHAI?
questions.explanation: Madhya Pradesh has become the first state in India to host a wildlife-safe highway developed by the National Highways Authority of India. The project is located on a stretch of NH-45 passing through a dense forest corridor near major wildlife habitats, including a tiger reserve and a wildlife sanctuary. Designed to reduce animal-vehicle collisions, the highway incorporates innovative features such as table-top red road markings, multiple wildlife underpasses, and guiding fences. Implemented under the Green Highways Policy, 2015, the initiative reflects a balance between infrastructure development and environmental conservation, setting a model for eco-sensitive road construction across forested regions of the country.

questions.question: Which state opened the strategic border sites of Cho La and Dok La for tourists under the Bharat Ranbhoomi Darshan initiative?
questions.explanation: Sikkim has taken a significant step in promoting border tourism by opening the strategically important Cho La and Dok La passes to tourists. The announcement was made by Chief Minister Prem Singh Tamang as part of the Bharat Ranbhoomi Darshan initiative. This programme, jointly supported by the Defence Ministry and the Tourism Ministry, aims to enhance public awareness about border regions, strengthen tourism infrastructure, and create livelihood opportunities for people living in remote border villages. By allowing controlled tourist access to these sensitive locations, the initiative also seeks to foster national pride and highlight the strategic importance of India’s border areas.

questions.question: Which country signed a tripartite Memorandum of Understanding with India for the maintenance of Scorpene-class submarines in December 2025?
questions.explanation: India strengthened its maritime and defence cooperation by signing a tripartite Memorandum of Understanding with Brazil for the maintenance of Scorpene-class submarines. The agreement was concluded during the official visit of Indian Navy Chief Admiral Dinesh K Tripathi in December 2025. It involves the Indian Navy, the Brazilian Navy, and Mazagon Dock Shipbuilders Limited. The MoU focuses on sharing technical knowledge, logistics support, training of personnel, and improving life-cycle management of submarines. Since both nations operate Scorpene-class submarines, the partnership enhances operational efficiency, long-term sustainment, and defence collaboration between two key maritime countries.

questions.question: Who was sworn in as the Chief Information Commissioner at Rashtrapati Bhavan?
questions.explanation: Raj Kumar Goyal was administered the oath of office as the Chief Information Commissioner at Rashtrapati Bhavan by the President of India, Droupadi Murmu. The oath-taking ceremony was attended by senior dignitaries, including Vice President C. P. Radhakrishnan and Minister of State for Personnel Jitendra Singh. A 1990-batch IAS officer from the AGMUT cadre, Goyal has previously served as Secretary in the Justice and Border Management departments. His appointment was recommended by a high-level selection committee headed by the Prime Minister, following a vacancy that arose in September 2025.

questions.question: Who has been appointed as the new Chairman-cum-Managing Director of Coal India Limited in December 2025?
questions.explanation: B. Sairam has been appointed as the Chairman-cum-Managing Director of Coal India Limited by the Ministry of Coal, effective from December 15, 2025. A seasoned mining engineer and alumnus of NIT Raipur, he brings over three decades of experience in the coal and mining sector. Prior to this role, he served as CMD of Northern Coalfields Limited, a key subsidiary of Coal India. His expertise spans mine operations, logistics, project planning, and regulatory affairs. The appointment is significant for India’s energy security, as Coal India plays a crucial role in supplying coal to the power and industrial sectors.

questions.question: Who has been appointed as the new Managing Director of the State Bank of India in December 2025?
questions.explanation: Ravi Ranjan has been appointed as the new Managing Director of the State Bank of India by the Government of India. A senior career banker, he was previously serving as Deputy Managing Director at SBI, where he handled important operational and strategic responsibilities. He succeeded Vinay M. Tonse and officially assumed charge following the government notification issued in December 2025. His tenure has been approved until his superannuation on 30 September 2028, ensuring leadership continuity at India’s largest public sector bank. The appointment is significant as SBI focuses on digital banking expansion, credit growth, asset quality management, and maintaining financial stability in a competitive banking environment.

questions.question: Who has been appointed as the new Director General of the National Council of Applied Economic Research (NCAER) from January 2026?
questions.explanation: Suresh Goyal has been appointed as the Director General of NCAER, one of India’s most respected economic policy think tanks. With more than three decades of experience across public and private sectors, he brings strong expertise in infrastructure finance, policy implementation, and strategic leadership. Prior to this role, he served as the Managing Director and CEO of the National Highway Infra Trust, supporting India’s National Monetisation Pipeline. As Director General, he is tasked with expanding NCAER’s research capabilities, setting up new policy centres, strengthening engagement with governments, and enhancing evidence-based policymaking to support India’s long-term economic growth objectives.

questions.question: Which country became the first in the world to receive UNESCO recognition for its entire national cuisine?
questions.explanation: Italy achieved a historic cultural distinction by becoming the first country to receive UNESCO recognition for its entire national cuisine. The recognition was granted in December 2025 when Italian cuisine was inscribed on UNESCO’s List of Intangible Cultural Heritage during the organisation’s cultural assembly held in Delhi. Unlike earlier recognitions that focused on individual dishes or culinary practices, this acknowledgment covers Italy’s complete food culture, including everyday cooking traditions, regional diversity, and shared social practices. The move highlights food as a living cultural expression that strengthens community bonds, preserves intergenerational knowledge, and reflects national identity on a global stage.

questions.question: Which state launched ‘Project Mahadeva’ to identify and nurture under-13 football talent?
questions.explanation: Maharashtra launched ‘Project Mahadeva’ as a major state-level sports development initiative aimed at strengthening grassroots football. The project was inaugurated by Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis at Mumbai’s iconic Wankhede Stadium. It is being implemented in collaboration with multiple organizations, including MITRA, VSTF, WIFA, CIDCO, and the state Sports Department. The launch event drew significant attention with the presence of global and national sports icons such as Lionel Messi, Sachin Tendulkar, and Sunil Chhetri. The initiative focuses on identifying young football talent under the age of 13 and supporting them through scholarships, access to international coaching, and comprehensive development programs.

questions.question: What was India’s overall unemployment rate in November for persons aged 15 years and above?
questions.explanation: India’s unemployment rate declined to 4.7% in November, marking the lowest level recorded since April for individuals aged 15 years and above. This improvement reflects a positive trend in the labour market as measured by the Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation under the Current Weekly Status framework. The decline was supported by easing unemployment in both rural and urban areas, alongside an increase in labour force participation. Rising workforce engagement and sectoral recovery contributed to improved employment conditions, indicating gradual strengthening of economic activity and job absorption across regions.

questions.question: What is the total number of Ramsar sites in India after the addition of Siliserh Lake and Kopra Jalashay?
questions.explanation: With the designation of Siliserh Lake and Kopra Jalashay, India’s total number of Ramsar sites has increased to 96. These additions marked the 95th and 96th entries to the internationally recognised list of wetlands of importance. Siliserh Lake, a historic man-made freshwater body built in 1845 in Rajasthan, serves as a crucial water source, while Kopra Jalashay gained distinction as the first Ramsar site in Chhattisgarh. The expansion reflects India’s growing commitment to wetland conservation, biodiversity protection, and sustainable management of vital aquatic ecosystems across different regions.

questions.question: Who was elected as the new President following Chile’s recent presidential election?
questions.explanation: Jose Antonio Kast emerged victorious in Chile’s presidential election, marking a significant political shift in the country. A right-wing and ultra-conservative leader, he secured a decisive win with 58.16% of the vote, defeating leftist candidate Jeannette Jara. His election reflects growing public concerns over rising crime, illegal migration, and internal security. Kast’s agenda focuses on strengthening border control, reducing organised violence, and stabilising the economy through fiscal discipline. His victory signals a broader rightward shift in Chile’s political landscape and may influence both domestic governance and the country’s future foreign and economic policies.

questions.question: In which city was the AYUSH Expo organised as part of the 2nd WHO Global Conference on Traditional Medicine?
questions.explanation: The AYUSH Expo was organised in New Delhi as a major component of the 2nd WHO Global Conference on Traditional Medicine. Hosted at Bharat Mandapam between December 17 and 19, 2024, the event was jointly organised by the Ministry of AYUSH and the World Health Organization. The expo highlighted India’s rich heritage of traditional medicine systems, including Ayurveda, Yoga, Unani, Siddha, Sowa-Rigpa, and Homeopathy. It also featured specialised pavilions and zones such as medicinal plants, spices, metallotherapeutics, wellness practices, and the Traditional Knowledge Digital Library, reinforcing India’s leadership in traditional healthcare knowledge.

questions.question: Which institution developed the nanoparticle-based multi-target therapy for Alzheimer’s disease?
questions.explanation: The Institute of Nano Science and Technology (INST) Mohali, operating under the Department of Science and Technology, has developed an advanced nanoparticle-based therapy aimed at treating Alzheimer’s disease through a multi-target approach. Unlike conventional treatments that focus on a single aspect of the disease, this innovative therapy integrates EGCG, dopamine, and tryptophan within engineered nanoparticles. The formulation simultaneously addresses multiple pathological features of Alzheimer’s, including amyloid plaque accumulation, oxidative stress, inflammation, and neuronal degeneration. This comprehensive strategy enhances therapeutic effectiveness and represents a significant advancement in neurodegenerative disease research.

questions.question: Which railway station received the National Energy Conservation Award 2025 in the Best Transport Category?
questions.explanation: Miyana Railway Station in Guna district of Madhya Pradesh was honoured with the National Energy Conservation Award 2025, presented by President Droupadi Murmu. The station was recognised under the Best Transport Category for its significant efforts in reducing electricity consumption. By adopting energy-efficient technologies such as LED lighting, BLDC fans, and smart lighting systems, the station achieved savings of 9,687 electricity units. This achievement reflects the broader commitment of Indian Railways towards sustainable practices, cost efficiency, and environmentally responsible operations, as highlighted by the Bureau of Energy Efficiency through this national-level recognition.

questions.question: Which city coordinated the Army initiative to fast-track indigenous drone systems through the 515 Army Base Workshop?
questions.explanation: The initiative to accelerate the development and induction of indigenous drone systems for the Indian Army was coordinated through the 515 Army Base Workshop located in Secunderabad. This effort aligns with the Atmanirbhar Bharat vision by promoting self-reliance in defence technology and reducing dependence on imports. The Memorandum of Understanding focuses on advancing IC engine-based drones and enhancing operational capability in GPS-denied environments. By streamlining the process from evaluation to induction, the partnership supports quicker deployment of unmanned systems, strengthening the Army’s land-based operational readiness and technological capabilities.

questions.question: Which country conferred its highest civilian honour, the Great Honour Nishan, on Prime Minister Narendra Modi?
questions.explanation: Prime Minister Narendra Modi was conferred The Great Honour Nishan of Ethiopia, the highest civilian award of Ethiopia, during his official visit to Addis Ababa. With this recognition, he became the first global Head of State or Government to receive the prestigious honour, highlighting India’s expanding diplomatic influence, particularly in Africa and the Global South. The award, presented by Ethiopian Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed Ali, marked PM Modi’s 28th international state honour. It reflects the deep historical, cultural, and educational ties between India and Ethiopia and underscores the strengthening strategic partnership between the two nations.

questions.question: Which company launched its first-ever global credit card in India on the RuPay network?
questions.explanation: Google launched its first-ever global credit card in India, marking a significant milestone in the country’s digital payments landscape. Issued in partnership with Axis Bank and operating on the RuPay network, the card is integrated with Google Pay and can be directly linked to UPI for merchant payments. This enables users to make seamless credit-based UPI transactions, a feature not supported by Visa or Mastercard cards. The card also introduces an instant rewards system, allowing users to redeem benefits immediately after each transaction, highlighting India’s growing leadership in fintech innovation and digital payment solutions.

questions.question: Which global banking giant announced plans to set up Asia’s largest Global Capability Centre in India?
questions.explanation: JP Morgan announced its plan to establish Asia’s largest Global Capability Centre in India, marking a significant milestone in the country’s global services landscape. The centre will be located in Powai, Mumbai, spread across 2 million square feet, and is expected to employ around 30,000 people by 2029. This move highlights India’s growing importance as a hub for banking, financial services, and technology-driven operations. It also reflects global corporations’ confidence in India’s skilled workforce, cost efficiency, and robust digital ecosystem, further strengthening the nation’s position in global finance.

questions.question: What was India’s rank in the Global Investment Risk and Resilience Index 2025?
questions.explanation: The Global Investment Risk and Resilience Index 2025 measures how well countries can withstand and manage investment-related risks arising from geopolitical uncertainty, economic volatility, technological disruption, and climate challenges. India was ranked 104th in this index, indicating a relatively lower level of resilience compared to many other nations assessed. While countries such as Switzerland topped the rankings due to strong institutional stability and investor-friendly environments, India’s position reflects ongoing challenges related to infrastructure, regulatory consistency, and risk mitigation. This ranking serves as an indicator of areas where policy reforms and economic strengthening could improve investor confidence.

questions.question: Which airline won the Best Domestic Airline title at the Travel + Leisure India & South Asia Awards 2025?
questions.explanation: Air India was awarded the Best Domestic Airline title at the Travel + Leisure India & South Asia Awards 2025 for the second consecutive year. The recognition is significant as it is entirely based on reader and passenger votes, reflecting real travel experiences rather than jury assessments. The award highlights growing customer trust in Air India during its large-scale transformation phase, which includes fleet modernization, improved onboard comfort, enhanced service quality, and better operational reliability. With major investments such as large aircraft orders and fleet upgrades, the airline is strengthening its domestic market credibility and working toward becoming a world-class aviation brand.

questions.question: On which date is Minorities Rights Day observed in India?
questions.explanation: Minorities Rights Day is observed in India on December 18 to highlight the importance of protecting and promoting the rights of minority communities. The day commemorates the United Nations’ 1992 declaration on minority rights and has been observed in India since 2013 under the National Commission for Minorities. It emphasizes safeguarding constitutional provisions, particularly Articles 29 and 30, which ensure cultural, linguistic, and educational rights. The observance promotes inclusion, equality, and safety while recognizing the social, cultural, and economic contributions of the six officially notified minority communities in the country.

questions.question: Which country signed an official visa waiver pact with India to ease official travel under the Strategic Partnership Council framework?
questions.explanation: India and Saudi Arabia entered into a bilateral visa waiver agreement aimed at facilitating smoother official travel between the two nations. The pact provides mutual short-term visa exemptions for holders of diplomatic, special, and official passports, reducing administrative barriers for government officials. Signed in Riyadh under the Strategic Partnership Council framework, the agreement reflects deepening diplomatic ties and growing cooperation across sectors such as trade, energy, defense, and people-to-people exchanges. By simplifying travel procedures, the initiative is expected to enhance institutional dialogue, accelerate joint initiatives, and further strengthen the long-standing strategic relationship between India and Saudi Arabia.

questions.question: Where were the FIFA Best Football Awards 2025 held?
questions.explanation: The FIFA Best Football Awards 2025 ceremony took place in Doha, Qatar, marking the city’s growing prominence as a global hub for major sporting events. Doha has previously hosted several international tournaments and conferences, supported by world-class infrastructure and facilities. The awards recognized outstanding football achievements over the past year, including individual honours for top male and female players. Hosting the event in Doha highlights FIFA’s efforts to expand football’s global reach and celebrate excellence in diverse regions, while also reinforcing Qatar’s role in international sports following successful large-scale events in recent years.

questions.question: When is Bharat Taxi expected to roll out fully in Delhi?
questions.explanation: Bharat Taxi is scheduled for its full-scale rollout in Delhi in January 2026, marking a significant development in India’s ride-hailing sector. After pilot operations in Delhi and parts of Gujarat in December 2025, the platform plans to expand operations with a cooperative, driver-owned model. Its zero-commission approach, at least in the initial phase, aims to improve driver earnings and welfare while offering affordable and transparent pricing for passengers. The January 2026 rollout is expected to intensify competition with established players like Ola and Uber, potentially reshaping the dynamics of the urban mobility market in India.

questions.question: On which date is International Migrants Day observed globally?
questions.explanation: International Migrants Day is observed every year on December 18 to recognize and highlight the rights, contributions, and challenges of migrants across the world. The day was proclaimed by the United Nations General Assembly in 2000 to commemorate the adoption of the 1990 International Convention on the Protection of the Rights of All Migrant Workers and Members of Their Families. It draws attention to the cultural, social, and economic contributions made by nearly 272 million international migrants globally, including millions of displaced persons, while also promoting awareness about migration-related issues and inclusive development.

questions.question: Which digital payment platform introduced PIN-free UPI payments using biometric authentication in India?
questions.explanation: Amazon Pay introduced a PIN-free UPI payment feature in India that allows users to authenticate transactions through fingerprint or facial recognition on Android devices. Launched on 16 December 2025, this facility supports transactions up to ₹5,000 and covers services such as Send Money, Scan & Pay, and merchant payments. By relying on device-bound biometrics that remain securely stored on the user’s phone, the feature enhances convenience, speed, and security. This innovation aims to simplify digital payments, promote one-handed usage, and encourage wider adoption of UPI-based transactions.

questions.question: Which company emerged as the world’s most valuable company in the Hurun Global 1000 Report 2025?
questions.explanation: The Hurun Global 1000 Report 2025 ranks the world’s 1,000 most valuable companies and reflects major shifts in global corporate leadership. In this edition, Nvidia secured the top position, surpassing long-time leaders such as Microsoft and Apple. Nvidia’s rise has been driven by its dominance in advanced semiconductor technology, particularly in graphics processing units and artificial intelligence applications. The growing global demand for AI-driven solutions, data centers, and high-performance computing significantly boosted the company’s valuation. This achievement highlights the increasing importance of technology and innovation in shaping the global economic landscape.

questions.question: Which country signed the Agricultural Research Work Plan 2025–27 with India to strengthen cooperation in agronomy and technology exchange?
questions.explanation: India and Argentina entered into a Work Plan for 2025–27 aimed at enhancing collaboration in agricultural research and technology exchange. The agreement was signed in New Delhi and involves cooperation between the Indian Council of Agricultural Research and Argentina’s National Institute of Agricultural Technology. Key focus areas include sustainable agronomy, efficient natural resource management, zero tillage practices, agricultural mechanisation, micro-irrigation, fertigation techniques, and germplasm exchange. This partnership is designed to promote innovation, improve farm productivity, and support sustainable agricultural development in both countries through shared expertise and advanced research practices.

questions.question: Which company commissioned the Khavda II-B inter-state transmission project to evacuate 4.5 GW of renewable energy from Gujarat’s Khavda region?
questions.explanation: Power Grid commissioned the Khavda II-B inter-state transmission project to facilitate the evacuation of 4.5 GW of renewable energy from the Khavda region of Gujarat, one of India’s largest renewable energy hubs. The project was implemented through Power Grid’s subsidiary under the Tariff-Based Competitive Bidding (TBCB) route and achieved commercial operation from December 13. This transmission system plays a crucial role in strengthening India’s interstate power grid by enabling the large-scale integration of solar and wind energy, supporting the country’s renewable energy expansion and long-term clean energy goals.

questions.question: Where was Jammu & Kashmir’s first Gen Z Post Office inaugurated as part of India Post’s initiative to modernise campus-based postal services?
questions.explanation: AIIMS Vijaypur became the location for Jammu & Kashmir’s first Gen Z Post Office, reflecting India Post’s strategy to modernise postal services within educational and institutional campuses. The Gen Z Post Office model focuses on youth-centric, technology-enabled services designed to meet the expectations of younger users. AIIMS Vijaypur also earned the distinction of being the first AIIMS in the country to host such a facility. Alongside this, India Post expanded the concept further by launching its first Gen G Post Office in Karnataka at Acharya Institute of Technology, Bengaluru, highlighting a parallel effort to create inclusive, community-focused postal service hubs for the general population.

questions.question: Which state is set to host the Regional AI Impact Conference on December 19–20 to promote AI-driven governance and public service reforms?
questions.explanation: Odisha is hosting the Regional AI Impact Conference on December 19–20, positioning itself as a key player in India’s evolving artificial intelligence ecosystem. The conference focuses on the application of AI in governance and public services, with emphasis on sustainability, inclusive growth, and technology-led reforms. It aligns with the larger India AI Impact Summit 2026 and follows Odisha’s proactive AI roadmap under the Odisha AI Policy 2025. Guided by the theme of “Planet, People and Progress,” the event highlights AI use across sectors such as health, education, disaster management, and social welfare, reinforcing Odisha’s vision of becoming a future-ready AI hub.

questions.question: In which state were MoUs worth ₹13,000 crore signed for setting up pumped storage power projects under the Pump Storage Project Promotion Policy, 2025?
questions.explanation: Bihar emerged as the focus of major pumped storage power investments after BSPGCL signed two MoUs with private developers for projects totaling 2,120 MW capacity in the Nawada district. The combined investment amounts to about ₹13,000 crore and falls under the Bihar Pump Storage Project Promotion Policy, 2025. Under these agreements, GreenCo Energies will develop a 1,200 MW project with an investment of ₹7,800 crore, while Sun Petrochemicals will set up a 920 MW project costing ₹5,200 crore. These projects are expected to strengthen energy storage capacity and support grid stability.

questions.question: Which institution, along with the Government of India, launched the #OneRRBOneLogo initiative to provide a unified brand identity to all Regional Rural Banks?
questions.explanation: NABARD played a key role in launching the #OneRRBOneLogo initiative in collaboration with the Government of India.
