questions.question: Who was sworn in as the United States Ambassador to India on November 11, 2025?
questions.explanation: Sergio Gor assumed office as the United States Ambassador to India on November 11, 2025, marking a notable moment in the expanding Indo-US relationship. At 38, he brings extensive experience from his previous role as Director of Presidential Personnel in the Trump administration, where he oversaw significant staffing decisions and strategic coordination. His appointment was confirmed by the US Senate in October 2025, and his swearing-in ceremony at the Oval Office was attended by top US leadership, reflecting the importance of the India-US partnership. Gor aims to strengthen cooperation in defence, regional security, trade, technology, and supply chain resilience.

questions.question: Who was the 114-year-old Padma Shri environmentalist known for planting hundreds of banyan trees?
questions.explanation: Saalumarada Thimmakka was an iconic environmentalist admired for her extraordinary contribution to afforestation. She became widely known for planting 385 banyan trees along a 4.5-kilometre stretch, a feat that earned her the name “Saalumarada,” meaning a row of trees. Over her long lifetime, she received numerous prestigious recognitions, including the Padma Shri in 2019, the Nadoja Award in 2010, the National Citizen Award in 1995, and the Indira Priyadarshini Vrikshamitra Award in 1997. Her work became a symbol of dedication to nature conservation, inspiring many to engage in environmental protection and sustainable practices.

questions.question: Which company plans to set up India’s largest 10 GW solar wafers and ingots manufacturing plant?
questions.explanation: Tata Power has announced a major step toward strengthening India’s renewable energy manufacturing ecosystem by planning a 10 GW solar wafers and ingots plant. This facility will complete the company’s solar manufacturing chain, as it already operates around 4.9 GW of integrated cell and module production capacity. By moving into upstream components such as ingots and wafers, the company aims to reduce the nation’s reliance on imports and support the Make-in-India initiative. The project also aligns with government incentives promoting domestic manufacturing and clean energy. Once operational, it will significantly enhance India’s capability to build a self-reliant solar supply chain.

questions.question: What is the name of the AI-based system introduced by Indian Railways to monitor wagon door locking status in real time?
questions.explanation: The Indian Railways has introduced an advanced AI-powered system called DRISHTI to enhance the safety and monitoring of freight operations. This system uses real-time surveillance supported by computer vision technology to keep track of the locking status of wagon doors, ensuring better security and operational efficiency. DRISHTI was created through collaborative innovation between the Northeast Frontier Railway (NFR) and IIT Guwahati – TIDF. By integrating artificial intelligence with railway logistics, the system aims to reduce human error, improve monitoring accuracy, and offer a proactive approach to safeguarding freight movement across the network.

questions.question: Who was felicitated by the UP Police for her achievements in the Women’s ODI World Cup?
questions.explanation: Deepti Sharma, who earned the title of Player of the Tournament in the Women’s ODI World Cup, was honoured at the UP Police Headquarters in Gomtinagar Extension. Her recognition reflects her outstanding contributions to Indian cricket as well as her commitment to public service, having recently joined the Uttar Pradesh Police as a Deputy Superintendent of Police under the sports quota. DGP Rajeev Krishna commended her for bringing pride to both the state and the nation. This felicitation highlights the growing support for athletes who excel internationally while also serving in administrative or public roles.

questions.question: Which countries will jointly host the 2026 FIH Hockey World Cup?
questions.explanation: Belgium and the Netherlands have been selected to jointly host the 2026 FIH Hockey World Cup, creating the first-ever edition that is both dual-host and dual-gender. The event will take place from 15–30 August 2026 and will feature tournaments for both men and women. Additionally, this edition introduces the first ParaHockey World Cup, expanding inclusivity within the sport. The competition format has also been updated to include 16 teams per gender, with a system that allows top teams to carry forward results into a second group stage, ultimately determining the semi-finalists.

questions.question: What is the new reduced GI tag application fee aimed at supporting tribal artisans and traditional crafts?
questions.explanation: The government has lowered the Geographical Indication (GI) tag application fee from ₹5,000 to ₹1,000 to make the process more accessible for tribal artisans and those engaged in traditional crafts. This reduction is intended to encourage more communities to register their unique products, thereby helping preserve cultural heritage and promoting regional identity. GI tags play an essential role in safeguarding items whose reputation, quality, or characteristics are linked to their place of origin. Products such as Kannadippaya, Apatani textile, Marthandam honey, Lepcha Tungbuk, Bodo Aronai, Ambaji Marble, and Badri cow ghee exemplify this cultural and geographical significance.

questions.question: Where was the 30th CII Partnership Summit 2025 inaugurated?
questions.explanation: The 30th CII Partnership Summit 2025 was inaugurated in Visakhapatnam, a major industrial and port city in Andhra Pradesh. This location was chosen as the state is emerging as a fast-growing investment hub with strong support from both the central and state governments. The summit brought together global delegates, industry leaders and policymakers to deepen discussions around trade, technology and investment. With over 2,500 participants from 77 countries, the event highlighted Andhra Pradesh’s ambition to accelerate economic growth through sectors like drones, aerospace, semiconductors and defence. Visakhapatnam served as a strategic venue showcasing the region’s potential, infrastructure and investor-friendly governance.

questions.question: What was the year-on-year bank credit growth reported for October 2025?
questions.explanation: The bank credit growth for October 2025 stood at 11.3%, reflecting a slowdown in lending activity across the financial sector. This moderation is linked to factors such as reduced loan demand, cautious lending behaviour by banks, and broader global economic uncertainties. Slower credit growth can impact industries, MSMEs, NBFCs and retail borrowers by delaying investment cycles and affecting expansion plans. Meanwhile, deposit growth accelerated, creating a liquidity surplus that may pressure banks to rethink their strategies for deploying funds efficiently. The 11.3% figure is significant because it highlights a pivotal shift in India’s credit-deposit dynamics and signals potential policy considerations ahead.

questions.question: In which country did the Indian Air Force contingent arrive to participate in the Garuda-2025 air exercise?
questions.explanation: The Indian Air Force contingent arrived in France to take part in the Garuda-2025 air exercise held at the Mont-de-Marsan Air Base. This bilateral exercise is an important symbol of the deep strategic cooperation between India and France, particularly in the area of defence and aviation. The drill involves frontline fighter aircraft from both nations, enhancing interoperability and strengthening mutual operational capabilities. The exercise also helps Indian pilots gain exposure to advanced tactics, mission planning frameworks, and logistical environments of the French Air and Space Force. Such engagements further reinforce a long-standing partnership rooted in technology, trust and shared strategic goals.

questions.question: How many seats did the NDA win in the 2025 Bihar Assembly Elections?
questions.explanation: The NDA secured a decisive victory in the 2025 Bihar Assembly Elections by winning 202 out of 243 seats, far surpassing the required majority. This overwhelming mandate reflected a combination of strong political organization, effective campaigning, and significant support from key voter groups, especially women and youth. The impressive female voter turnout, which reached a historic high, played a crucial role in boosting the alliance’s performance. The BJP emerged as the single-largest party, and the combined strength of its partners further solidified the alliance’s dominance, marking a major shift in Bihar’s political landscape.

questions.question: On which date is Janjatiya Gaurav Divas observed each year in India?
questions.explanation: Janjatiya Gaurav Divas is observed annually on November 15 to honour the birth anniversary of Birsa Munda, one of India’s most revered tribal freedom fighters. The date holds deep historical and cultural importance because Birsa Munda played a transformative role in mobilizing tribal communities against British oppression, advocating for land rights, autonomy, and preservation of indigenous identity. The observance highlights the contributions of tribal leaders, promotes awareness of their struggles, and reinforces national recognition of tribal heritage. This day serves as a reminder of the sacrifices made by numerous tribal warriors whose stories remain integral to India’s freedom narrative.

questions.question: What is the planned depth for India’s upcoming world’s deepest underwater research laboratory?
questions.explanation: India is undertaking an ambitious deep-ocean initiative by planning to build the world’s deepest underwater research laboratory at a depth of 6,000 metres. This project, part of the Vision 2047 roadmap, aims to establish a pioneering habitat capable of supporting long-term scientific research in extreme marine environments. Such a facility would enable breakthroughs in studying deep-sea biodiversity, geological processes, biotechnology, and human endurance under immense pressure. With advanced materials, specialised life-support systems, and docking bays for submersibles, the lab is designed to operate in one of Earth’s most challenging zones. This achievement would position India as a global leader in deep-sea exploration and marine innovation.

questions.question: Who will take over as the new President and CEO of Walmart Inc. from February 1, 2026?
questions.explanation: John Furner has been chosen to take over as the President and CEO of Walmart Inc. starting February 1, 2026, marking an important leadership transition for the global retail giant. Furner brings decades of experience within Walmart, having started as an hourly associate in 1993 before rising through various leadership positions, including CEO of Sam’s Club and CEO of Walmart U.S. His appointment reflects Walmart’s strategy of nurturing internal talent and ensuring continuity as the company continues to focus on omnichannel expansion, technological upgrades, and operational resilience. This transition follows Doug McMillon’s highly impactful decade-long tenure, during which Walmart strengthened its global presence and digital capabilities.

questions.question: What is India’s rank in the Henley Passport Index 2025?
questions.explanation: India holds the 85th position in the Henley Passport Index 2025, reflecting a decline of five places compared to the previous year. This rank is based on the number of destinations Indian passport holders can visit without a prior visa, which currently stands at 57. The lower ranking highlights challenges in expanding bilateral visa agreements and slower diplomatic progress relative to rapidly advancing nations in Asia and the Gulf. As global mobility becomes increasingly competitive, India’s passport strength has not kept pace with its expanding economic and geopolitical ambitions, emphasizing the need for greater diplomatic efforts and international partnerships.

questions.question: What is India’s global position as a patent filer according to the latest announcement?
questions.explanation: India has reached the 6th position globally in patent filings, marking a major leap in its innovation journey. With over 64,000 patent applications submitted—more than half by resident innovators—the country is strengthening its intellectual property ecosystem. This rise reflects the impact of a vibrant start-up culture, supportive government policies, and increased emphasis on applied sciences and skill development. The improvement in India’s rank on the Global Innovation Index, from 81st to 38th, further reinforces this upward trajectory. Collectively, these achievements demonstrate India’s transition from being primarily a consumer of technology to an emerging global creator and contributor in research, innovation and IP generation.

questions.question: Which Indian state earned global recognition as its Puri and Sunapur beaches received Blue Flag certification for 2025–26?
questions.explanation: Odisha earned significant international recognition when its Puri and Sunapur beaches once again secured the prestigious Blue Flag certification for 2025–26. This achievement reflects the state’s commitment to maintaining high environmental standards, clean coastlines, and sustainable tourism practices. Both beaches have consistently demonstrated excellence through strict waste-management systems, water-quality monitoring, eco-education initiatives, and community participation. Puri Golden Beach has earned this certification multiple times, while Sunapur Beach continues to strengthen its reputation for conservation-oriented development. These recognitions reinforce Odisha’s growing leadership in eco-friendly tourism and showcase India’s broader efforts to promote sustainable coastal destinations.

questions.question: Which country participated with India in the 7th Ministerial Dialogue on Trade and Investment to enhance bilateral economic engagement?
questions.explanation: India engaged with Canada in the 7th Ministerial Dialogue on Trade and Investment to advance cooperation across various strategic sectors. The meeting focused on deepening collaboration in critical minerals, clean energy, aerospace, and dual-use technologies—areas that are increasingly important for both economic growth and security. The dialogue also emphasised the need for resilient and diversified supply chains, particularly in agriculture, to support long-term economic stability. Through such dialogues, both nations aim to build a stronger partnership that promotes trade expansion, technology sharing, and sustainable development, reflecting their shared commitment to mutually beneficial economic ties.

questions.question: What was India’s Labour Force Participation Rate (LFPR) for individuals aged 15+ in October, marking a six-month high?
questions.explanation: India’s Labour Force Participation Rate (LFPR) for people aged 15 and above reached 55.4% in October, reflecting a sustained rise over four consecutive months. This figure represents the proportion of individuals who are either working or actively seeking work and is measured under the Current Weekly Status (CWS). The improvement highlights growing engagement in the labour market, particularly in rural regions where participation rose to 57.8%. Although urban participation saw a minor dip to 50.5%, the overall national increase signals strengthening economic activity, broader employment opportunities, and a gradual recovery in workforce involvement across different regions and sectors.

questions.question: Who has been appointed as the new part-time chairman of J&K Bank?
questions.explanation: S Krishnan, a highly experienced banking professional, has been appointed as the part-time chairman of J&K Bank for the term spanning November 13, 2025, to March 26, 2028. His extensive background includes serving as Managing Director and CEO of Punjab & Sind Bank as well as Tamilnad Mercantile Bank, where he contributed significantly to restructuring, digital expansion, and operational improvements. As an existing independent director on the board of J&K Bank, he brings valuable insights into the bank’s functioning. His appointment is expected to enhance governance, strengthen compliance frameworks, and support financial inclusion and digital initiatives across Jammu & Kashmir and neighboring regions.

questions.question: Which state has been directed by the Supreme Court to declare the Saranda Forest as a wildlife sanctuary?
questions.explanation: The Supreme Court has instructed the state of Jharkhand to officially designate the Saranda Forest as a wildlife sanctuary, recognizing its exceptional ecological and cultural importance. Saranda, located in the West Singhbhum district, is Asia’s largest natural Sal forest and a habitat for numerous endangered species such as the sal forest tortoise, four-horned antelope, Asian palm civet, and wild elephants. It also sustains several Adivasi communities whose livelihoods and cultural heritage are intertwined with the forest. The sanctuary status will provide legal protection under the Wildlife Protection Act, 1972, helping control mining pressures, prevent habitat loss, and promote sustainable conservation practices involving local communities.

questions.question: In which year is ISRO’s Chandrayaan-4 lunar sample-return mission scheduled to be launched?
questions.explanation: Chandrayaan-4, India’s first lunar sample-return mission, is scheduled for launch in 2028 as part of ISRO’s expanded roadmap for deep space exploration. The mission is expected to collect and bring back lunar soil and rock samples, placing India among the few nations capable of executing such a technically advanced operation. The timeline aligns with ISRO’s broader goals, which include tripling spacecraft production, increasing launch frequency, advancing human spaceflight through the Gaganyaan program, and establishing the initial module of an Indian Space Station by 2028. These efforts collectively strengthen India’s scientific capabilities and elevate its position in the global space sector.

questions.question: Which country launched Operation SOUTHERN SPEAR to target narco-terrorists?
questions.explanation: Operation SOUTHERN SPEAR was launched by the United States to counter narco-terrorist networks operating across Latin America. The initiative is overseen by the U.S. Southern Command (SOUTHCOM), which supervises a broad region covering South America, Central America, and the Caribbean. The operation focuses on disrupting criminal organizations, dismantling drug-trafficking operations, and strengthening security partnerships throughout the Western Hemisphere. By targeting these transnational threats, the effort aims to safeguard regional stability and protect the U.S. homeland. The mission underscores the strategic importance of collaborative security measures and highlights ongoing efforts to confront complex criminal and terrorist networks operating across international borders.

questions.question: Which traditional white stone from Gujarat has recently been granted a Geographical Indication (GI) Tag?
questions.explanation: Ambaji Marble, primarily found in the Banaskantha district of north Gujarat, has earned recognition through the grant of a Geographical Indication (GI) Tag. This marble is renowned for its milky white appearance, high calcium content, and exceptional durability. Its mining heritage dates back over a thousand years and is associated with the construction period of the iconic Dilwara Jain Temple in Mount Abu. The GI Tag not only acknowledges its unique qualities and historical relevance but also helps preserve its identity while promoting regional craftsmanship. This recognition supports local miners, enhances market value, and protects the stone from imitation.

questions.question: On which date is National Press Day celebrated in India?
questions.explanation: National Press Day is observed annually on November 16 to commemorate the establishment of the Press Council of India, an institution created to preserve the freedom of the press and maintain high journalistic standards. The day highlights the importance of an independent and responsible media in a democratic society. Various laws and reforms, including the Working Journalists Act of 1955 and the more recent Press and Registration of Periodicals Act 2023, help safeguard journalist rights and modernise media governance. Initiatives like the Press Sewa Portal further enhance transparency and streamline the registration of periodicals, contributing to a more efficient and accountable media ecosystem.

questions.question: Which cricketer became the fourth player in Test history to achieve the milestone of 4000 runs and 300+ wickets?
questions.explanation: Ravindra Jadeja achieved a rare all-rounder milestone by becoming only the fourth cricketer in Test history to record over 4000 runs and 300-plus wickets. This remarkable accomplishment places him in an elite group that includes Kapil Dev, Ian Botham, and Daniel Vettori. Jadeja reached the milestone during the India vs South Africa Test match held at Eden Gardens, showcasing his consistency, skill, and longevity in the longest format of the game. His contributions extend beyond batting and bowling, as he is also celebrated for his exceptional fielding. This achievement further solidifies his standing as one of the greatest modern all-rounders in international cricket.

questions.question: On which date is International Students’ Day observed each year?
questions.explanation: International Students’ Day is observed annually on November 17 to honour the courage and sacrifice of Czech students who stood against Nazi oppression in 1939. The day marks the brutal crackdown in Prague, during which nine student leaders were executed, more than 1,200 students were deported to concentration camps, and all Czech universities were shut down. Declared officially in 1941 by the International Students’ Council in London, the observance is significant because it is the only global day dedicated exclusively to students. It highlights the importance of academic freedom, student rights, and the enduring role of youth in resisting injustice and promoting social change.

questions.question: Which country has been inducted as the 5th member of the Colombo Security Conclave?
questions.explanation: Bangladesh recently became the 5th member of the Colombo Security Conclave, an evolving regional security platform aimed at strengthening maritime cooperation and collaborative security efforts in the Indian Ocean region. The Conclave initially grew out of a trilateral security framework involving India, Sri Lanka, and the Maldives, established to coordinate maritime activities and address emerging security challenges. Over time, the group expanded to include Mauritius as a member and Seychelles as an observer, reflecting its growing strategic importance. With Bangladesh joining, the Conclave now represents a broader coalition committed to regional stability, enhanced information sharing, and coordinated responses to common security concerns.

questions.question: On which date will India observe National Epilepsy Day in 2025?
questions.explanation: National Epilepsy Day 2025 in India will be observed on November 17, a day dedicated to educating the public about epilepsy, its symptoms, and available treatments. The observance aims to dispel long-standing myths and stigma surrounding the condition by promoting awareness and understanding. Healthcare institutions, neurologists, and volunteer organisations conduct workshops, awareness drives, and health camps to highlight the importance of early diagnosis and consistent treatment. Since epilepsy affects millions globally and a significant number in India, this day plays a crucial role in encouraging timely medical consultation, reducing discrimination, and strengthening community support for individuals living with epilepsy.

questions.question: What GDP growth rate is projected for India in Q2 FY26 according to ICRA?
questions.explanation: ICRA has projected that India’s GDP growth for Q2 FY26 will moderate to 7%, reflecting a slowdown from the stronger 7.8% expansion recorded in Q1. This deceleration is linked to weaker performances in the services and agriculture sectors, despite encouraging industrial output supported by festive demand, GST rate cuts, and inventory stocking. Additional factors contributing to the easing pace include lower government expenditure, moderation in services exports, and weather-related disruptions affecting agricultural yields. Although industry remained a bright spot, the combined drag from services, agriculture, and fiscal trends indicates a softer overall growth outlook for the quarter.

questions.question: In which city was the Asian Archery Championships 2025 held?
questions.explanation: The Asian Archery Championships 2025 took place in Dhaka, the capital city of Bangladesh, where India performed exceptionally well by winning a total of ten medals. These included six gold, three silver, and one bronze across various categories, particularly excelling in compound events with strong showings in both individual and team competitions. Hosting the event in Dhaka provided a competitive platform for archers from across the continent to showcase their skills. India’s success at this edition also reflected an improvement compared to its previous performance in 2023, where it had secured seven medals.

questions.question: From which country will India import 2.2 million tonnes of LPG under the newly signed one-year deal?
questions.explanation: India has entered into a one-year agreement to import a substantial quantity of LPG from the United States, amounting to 2.2 million tonnes annually. The deal was finalized after officials from major Indian oil companies—IOC, BPCL, and HPCL—held detailed discussions with leading American producers along the US Gulf Coast. This arrangement strengthens India’s energy security by diversifying supply sources and reducing dependence on traditional exporters. It also reflects growing strategic and commercial ties between India and the U.S. in the energy sector, ensuring a stable supply of LPG for domestic consumption and supporting the country’s broader energy needs.

questions.question: Who defeated Carlos Alcaraz to win the ATP Finals title in Turin?
questions.explanation: Jannik Sinner secured the ATP Finals title in Turin by defeating World No. 1 Carlos Alcaraz in a highly anticipated match. Ranked World No. 2, Sinner showcased exceptional form and composure, earning an important victory in front of his home crowd in Italy. This win marked his sixth meeting with Alcaraz in the year and his second triumph against him, with the previous one coming in the Wimbledon final. The result further elevated Sinner’s stature in the tennis world, adding to his growing list of achievements, while Alcaraz continues to hold an impressive record with six Grand Slam titles.

questions.question: What is the name of the first Mahe-class Anti-Submarine Warfare Shallow Water Craft whose crest was recently unveiled by the Indian Navy?
questions.explanation: INS Mahe is the first vessel of the indigenously developed Mahe-class Anti-Submarine Warfare Shallow Water Craft, designed to strengthen India’s coastal defence and underwater threat-neutralisation capabilities. The ship derives its name from the historic coastal town of Mahe, reflecting India’s maritime heritage and cultural identity. Its crest features the Urumi, a traditional flexible sword symbolising stealth, agility, and precision—qualities essential for shallow-water ASW operations. Complemented by rising waves that represent maritime vigilance, the crest highlights the Indian Navy’s fusion of combat readiness and cultural symbolism. As part of India’s Aatmanirbhar Bharat vision, the Mahe-class underscores advances in indigenous warship design, sonar systems, and coastal security preparedness.

questions.question: Who was honoured with the Chevalier de l’Ordre des Arts et des Lettres by the French government in 2025?
questions.explanation: Thota Tharani, one of India’s most distinguished art directors and production designers, received the Chevalier de l’Ordre des Arts et des Lettres in 2025 for his exceptional contribution to cinema and visual arts. His career spans over four decades, during which he has shaped the visual identity of numerous iconic films across multiple languages. His mastery in crafting culturally immersive and historically accurate sets has elevated film aesthetics in Indian cinema. The award recognises his impact not only within India but also on the global arts landscape, placing him among other renowned Indian recipients who have enriched artistic expression through their craft.

questions.question: By what percentage did the government increase print media advertisement rates?
questions.explanation: The government implemented a 26% rise in print media advertisement rates to provide stronger financial backing to the industry. This adjustment, based on recommendations from the 9th Rate Structure Committee, updates the cost per square centimetre for black-and-white advertisements in newspapers with a circulation of one lakh copies. The revision helps the sector cope with operational challenges, sustain its revenue streams, and remain competitive in a rapidly evolving media environment.

questions.question: Who won the 2025 MotoGP finale at the Valencia Grand Prix?
questions.explanation: Marco Bezzecchi delivered a landmark performance by winning the 2025 MotoGP season finale in Valencia. Riding for Aprilia, he not only secured a dominant victory but also achieved the rare feat of winning back-to-back races, something no Aprilia rider had done before. His triumph in Valencia, combined with his earlier win in Portugal, propelled him to third place in the overall championship standings—marking a historic milestone for both his career and the Aprilia team. This victory highlighted his consistent pace, strong qualifying position, and ability to withstand pressure from emerging contenders like Raul Fernandez and Fabio Di Giannantonio.

questions.question: What is the award period covered by the Sixteenth Finance Commission’s report?
questions.explanation: The Sixteenth Finance Commission’s report covers the five-year award period from 2026 to 2031, guiding India’s fiscal framework for this duration. During this period, the Commission’s recommendations shape how tax revenue is shared between the Union and the States, how grants-in-aid are allocated, and how disaster risk financing mechanisms are structured. It plays a central role in strengthening fiscal federalism by defining criteria for vertical and horizontal devolution, local body financing, and performance-based grants. The report, prepared after extensive consultations and expert inputs, forms the foundation for fiscal planning and resource distribution for the entire award cycle.

questions.question: What is the name of India’s first nitric-oxide-releasing wound dressing for diabetic foot ulcers?
questions.explanation: ColoNoX is a nitric-oxide-releasing wound dressing introduced by the Department of Atomic Energy through BARC to address diabetic foot ulcers, a condition that often requires advanced therapeutic solutions due to slow healing and high infection risk. This innovation marks a major step in integrating nuclear research with biomedical applications, enabling controlled nitric oxide release that supports antimicrobial action, improved blood flow, and enhanced tissue repair. Its development strengthens India’s medical technology capabilities and demonstrates the potential of cross-disciplinary research in creating effective healthcare interventions for chronic and complex wounds.

questions.question: Who will receive ₹5 lakh each under the National Gopal Ratna Awards 2025?

options.A: To top dairy farmers and cooperatives

questions.explanation: The National Gopal Ratna Awards 2025 include a cash reward of ₹5 lakh each for the top performers in the Best Dairy Farmer and Best Dairy Cooperative/FPO/MPC categories. These awards aim to honour those who significantly contribute to India’s livestock and dairy ecosystem through excellence in dairy farming and cooperative management. By recognizing top dairy farmers and cooperatives, the initiative encourages improved breeding practices, scientific cattle management, and innovation in milk production. The awards also reinforce the importance of these stakeholders in strengthening India’s position as the world’s largest milk producer while promoting sustainable and efficient dairy development nationwide.

questions.question: What is the name of the storm that caused fatalities and severe flooding in Portugal and Wales?
questions.explanation: The storm responsible for the widespread damage, severe flooding, and loss of life across parts of Portugal and Wales was named Claudia. It brought intense rain, strong winds, and hazardous conditions that led authorities to issue amber alerts in several Portuguese districts, including Algarve, Beja, and Setubal. In Wales, the storm’s impact was equally serious, with rivers overflowing and causing significant flooding, especially in Monmouth. Events like these highlight the increasing vulnerability of regions to extreme weather, emphasizing the need for preparedness, timely warnings, and resilient infrastructure to mitigate the effects of such natural disasters.

questions.question: With which country is India conducting the joint military exercise ‘AJEYA WARRIOR-25’?
questions.explanation: ‘AJEYA WARRIOR-25’ is a bilateral military exercise conducted between India and the United Kingdom, reflecting the strong and historic defence ties shared by the two nations. Held at the Mahajan Field Firing Ranges in Rajasthan, the exercise brings together equal troop strength from both sides to train under a UN mandate, focusing on counter-terror operations in semi-urban terrain. This collaboration enhances interoperability through joint planning, tactical drills, and field exercises, helping both armies prepare for complex modern security challenges. The long-running series, active since 2011, continues to play a key role in strengthening mutual trust and operational synergy between India and the UK.

questions.question: Which organisation signed an MoU with Gati Shakti Vishwavidyalaya to advance smart defence technologies and secure logistics systems?
questions.explanation: The Defence Research and Development Organization (DRDO) partnered with Gati Shakti Vishwavidyalaya to strengthen India’s capabilities in smart defence technologies and secure logistics systems. This collaboration focuses on areas such as operational logistics modelling, indigenous chip design, hardware security, and advanced encryption technologies, all of which are vital for national defence preparedness. By linking GSV’s expertise in transportation and logistics with DRDO’s cutting-edge defence R&D, the partnership accelerates innovation in sensitive domains. It also fosters capacity building through joint research, workshops, and conferences, helping nurture a new generation of scientists and professionals aligned with India’s Aatmanirbharta vision in defence technology.

questions.question: On which date is World Toilet Day observed each year?
questions.explanation: World Toilet Day is observed annually on November 19 to emphasize the critical importance of safe, accessible, and climate-resilient sanitation systems for all. The day serves as a reminder of the global sanitation crisis affecting billions of people who continue to live without proper toilet facilities. It draws attention to the health, environmental, and social challenges that arise from inadequate sanitation, including disease transmission, water contamination, and safety concerns for vulnerable communities. By highlighting this date, the campaign urges governments, institutions, and individuals to invest in sustainable sanitation solutions that protect both human dignity and public health.

questions.question: From which country will India source 10% of its LPG imports under the new 2026 deal?
questions.explanation: India has entered into a landmark agreement to source a significant portion of its LPG imports—about 10%—from the United States starting in 2026. This structured deal marks a strategic shift in India’s energy procurement pattern, as it has traditionally relied heavily on West Asian suppliers such as Saudi Arabia, the UAE, Qatar, and Kuwait. By diversifying its supply chain, India aims to strengthen its energy security, reduce dependence on a single region, and explore competitive pricing options based on the Mont Belvieu benchmark used in the US. The move also supports broader diplomatic and trade objectives between the two countries.

questions.question: Who received an honourary Academy Award at the 2025 Governors Awards?
questions.explanation: Tom Cruise was honoured with an honourary Academy Award at the 2025 Governors Awards, marking a significant milestone in his long and influential career. Despite being nominated several times in the past, this recognition represents his first Oscar win. The award acknowledges not only his achievements as an actor but also his impactful work as a producer and his contributions to elevating theatrical cinema over several decades. Presented by director Alejandro González Iñárritu, the honour highlights Cruise’s enduring influence, his commitment to cinematic excellence, and his role in shaping modern Hollywood filmmaking.

questions.question: Which country was unanimously re-elected to the Codex Executive Committee for the Asia region until 2027?
questions.explanation: India secured its re-election to the Codex Executive Committee for the Asia region, reinforcing its influential role in shaping global food standards and trade-related food safety policies. This unanimous decision reflects the confidence of the international community in India’s leadership, technical expertise, and commitment to balanced, science-based regulatory frameworks. Through active participation in multiple Codex committees, India has consistently advocated for standards that incorporate regional realities while aligning with global best practices. Its contributions span food additives, pesticide residue monitoring, analytical methods, and commodity standards, including progress on cashew kernel regulations. This renewed mandate empowers India to continue shaping equitable and effective global food governance.

questions.question: Which state’s High Court directed the government to install CCTV cameras in all police stations?
questions.explanation: The directive came from the High Court of Jharkhand, which instructed the state government to ensure the installation of CCTV cameras across all police stations. This move aims to improve transparency, accountability, and monitoring within law enforcement facilities. The court also emphasized timely execution by directing officers to complete the detailed project report and initiate the tendering process by December 31. Such measures are often taken to strengthen institutional practices, enhance public trust, and ensure that modern surveillance infrastructure supports fair and lawful policing procedures throughout the state.

questions.question: What was the value of India’s gold imports in October 2025?
questions.explanation: India experienced a significant surge in gold imports in October 2025, reaching $14.72 billion. This sharp rise represented a threefold increase compared with the previous year and was mainly fueled by strong demand during the festival and wedding seasons, periods traditionally associated with higher gold purchases. The unusually high level of imports also played a major role in widening the country’s trade deficit to record levels. Understanding the factors behind this jump provides insight into the interaction between consumer behavior, seasonal trends, and broader economic impacts such as trade imbalances.

questions.question: Which university topped the QS World University Sustainability Rankings 2026?
questions.explanation: Lund University secured the top position in the QS World University Sustainability Rankings 2026, marking the first time it has achieved this distinction since the rankings began in 2023. It displaced the University of Toronto, which had been the leader for two consecutive years. The 2026 edition evaluated nearly 2,000 institutions across 106 countries, reflecting a broader global participation in measuring environmental, social, and governance (ESG) performance. Lund University earned a perfect score of 100, showcasing its strong commitment to sustainable practices, climate action, social equality, and transparent governance. Its leadership underscores the growing role of universities in shaping a sustainable future.

questions.question: Who secured the victory at the Valencia Grand Prix in MotoGP 2025?
questions.explanation: Marco Bezzecchi claimed an important win at the Valencia Grand Prix, achieving a milestone for both himself and Aprilia. The victory marked his second consecutive triumph, coming just a week after his success in Portugal. This exceptional performance elevated him to third place in the 2025 MotoGP World Championship standings, representing his highest career finish. It also signified a breakthrough for Aprilia, as it was the first time one of their riders earned back-to-back wins. His consistent form throughout the season solidified his reputation as one of the standout competitors on the MotoGP grid.

questions.question: In which city will India host the Global Big Cats Summit in 2026?
questions.explanation: The Global Big Cats Summit scheduled for 2026 will be hosted in New Delhi, reflecting India’s prominent role in global wildlife conservation efforts. As the host city, New Delhi will bring together major big cat range nations, biodiversity experts, and climate action stakeholders under the framework of the International Big Cat Alliance (IBCA). The summit aims to strengthen collaboration on protecting species such as tigers, lions, leopards, snow leopards, jaguars, cheetahs, and pumas. By choosing New Delhi as the venue, India reinforces its commitment to ecological preservation, climate resilience, and leadership in international conservation dialogue.

questions.question: Who has been appointed as UNICEF India’s Celebrity Advocate?
questions.explanation: Keerthy Suresh has taken on the significant role of UNICEF India’s Celebrity Advocate, bringing her strong public influence and dedicated fan base to support critical social causes. As an acclaimed actor known across Tamil, Telugu, Malayalam, and Hindi cinema, she is well-positioned to highlight issues related to child rights, mental health, and emotional well-being. Her involvement is intended to inspire communities, mobilize awareness campaigns, and encourage positive action for children’s welfare. By leveraging her platform, she aims to contribute to long-term change and elevate national conversations around the needs and rights of children.

questions.question: In which city is the CAG establishing the Centre of Excellence for Financial Audit?
questions.explanation: The Comptroller and Auditor General of India is setting up a dedicated Centre of Excellence for Financial Audit in Hyderabad with the objective of modernizing and strengthening India’s audit ecosystem. This centre is expected to play a transformative role by standardizing high-quality audit methodologies, integrating advanced tools like AI and data analytics, and promoting research-driven professional development. Its establishment signals a shift from conventional sample-based audits to comprehensive data-driven evaluations, improving transparency and accountability in public financial management. By serving as an incubator of global best practices and incorporating ESG-based assessments, it aims to elevate India’s audit standards to international levels.

questions.question: On which date is World Children’s Day observed globally?
questions.explanation: World Children’s Day is observed every year on November 20 and is dedicated to promoting and protecting children’s rights around the world. The date holds immense historical and symbolic value as it marks the adoption of two significant UN declarations related to child rights in 1959 and 1989. The observance emphasises children’s dignity, participation, and well-being, and encourages global communities to take meaningful action to ensure that every child receives equal opportunities, protection from harm, access to education, and an environment that supports their growth and voice.

questions.question: Who has been elected as the new Chairman of the Karnataka Planters Association (KPA) in 2025?
questions.explanation: M Salman Baseer has taken charge as the Chairman of the Karnataka Planters Association during its 67th Annual General Meeting held in Chikmagaluru. His leadership comes at a pivotal moment for Karnataka’s coffee sector, which contributes the majority of India’s coffee production. With extensive grassroots experience, he is expected to focus on improving price realization for growers, advocating for export incentives, strengthening sustainable farming practices, and pushing for better technological support for coffee estates. His role is crucial in steering reforms, addressing climate-related challenges, and enhancing the global competitiveness of Karnataka’s coffee industry while safeguarding planter interests.

questions.question: Which country has been selected as the Country Partner for the Hornbill Festival 2025?
questions.explanation: The United Kingdom has been chosen as the Country Partner for the Hornbill Festival 2025, marking a significant step toward strengthening cultural ties and enhancing global engagement with Nagaland’s rich heritage. This partnership was formalised through a signing ceremony involving the Nagaland Chief Minister and senior British officials, demonstrating a shared commitment to cultural diplomacy. As part of the collaboration, the British Council and the British Deputy High Commission will curate cultural programs and bring UK artists to the festival. This association is expected to boost tourism, promote indigenous traditions, and create new avenues for cultural exchange between India and the UK.

questions.question: Who was awarded the Indira Gandhi Prize for Peace, Disarmament and Development for 2024?
questions.explanation: Michelle Bachelet, former President of Chile and former UN High Commissioner for Human Rights, received the 2024 Indira Gandhi Peace Prize in recognition of her lifelong dedication to human rights, gender equality, and global peace initiatives. Her leadership in establishing key institutions such as Chile’s Ministry of Women and Gender Equality, implementing major social reforms, and her global advocacy through roles at the UN highlight her impact. The award also acknowledges her resilience shaped by political turmoil, her commitment to democratic values, and her principled stance on rights issues worldwide, including critical assessments of policies affecting civil liberties.

questions.question: Which country was designated as a Major Non-NATO Ally by the United States in November 2025?
questions.explanation: Saudi Arabia received the Major Non-NATO Ally (MNNA) status from the United States, marking a major elevation in their strategic relationship. This designation provides access to advanced American defence technologies, preferential military cooperation, joint training programs, and participation in research and development initiatives. The announcement coincided with a landmark defence and technology partnership that includes the sale of F-35 fighter jets, advanced tanks, and expanded security collaboration in the Gulf region. Additionally, agreements on civil nuclear energy, artificial intelligence, and critical minerals further deepen the bilateral ties, aligning with Saudi Arabia’s Vision 2030 goals and reshaping regional strategic dynamics.

questions.question: On which date is International Men’s Day observed each year?
questions.explanation: International Men’s Day is observed annually on November 19 to acknowledge the contributions, responsibilities, and challenges faced by men in various roles throughout society. The day highlights issues such as mental health, emotional wellbeing, workplace stress, and societal expectations linked to masculinity. It also emphasises the value of positive male role models and encourages healthier, more compassionate lifestyles. With the 2025 theme “Celebrating men and boys,” the observance aims to appreciate their positive influence in families, communities, and professional spaces. Recognizing this date helps drive conversations about equality, support systems, and nurturing environments for men and boys worldwide.

questions.question: Which company reclaimed the top position as India’s most valuable brand in the 2025 Kantar BrandZ report?
questions.explanation: HDFC Bank regained its position as India’s most valuable brand in the 2025 Kantar BrandZ rankings, achieving a brand value of $44.9 billion. This comeback reflects a combination of strong post-merger consolidation with HDFC Ltd, accelerated digital innovations, and sustained consumer trust. The bank’s initiatives—such as its rapid loan processing systems and cybersecurity-focused brand mascots—enhanced its market presence and differentiation. With a remarkable 377% rise in brand value since 2014, HDFC Bank demonstrates consistent long-term brand investment. Its renewed leadership comes at a time when most major Indian brands are experiencing slower growth, highlighting the bank’s ability to stand out in a competitive landscape.

questions.question: Who has been appointed as the Senior Director and General Manager for Dell India’s Consumer Sales business?
questions.explanation: Anurag Arora has been appointed as the Senior Director and General Manager for Dell Technologies’ Consumer Sales business in India. With over 28 years of experience across technology, retail, e-commerce, and product management, he brings deep expertise in omnichannel strategies and consumer engagement. His previous contributions at Dell include expanding Dell.com India, improving retail presence, and enhancing integration between online and offline sales channels. In this leadership role, he will guide strategy, boost sales performance, and drive growth initiatives at a time when India remains a crucial market for Dell, given the rising demand for personal computing devices and rapid digital adoption.

questions.question: Who was sworn in as Chief Minister of Bihar for a historic 10th term in 2025?
questions.explanation: Nitish Kumar’s swearing-in for a record 10th term as Bihar’s Chief Minister marks an extraordinary milestone in Indian state politics. His leadership once again emerged at the forefront following the NDA’s commanding victory, which secured 202 seats in the 2025 Assembly elections. The grand ceremony at Patna’s Gandhi Maidan showcased the political weight of the event with participation from top national leaders, reflecting the stability and continuity he brings to Bihar’s governance. His long tenure symbolises sustained public trust, consistent administrative focus, and a political presence that has shaped Bihar’s development trajectory across multiple terms.

questions.question: In which city is India’s first dedicated Tesla Centre scheduled to open on November 26, 2025?
questions.explanation: India’s first dedicated Tesla Centre is set to open in Gurugram, marking a significant step in Tesla’s expansion into the Indian market. This centre will be located at Orchid Business Park and will function as a full-service facility offering sales consultations, deliveries, repairs, and potentially Supercharging support. Gurugram was selected due to its strategic position in the Delhi-NCR region, strong EV adoption environment, and proximity to affluent buyers and early tech adopters. The launch follows Tesla’s initial presence through experience centres in Mumbai and Delhi, and reinforces India’s emergence as a promising market for premium electric vehicles.

questions.question: What is India’s rank in the Climate Change Performance Index (CCPI) 2026?
questions.explanation: India holds the 23rd rank in the Climate Change Performance Index (CCPI) 2026, reflecting a significant drop of 13 positions from the previous year. This decline resulted largely from the country’s lack of a national coal phase-out plan, which affected its overall standing. The CCPI evaluates 63 countries along with the EU across key indicators such as greenhouse gas emissions, renewable energy adoption, energy use, and climate policy. Together, these regions account for about 90% of global emissions. India’s shift from a high to medium performer underscores the challenges it faces in accelerating its transition to cleaner energy pathways.

questions.question: Which term was selected as the Cambridge Dictionary Word of the Year for 2025?
questions.explanation: Parasocial was chosen as the Cambridge Dictionary Word of the Year for 2025 due to its growing relevance in modern culture. The term, first introduced in 1956 by sociologists Donald Horton and Richard Wohl, originally described the emotional connections viewers developed with television personalities. Over time, the concept has expanded to include one-sided emotional relationships people form with celebrities, online creators, fictional characters, and even AI systems. Its selection highlights the increasing impact of digital environments on human interaction, as more individuals form meaningful yet unreciprocated bonds with media figures and virtual entities.

questions.question: In which city will the 4th edition of the Swavlamban 2025 Innovation Seminar be held?
questions.explanation: New Delhi is the host city for the 4th edition of the Swavlamban 2025 Innovation Seminar, organised by the Naval Innovation & Indigenisation Organisation. The seminar is scheduled to begin on 26 November and is designed to bring together key stakeholders such as industry leaders, MSMEs, start-ups, and academic institutions. Its central theme, “Strength and Power through Innovation and Indigenisation,” highlights the Indian Navy’s commitment to advancing technological self-reliance and enhancing naval capabilities. The event serves as a platform to promote collaboration, accelerate innovation, and support indigenous solutions crucial for strengthening national defence preparedness.

questions.question: Who received the CII Quality Ratna Award 2025 at the 33rd CII Excellence Summit?
questions.explanation: Venu Srinivasan, Chairman Emeritus of TVS Motor, received the prestigious CII Quality Ratna Award 2025 in recognition of his transformative contributions to India’s quality movement. He played a pivotal role in introducing and championing Total Quality Management (TQM) practices across the Indian automotive sector. Under his leadership, TVS Motor became the first non-Japanese two-wheeler company to earn the Deming Prize in 2002, a global benchmark for excellence in quality. His lifelong commitment to innovation, operational excellence, and organizational improvement has significantly influenced Indian industry standards, earning him this distinguished honour.

questions.question: With which country did DRDO sign a technical agreement to enhance bilateral defence R&D cooperation?
questions.explanation: France is the nation with which DRDO signed a technical agreement aimed at deepening defence research and development cooperation. This collaboration, established in New Delhi with France’s Directorate General of Armaments (DGA), will support the transfer of advanced equipment and technologies between the two countries. The partnership covers a wide spectrum of strategic domains, including aeronautical platforms, unmanned systems, artificial intelligence, cybersecurity, quantum technologies, advanced sensors, propulsion systems, and both space and underwater technologies. By expanding cooperation across such high-end fields, the agreement reinforces long-term technological synergy and strengthens bilateral defence capabilities.

questions.question: Where was India Post’s first Gen Z-themed Post Office inaugurated?
questions.explanation: IIT Delhi is the location where India Post introduced its first Gen Z-themed Post Office, reflecting a shift toward modernizing postal services for younger, tech-savvy users. The revamped Campus Post Office includes features such as Wi-Fi zones, vibrant graffiti and artwork created by the institute’s Fine Arts Society, and QR-based parcel booking systems that offer convenient Speed Post discounts for students. This initiative is part of a broader nationwide plan to update 46 campus Post Offices across major educational institutions, aiming to make postal facilities more appealing, accessible, and relevant to the evolving needs of today’s youth.

questions.question: Where has Google opened its largest AI hardware engineering centre outside the United States?
questions.explanation: Taiwan is the location of Google’s largest AI hardware engineering centre outside the United States, marking a major expansion of the company’s global technological footprint. Situated in Taipei, the centre plays a crucial role in advancing AI-focused hardware development, especially through the integration of Google’s TPU processors into high-performance server systems. The initiative also reflects the deepening strategic technology partnership between the US and Taiwan. Since 2020, the engineering team in Taiwan has tripled, demonstrating Google’s long-term commitment to strengthening cloud computing, AI workloads, and data-driven infrastructure capabilities in the region.

questions.question: Who is set to be inducted into the International Tennis Hall of Fame in August 2026?
questions.explanation: Roger Federer is the individual scheduled for induction into the International Tennis Hall of Fame in 2026. He is celebrated globally for his extraordinary tennis career, marked by 20 Grand Slam titles, 103 tour-level titles, and unmatched consistency that kept him at World No. 1 for a record 237 consecutive weeks. His influence extends beyond statistics, as he helped shape a golden era of tennis alongside Rafael Nadal and Novak Djokovic, inspiring millions with his elegance, sportsmanship, and longevity. His induction honours his profound impact on the sport and his enduring legacy as one of tennis’s greatest champions.

questions.question: Where will the 20th G20 Leaders’ Summit be held, which PM Modi is set to attend?
questions.explanation: Johannesburg is the host city for the 20th G20 Leaders’ Summit, which PM Narendra Modi will attend from 21–23 November. The summit marks the fourth consecutive G20 meeting held in the Global South, highlighting the increasing significance of developing regions in shaping global economic and political discussions. India will use this platform to share its priorities and perspectives on key global challenges. During the visit, PM Modi will also take part in the India-Brazil-South Africa (IBSA) Leaders’ Meeting, strengthening trilateral cooperation. The choice of Johannesburg underscores South Africa’s role as a central voice in international diplomacy.

questions.question: What is the name of India’s first indigenous CRISPR-based gene therapy launched for Sickle Cell Disease?
questions.explanation: BIRSA 101 is India’s first fully indigenous CRISPR-based gene therapy developed to treat Sickle Cell Disease (SCD), marking a major milestone in the nation’s genomic medicine capabilities. Launched by Dr. Jitendra Singh and dedicated to Birsa Munda on his 150th anniversary, the therapy represents a significant step toward India’s mission to eliminate SCD. It is designed as a low-cost alternative to global treatments that currently cost ₹20–25 crore, making advanced gene therapy accessible to a wider population. This innovation strengthens public health efforts while boosting India’s position in advanced biomedical research and healthcare technology.

questions.question: Which country’s nationals received expanded Visa-on-Arrival access to additional Indian airports including Cochin, Calicut, and Ahmedabad?
questions.explanation: India expanded its Visa-on-Arrival facility in November 2025 specifically for nationals of the UAE, allowing them entry through Cochin, Calicut, and Ahmedabad in addition to six existing airports. This policy move strengthens bilateral relations, supports tourism, and enhances business connectivity between the two nations. With a significant Indian expatriate population living in the UAE and frequent travel for medical care, trade, and cultural ties, the expansion reduces procedural barriers and improves travel convenience. It also aligns with India’s goal of deepening regional partnerships, promoting economic cooperation, and supporting people-to-people engagement through simplified immigration procedures.

questions.question: Who won the Miss Universe 2025 title?
questions.explanation: Fátima Bosch from Mexico won the Miss Universe 2025 crown, emerging victorious among more than 100 global contestants. Hosted in Thailand, the event showcased cultural performances, strong advocacies, and impressive stage presence from participants worldwide. Bosch stood out for her confidence, intelligence, and commitment to impactful social initiatives. She was crowned by Victoria Kjær Theilvig of Denmark, the outgoing Miss Universe 2024. Her performance in interviews, advocacy presentations, and stage segments solidified her as a deserving winner. Her victory also reflects Mexico’s continued excellence in international pageantry, inspiring audiences and fellow contestants across the globe.

questions.question: Who has been appointed as the Chief Investment Officer of Bajaj Alternate Investment Management Ltd.?
questions.explanation: Jitendra Gohil has been appointed as the Chief Investment Officer of Bajaj Alternate Investment Management Ltd., marking a significant strategic move for the company as it strengthens its position in the rapidly expanding alternative investment market in India. With nearly two decades of experience in financial markets, including senior roles at Credit Suisse India and Kotak Alternate Asset Managers, Gohil brings deep expertise in macroeconomics, portfolio management, and wealth strategy. His appointment supports Bajaj’s long-term vision of expanding its alternative investment fund offerings and building a strong leadership team under Lakshmi Iyer to compete effectively in the ₹15 trillion AIF industry.

questions.question: Which state’s Scheduled Castes Commission inaugurated India’s first dedicated courtroom for SC-related cases?
questions.explanation: The Punjab State Scheduled Castes Commission has taken a landmark step by inaugurating India’s first dedicated courtroom exclusively for Scheduled Caste-related cases. This initiative aims to streamline hearings and reduce delays that disproportionately affect marginalised communities seeking justice. By creating a specialised space equipped with modern infrastructure, the Commission enhances both efficiency and accessibility. The move also reflects Punjab’s commitment to social equity, as it plans to introduce an Online Court System to support virtual appearances, minimizing travel barriers for rural and remote complainants. This reform sets an important precedent for other states to strengthen SC grievance-redressal mechanisms.

questions.question: Where was the WAVES Film Bazaar 2025 inaugurated during the 56th International Film Festival of India (IFFI)?
questions.explanation: Goa served as the venue for the inauguration of the WAVES Film Bazaar 2025, held alongside the 56th International Film Festival of India (IFFI) in Panaji. The event, inaugurated by Dr. L Murugan on 20 November 2025, is one of South Asia’s most significant film industry platforms, bringing together filmmakers, producers, distributors, festival programmers, and financiers. As the 19th edition of the Film Bazaar, it offered global opportunities for Indian creators through co-production markets, screenwriters’ labs, viewing rooms, and industry masterclasses. Hosting this major event in Goa underscores the state’s long-standing importance as India’s cultural and cinematic hub, especially during IFFI.

questions.question: When is National Philosophy Day 2025 observed?
questions.explanation: November 20 is the date on which National Philosophy Day 2025 is observed, aligning with the third Thursday of November, which is recognised globally as World Philosophy Day. This day celebrates the enduring value of philosophy in fostering critical thinking, dialogue, and intellectual exploration. It underscores the importance of philosophy in addressing modern challenges by encouraging reflection, open-mindedness, and respect for diverse perspectives. Established by UNESCO in 2002 and officially recognised in 2005, the day serves to remind societies of the power of philosophical inquiry in promoting peace, tolerance, and global understanding. Through discussions, events, and educational activities, it inspires people to question, learn, and engage meaningfully with the world.

questions.question: Which country has been selected to host COP31 in 2026 after reaching a compromise with Australia?
questions.explanation: Turkey has been chosen to host COP31 in 2026 following a diplomatic compromise with Australia that resolved a long-standing dispute over the hosting rights. Under this arrangement, Turkey will oversee the logistical responsibilities and hold the summit’s Presidency, while Australia will take charge of leading intergovernmental negotiations. This decision helps maintain the continuity of global climate discussions during a crucial period when the world is focusing on strengthening climate finance, advancing adaptation mechanisms, supporting vulnerable island nations, and keeping the 1.5°C climate target within reach. The agreement also demonstrates how collaborative diplomacy can prevent procedural deadlocks in major international forums.

questions.question: Which countries have been announced as the official country partners for the Hornbill Festival 2025?
questions.explanation: Switzerland and Ireland have been selected as the country partners for the Hornbill Festival 2025, marking an important step in expanding the festival’s global reach. Their participation follows meetings between Nagaland’s Chief Minister and the ambassadors of both nations, during which cultural collaboration and deeper bilateral engagement were discussed. These partnerships will enrich the festival with diverse artistic expressions, including folk music, public art, and cultural exchanges. By welcoming global partners, the Hornbill Festival enhances its position as an international cultural convergence, strengthens cultural diplomacy, boosts tourism, and supports Nagaland’s economic and creative ecosystems.

questions.question: When is World Television Day 2025 observed?
questions.explanation: November 21 is observed annually as World Television Day, highlighting the profound influence television has had on global communication, education, and culture. Recognised by the United Nations, this day honours the medium's role in shaping public opinion, fostering cultural exchange, and supporting social development. Television has evolved from an educational tool into a powerful global platform that raises awareness about critical issues such as climate change, human rights, health, and poverty. Even in an era dominated by digital media, television remains a trusted source of information and a unifying force that connects diverse audiences across countries and cultures.

questions.question: Which country became the newest member of the Colombo Security Conclave during the 7th NSA-level meeting?
questions.explanation: Seychelles became the newest member of the Colombo Security Conclave during the 7th NSA-level meeting held in New Delhi on 20 November 2025. Its entry significantly strengthens regional cooperation across the Indian Ocean, especially in areas such as maritime security, counter-terrorism, cyber security, and disaster relief. As a strategically located island nation, Seychelles adds depth to collective efforts in monitoring sea lanes, preventing trafficking, and boosting maritime domain awareness. Its participation also reinforces diplomatic relations with India and other member nations, while reflecting the Conclave’s growing relevance and expansion as a multilateral security framework in the Indo-Pacific region.

questions.question: In which state was the first-ever Ramakrishna Mission College in Northeast India inaugurated?
questions.explanation: The first-ever Ramakrishna Mission College in Northeast India was inaugurated in Meghalaya, marking an important step toward strengthening educational infrastructure in the region. The inauguration by the state’s Chief Minister highlights Meghalaya’s commitment to expanding academic opportunities and improving access to quality higher education. Establishing such an institution in Nongthymmai, Mawsmai, Sohra not only supports local students but also contributes to the broader goal of uplifting educational standards across the Northeast. This initiative reflects a growing focus on inclusive development, skill enhancement, and empowering youth through modern academic facilities rooted in the values and service ethos of the Ramakrishna Mission.

questions.question: Which country is building the world’s first artificial floating island capable of withstanding nuclear blasts and severe ocean conditions?
questions.explanation: China has embarked on constructing a groundbreaking artificial floating island engineered to endure nuclear explosions, extreme waves, and powerful typhoons. This advanced platform, known as the Deep-Sea All-Weather Resident Floating Research Facility, is designed with military-grade resilience and cutting-edge materials such as metamaterial sandwich panels that absorb intense shockwaves. Measuring 138 metres in length and capable of supporting 238 personnel for months without resupply, the facility represents a major step forward in maritime engineering. Its long-term operational goal includes enhancing scientific research, bolstering deep-sea exploration, and expanding strategic capabilities in international waters by 2028.

questions.question: Who has been appointed as the new Whole-Time Member of SEBI for a three-year term?
questions.explanation: Sandip Pradhan has been appointed as a Whole-Time Member of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI), bringing his extensive experience from the Indian Revenue Service to the regulatory body. Prior to this role, he served as the Director General of Income Tax (Investigation) in Pune, where he supervised major tax probes, compliance matters, and financial scrutiny. His expertise in enforcement and regulatory oversight aligns with SEBI’s mission to strengthen surveillance, curb market manipulation, and enhance investor protection. With his inclusion, SEBI now has a strengthened leadership team to navigate the complexities of India’s evolving capital markets.

questions.question: Where will the Sixth International Agronomy Congress (IAC-2025) begin on November 24?
questions.explanation: The Sixth International Agronomy Congress (IAC-2025) is scheduled to begin in New Delhi, bringing together global experts, researchers, and policymakers in the field of agronomy. The event focuses on the theme “Re-envisioning Agronomy for Smart Agro-Food Systems and Environmental Protection,” highlighting the growing need for sustainable agricultural practices and innovative technologies. By hosting the congress in the national capital, India aims to showcase advancements in smart farming, climate-resilient agriculture, and environmentally conscious food systems. The three-day event, inaugurated by the Minister of Agriculture and Farmers' Welfare, serves as a platform for advancing scientific collaboration and addressing pressing agricultural challenges.

questions.question: On which date is National Cashew Day celebrated each year?
questions.explanation: National Cashew Day is celebrated every year on November 23, a day dedicated to appreciating the unique qualities of cashews and their global culinary significance. Although commonly referred to as nuts, cashews are actually seeds that originate from the cashew apple of the tropical cashew tree, first grown in Brazil before spreading across India, Southeast Asia, and Africa. The day encourages people to explore various ways to enjoy cashews—whether roasted, blended into milk or butter, tossed into salads, or used in desserts. It also highlights their health benefits, including rich mineral content, antioxidants, and heart-healthy fats.

questions.question: Where has the 69th National School Games Under-19 Table Tennis Tournament commenced?
questions.explanation: The 69th National School Games Under-19 Table Tennis Tournament has commenced in Jammu and Kashmir, bringing together nearly 400 young athletes from 34 states, union territories, and various organizations. The event is being hosted at the Gymnasium Hall of the University of Jammu, providing a competitive platform for emerging talent in table tennis. Such tournaments play a crucial role in encouraging sportsmanship, fostering youth development, and identifying potential players for higher-level competitions. By organizing the event in Jammu and Kashmir, the region continues to strengthen its position as a hub for national sporting activities and youth engagement.

questions.question: What is the theme of the National One Health Mission Assembly 2025?

options.A: Health for All: A Unified Global Vision
options.B: One Earth, One Health, One Future.
options.C: Integrated Wellness for a Sustainable World

questions.explanation: The National One Health Mission Assembly 2025 is centered around the theme “One Earth, One Health, One Future.” This theme reflects a holistic approach that recognises the interconnectedness of human, animal, and environmental health. By bringing together ministries, researchers, and experts from various disciplines, the event aims to strengthen collaborative strategies for managing health risks that arise from ecological changes, zoonotic diseases, and environmental disruptions. The theme underscores India’s growing leadership in promoting integrative health policies and emphasises the importance of long-term sustainability, coordinated surveillance systems, and cross-sectoral cooperation to ensure a healthier, more resilient future for all forms of life on the planet.

questions.question: Who has been appointed as the new Telecom Secretary in the latest bureaucratic reshuffle?
questions.explanation: Amit Agrawal has taken charge as the new Telecom Secretary following a major administrative reshuffle involving several key ministries. His appointment marks a shift from his earlier role as Secretary of the Department of Pharmaceuticals, where he served since December 2024. As an experienced IAS officer from the 1993 Chhattisgarh cadre, his new responsibilities include overseeing digital infrastructure projects, telecom policy implementation, spectrum allocation, and coordination with regulatory bodies. This change forms part of a broader government effort to strengthen leadership in sectors vital to national growth and technological advancement.

questions.question: With which country did India sign the Terms of Reference on November 20, 2025, to initiate negotiations for a comprehensive Free Trade Agreement?
questions.explanation: India signed the Terms of Reference with Israel to begin negotiations for a comprehensive Free Trade Agreement aimed at strengthening economic cooperation, boosting trade in goods and services, and enhancing investment flows. The agreement sets a structured framework for discussions on market access, technology collaboration, regulatory alignment, and innovation partnerships. Both nations seek to leverage complementary strengths—India’s large consumer base and manufacturing capabilities, and Israel’s advanced expertise in fields like agritech, cybersecurity, and water technology. The initiative is expected to foster deeper commercial ties, encourage cross-border innovation, and contribute to more resilient supply chains within an evolving global economic landscape.

questions.question: Which country became the world’s third-largest humanitarian donor in 2025 with contributions amounting to $1.46 billion?
questions.explanation: The UAE emerged as the third-largest humanitarian donor in 2025, contributing an impressive $1.46 billion, which accounts for 7.2% of all aid recorded by the UN’s Financial Tracking Service. This milestone highlights the UAE’s expanding global role in both emergency response and long-term development initiatives. Its contributions support critical areas such as food, water, medical assistance, post-conflict recovery, education, and clean energy projects. Led by visionary leadership prioritizing humanitarian responsibility, the UAE’s commitment reflects a blend of rapid crisis intervention and sustainable development, reinforcing its standing as a reliable and impactful global humanitarian partner.

questions.question: Under which Article does the Constitution (131st Amendment) Bill, 2025 propose to place Chandigarh for governance through Presidential regulations?
questions.explanation: The Constitution (131st Amendment) Bill, 2025 proposes placing Chandigarh under Article 240 of the Indian Constitution, marking a major shift in its governance structure. Article 240 empowers the President to frame regulations for specific Union Territories, particularly those without legislative assemblies. By including Chandigarh within its scope, the amendment aims to align the city’s administration with other UTs governed directly through Presidential regulations. This transition may also enable the appointment of an independent Administrator for Chandigarh, moving away from the longstanding arrangement where the Governor of Punjab oversees the Union Territory. The proposal carries notable administrative, constitutional, and political implications, especially concerning Centre–State relations and federal balance.

questions.question: Which organisation signed an MoU with Aramco Asia India to explore establishing a branch office and expand long-term collaboration?
questions.explanation: Engineers India Limited entered into a strategic MoU with Aramco Asia India to evaluate the possibility of setting up a branch office and deepen cooperation across multiple sectors. This collaboration aims to leverage Aramco’s global strengths alongside India’s expanding energy landscape, covering areas such as petrochemicals, infrastructure, and renewable energy. Through coordinated procurement, joint project execution, and long-term business planning, the partnership is expected to create new opportunities for growth. It also enhances India’s capacity to engage with major international energy players while supporting technological advancements and sustainable sectoral development.

questions.question: Which country strengthened sericulture and textile ties with India during the Nov 17–21 visit?
