questions.explanation: The Supreme Court reaffirmed that the right to personal liberty, which includes the right to hold or renew a passport, flows from Article 21 of the Indian Constitution. The Court emphasised that personal liberty is not a concession granted by the State but a fundamental constitutional obligation. In the Mahesh Agarwal vs Union of India case, it clarified that the mere pendency of criminal proceedings cannot automatically deprive an individual of passport rights. Any restriction on such rights must follow due process of law and meet constitutional standards, reinforcing the expansive and protective scope of Article 21.

questions.question: Which provision of the Indian Constitution is violated when civilian awards like Bharat Ratna or Padma awards are used as prefixes or suffixes to a person’s name?
questions.explanation: The Bombay High Court clarified that using civilian awards such as the Bharat Ratna or Padma awards as prefixes or suffixes to a person’s name violates Article 18(1) of the Indian Constitution. Article 18(1) prohibits the State from conferring titles, ensuring equality among citizens. Although these awards are constitutionally valid as honours recognizing excellence, they are not titles and must not be treated as such. Misuse of these honours as name attachments undermines the constitutional principle of equality and can lead to forfeiture under Regulation 10, reinforcing the need for strict compliance with constitutional values.

questions.question: The SPREE-2025 initiative by ESIC is launched under which Act?
questions.explanation: The SPREE-2025 (Scheme for Promoting Registration of Employers and Employees) has been launched under the provisions of the ESI Act, 1948. This Act forms the foundation of India’s Employees’ State Insurance framework, providing health insurance and social security benefits to workers. SPREE-2025, active from 1st July to 31st December 2025, encourages unregistered employers and employees, including temporary and contractual workers, to register voluntarily without the fear of retrospective penalties or inspections. By simplifying compliance and promoting wider registration, the initiative strengthens India’s social security net while ensuring that more workers receive the health and insurance benefits guaranteed under the ESI Act, 1948.

questions.question: Which constitutional provisions were highlighted by the Supreme Court while addressing discrimination against meritorious PwD candidates being denied upward mobility to unreserved seats?
questions.explanation: The Supreme Court emphasised Articles 14 and 16 of the Constitution while questioning the practice of forcing meritorious Persons with Disabilities (PwD) to remain in reserved seats even when they qualify in the unreserved/general category. Article 14 guarantees equality before the law, while Article 16 ensures equal opportunity in matters of public employment. Denial of upward mobility to PwD candidates was termed “hostile discrimination,” as it unfairly restricts their opportunities compared to SC/ST/OBC candidates who enjoy such mobility. By invoking these provisions, the Court reinforced that reservation is about inclusion and enabling equality, not charity, and must ensure fairness, dignity, and true empowerment for PwDs.

questions.question: How many consecutive days of detention lead to automatic removal of PM, CMs, and Ministers under the 2025 Bill?
questions.explanation: The Constitution (One Hundred and Thirtieth Amendment) Bill, 2025, introduced by Union Home Minister Amit Shah, specifies that the Prime Minister, Chief Ministers, and other ministers will be automatically removed from office if they are detained for 30 consecutive days on charges that carry a minimum sentence of five years. This clause strengthens accountability and ensures that individuals holding the highest executive positions cannot continue in office while under prolonged detention. By fixing the threshold at 30 days, the law balances due process with public trust in governance, preventing misuse of power and safeguarding democratic integrity.

questions.question: In which year did the Supreme Court make a ruling regarding medical professionals' liability under the Consumer Protection Act?
questions.explanation: The Supreme Court made a ruling in 1995, in the case of Indian Medical Association vs V P Shantha, regarding medical professionals' liability under the Consumer Protection Act. This ruling established that medical professionals could be sued in consumer court for providing faulty service, as defined by the Consumer Protection Act.

questions.question: Which organisation is responsible for grassroots delivery and community-based intervention in the e-SafeHER cybersecurity awareness program?
questions.explanation: The Reliance Foundation partnered with C-DAC Hyderabad to launch the e-SafeHER program on April 13, 2026, under MeitY’s ISEA programme. The initiative aims to train one million rural women (Cyber Sakhis) by 2029, with phased rollout starting in Madhya Pradesh and Odisha through women’s Self-Help Groups using a peer-led model. C-DAC Hyderabad develops localised multilingual training content, while Reliance Foundation handles grassroots delivery. The program enhances last-mile cybersecurity awareness for secure digital transactions and rural livelihoods. C-DAC, established in 1988 and headquartered in Pune, is a premier R&D organisation under MeitY. Reliance Foundation, established in 2010 and based in Mumbai, drives community-based intervention under this initiative.

questions.question: Which fintech startup entered the unicorn club in April 2026 after securing $280 million in pre-IPO funding?
questions.explanation: KreditBee achieved unicorn status in April 2026 after raising $280 million in a pre-IPO funding round, reaching a valuation of $1.5 billion. The company has shown strong financial performance, reporting ₹2,700 crore in revenue and ₹473 crore in net profit for FY25. Its Assets Under Management (AUM) grew significantly to ₹15,000 crore in FY26. The funding will support expansion in secured and MSME lending segments. Additionally, the company is preparing for an IPO, including merging its tech and NBFC entities, marking a significant milestone in its growth journey.

questions.question: Which company signed an MoU with IIT Bombay to develop a 3D Digital Twin for smart infrastructure?
questions.explanation: Tech Mahindra entered into a strategic partnership with IIT Bombay to develop a 3D Digital Twin of the institute’s Gymkhana building. This initiative showcases the use of advanced technologies such as Building Information Modelling (BIM), 3D rendering, cloud-based visualisation, and IoT integration. The digital twin will enable real-time monitoring, predictive maintenance, and efficient resource management. It also aims to support data-driven decision-making for smart campus development. As a pilot project, it demonstrates scalability potential, allowing similar frameworks to be extended across the entire campus in the future, thereby enhancing operational efficiency and infrastructure management.

questions.question: Which company signed an MoU with the National Council for Cement and Building Materials (NCB) to strengthen construction skills?
questions.explanation: The National Council for Cement and Building Materials entered into a Memorandum of Understanding with UltraTech Cement Limited to enhance construction-related skills across the sector. The collaboration focuses on training civil engineers, contractors, RMC professionals, and masons over a period of three to five years. Key areas of training include technical aspects such as material testing and concrete mix design, as well as sustainable construction practices aligned with environmental goals. The initiative also emphasizes practical learning through workshops, site demonstrations, and exposure visits to cement plants and ready-mix concrete facilities, thereby improving industry standards and workforce capability.

questions.question: Which organisation partnered with the National Commission for Women to launch the Women’s Digital Safety Awareness Initiative?
questions.explanation: The National Commission for Women collaborated with Truecaller to launch the Women’s Digital Safety Awareness Initiative in March 2026. This partnership focuses on enhancing digital safety for women by addressing online risks such as phishing, impersonation, harassment, and financial fraud. A key component of the initiative is the “TrueCyberSakhi: A Digital Safety Toolkit,” which provides interactive learning modules, self-assessment tools, and practical safety guidelines. Additionally, Truecaller verified the NCW’s 24x7 helpline on its platform, helping users identify authentic communication channels and reducing the risk of fraud or impersonation.

questions.question: Which tech giant is investing $350 million in Walmart-owned Flipkart as part of a $1 billion funding round?
questions.explanation: Google's investment of $350 million in Flipkart, as part of a larger funding round, aims to support Flipkart's expansion and technological advancements. This strategic move highlights Google's interest in the e-commerce sector and its commitment to supporting businesses in India.

questions.question: Which company is acquiring full control of Tata Play by buying a 30% stake from Walt Disney Co.?
questions.explanation: Tata Group will acquire full control of Tata Play by purchasing Disney's 30% stake, valuing the company at $1 billion. This transaction aligns with Tata Group's strategy of expanding its presence in the media industry and consolidating its ownership of Tata Play.

questions.question: Which company partnered with "SHIELD" for enhanced fraud prevention?
questions.explanation: Swiggy collaborated with "SHIELD" to enhance its fraud prevention capabilities within its Delivery Partner ecosystem. This partnership leverages SHIELD's device-first risk AI platform to minimize promo abuse and fraudulent activities, allowing Swiggy to focus resources on genuine users and improve overall platform integrity.

questions.question: Which company exported its first consignment of 100 octane premium fuel, XP100, to Sri Lanka?
questions.explanation: Indian Oil Corporation Ltd. (IOCL) marked a significant milestone by exporting its first-ever consignment of 100 octane premium fuel, XP100, to Sri Lanka. This event underscores IOCL's commitment to expanding its global reach and showcasing the quality of its products.

questions.question: With whom has Tata Motors partnered to enhance dealer financing options?
questions.explanation: Tata Motors has partnered with Bajaj Finance to offer financing programs for their authorized passenger and electric vehicle dealers. This collaboration aims to streamline financing options and support the business operations of these dealers, providing them with financial capital to capitalize on opportunities in the growing passenger vehicles market.

questions.question: In which Indian state was the Girder Laying Ceremony for the Indian Coast Guard’s Air Cushion Vehicles (ACVs) conducted on May 11, 2026?
questions.explanation: The Girder Laying Ceremony for the 4th, 5th, and 6th Air Cushion Vehicles (ACVs) of the Indian Coast Guard was conducted in Goa on May 11, 2026. The ceremony took place at the Rassaim Yard of Chowgule Shipyard. These hovercrafts are being built with 50% indigenous material under the Aatmanirbhar Bharat initiative, promoting self-reliance in defence manufacturing. The ACVs are specially designed for high-speed coastal patrolling, reconnaissance, interception, and search-and-rescue missions in shallow waters, marshy terrains, and deep sea regions. The project highlights India’s growing focus on strengthening coastal security and indigenous defence production.

questions.question: Who was appointed as the next Chief of Defence Staff (CDS) of India in May 2026?
questions.explanation: Lt Gen NS Raja Subramani was appointed as the next Chief of Defence Staff (CDS) of India, succeeding Gen Anil Chauhan after his retirement in May 2026. Along with serving as the principal military adviser to the Defence Minister, the CDS also functions as the Secretary of the Department of Military Affairs. Lt Gen Subramani has a distinguished military career, having been commissioned into the Garhwal Rifles in 1985 and later serving in key strategic roles along the Line of Actual Control and the western front. His appointment reflects the government’s emphasis on experienced leadership and integrated military coordination within India’s defence structure.

questions.question: What is the name of the newly commissioned Adamya-class Fast Patrol Vessel inducted into the Indian Coast Guard in May 2026?
questions.explanation: ICGS Achal is a new-generation Adamya-class Fast Patrol Vessel commissioned into the Indian Coast Guard at Goa Shipyard Limited on May 09, 2026. The vessel was designed and built entirely in India, supporting the government’s focus on indigenous defence manufacturing and self-reliance. More than 50 percent of its components are domestically produced, highlighting advancements in the Indian shipbuilding sector. The vessel is intended to strengthen maritime security and coastal surveillance operations across India’s maritime frontiers. The commissioning ceremony was attended by senior officials from the Ministry of Defence and the Indian Coast Guard, reflecting the strategic importance of the induction.

questions.question: Where was the 52nd All India Sainik Schools Principals’ Conference inaugurated on May 07, 2026?
questions.explanation: The 52nd All India Sainik Schools Principals’ Conference was inaugurated at Kazhakoottam in Kerala by Raksha Rajya Mantri Shri Sanjay Seth on May 07, 2026. The conference brought together delegates from 33 Sainik Schools and principals of 79 New Sainik Schools through video conferencing. The event included activities such as a wreath-laying ceremony at the War Memorial and exhibitions on educational technology at the Gyan Mela. Several awards for academic excellence and contributions to defence academy admissions were presented during the conference, highlighting the role of Sainik Schools in preparing students for leadership and military careers.

questions.question: Which organisation inaugurated the new CBRN Field Training and Demonstration Centre in Delhi?
questions.explanation: The Defence Research & Development Organisation (DRDO) inaugurated a new Chemical, Biological, Radiological and Nuclear (CBRN) Field Training and Demonstration Centre at Burari plains in Delhi. The facility was opened by Dr. Samir V Kamat, who serves as the Secretary of the Department of Defence R&D and Chairman of DRDO. The centre is part of the upcoming CBRN Centre of Excellence under the Institute of Nuclear Medicine & Allied Sciences (INMAS). It includes advanced infrastructure such as radiological test beds, heavy ion research facilities, and emergency response systems to provide specialized training for defence personnel and disaster management agencies.

questions.question: Who attended 'Exercise Cyber Suraksha – 2024' to strengthen India's cyber defence?
questions.explanation: Chief of Defence Staff (CDS) Gen Anil Chauhan attended 'Exercise Cyber Suraksha – 2024' to emphasize the critical importance of enhancing India's cyber defence capabilities. The exercise, conducted by the Defence Cyber Agency, aimed to bolster collaboration and integration among military and national agencies to advance the nation’s cyber defence readiness.

questions.question: What GDP growth forecast did Moody's set for India for 2026 and 2027?
questions.explanation: Moody's Investors Service revised India's GDP growth forecast to 6% for both 2026 and 2027 due to rising energy costs and geopolitical tensions affecting the economy. The downgrade reflects concerns over subdued private consumption, weaker industrial activity, and reduced capital formation. India’s dependence on imported energy, especially crude oil and LPG passing through the Strait of Hormuz, increases vulnerability to global disruptions. Higher fuel and fertiliser costs may also strain government finances and reduce capital spending. Moody’s is one of the world’s leading credit rating agencies and closely monitors global economic and financial conditions.

questions.question: What is the projected real GDP growth rate of India for FY27 according to SBI Research?
questions.explanation: SBI Research projected India’s real GDP growth for the fiscal year 2026-27 (FY27) at 6.6% despite challenges such as global economic uncertainty and fluctuating crude oil prices. The report also highlighted strong credit growth among Scheduled Commercial Banks during FY26, driven largely by increased consumption and GST-related economic activity. However, credit growth is expected to moderate in FY27 due to the high base effect. Additionally, rising crude oil prices remain a concern because they can widen the current account deficit, increase inflation, and reduce overall GDP growth. The forecast reflects India’s resilience amid global economic pressures.

questions.question: What GDP growth rate was projected for India for FY27 by S&P Global in May 2026?
questions.explanation: S&P Global revised India’s FY27 GDP growth forecast to 6.6% due to a major energy supply disruption originating in West Asia. The downgrade reflected concerns over rising crude oil prices, increased freight costs, and global economic uncertainty. Earlier projections estimated growth at 7.1%, while the economy had previously expanded by 7.6%. The report also highlighted rising inflation, weakening of the Indian rupee, and widening current account deficits caused by increased import dependence on crude oil and gas. To address the economic challenges, the government introduced stabilisation measures such as a ₹1 lakh crore oil hedging fund and maintenance of strategic petroleum reserves.

questions.question: What Fair and Remunerative Price (FRP) per quintal was approved for sugarcane farmers for the Sugar Season 2026-27?
questions.explanation: The Cabinet Committee on Economic Affairs (CCEA) approved the Fair and Remunerative Price (FRP) for sugarcane at Rs. 365 per quintal for the Sugar Season 2026-27. This rate is applicable for a basic recovery rate of 10.25% and will come into effect from October 1, 2026. Farmers are eligible for additional premiums if the sugar recovery rate exceeds the benchmark, while deductions apply for lower recovery rates. The decision benefits nearly 5 crore sugarcane farmers and lakhs of workers employed in sugar mills and related industries. The FRP system ensures fair compensation to farmers while maintaining stability in the sugar sector.

questions.question: Which fintech company partnered with NPCI Bharat BillPay Ltd (NBBL) to launch the Banking Connect SDK platform?
questions.explanation: Juspay partnered with NPCI Bharat BillPay Ltd (NBBL) to launch a new switch and Software Development Kit (SDK) for the Banking Connect platform. The collaboration aims to simplify integration for banks and financial institutions operating within the ETBFSI ecosystem. The platform provides a single integration layer that enables direct transaction routing to a central switch while enhancing security and fraud monitoring systems. It also standardises net banking integration protocols and reduces onboarding time for participating entities. Juspay, founded in 2012 and headquartered in Bengaluru, is a leading Indian fintech company specialising in digital payment processing infrastructure and financial technology solutions.

questions.question: What milestone has India's market capitalization achieved?
questions.explanation: India's market capitalization has reached a historic milestone of $5 trillion, showcasing the nation's robust economic resilience and investor confidence. This achievement places India in the elite league of countries with a $5 trillion market cap, alongside stalwarts like the US, China, Japan, and Hong Kong.

questions.question: Which Indian Institute of Technology signed a Memorandum of Understanding with Coventry University Group (UK) to strengthen collaboration in Artificial Intelligence and healthcare research?
questions.explanation: IIT Guwahati signed a Memorandum of Understanding with Coventry University Group (UK) to enhance collaboration in research, innovation, and academic exchange. The partnership focuses particularly on advancing developments in Artificial Intelligence and healthcare through joint initiatives. The agreement includes provisions for academic and research mobility, joint doctoral programmes, and collaborative research projects. A major theme of the partnership is “AI for One Health,” which aims to integrate artificial intelligence with healthcare systems to address societal health challenges. This collaboration builds on the earlier AI Impact Pre-Summit event hosted in January 2026, which emphasised using AI to strengthen healthcare integration and interdisciplinary innovation.

questions.question: Which university signed an MoU with the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment to promote accessibility and inclusion for persons with disabilities?
questions.explanation: Pondicherry University signed a Memorandum of Understanding with the Office of the Chief Commissioner for Persons with Disabilities under the Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities, Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment. The collaboration aims to strengthen accessibility, promote inclusion, and support the rights of persons with disabilities through academic and policy engagement. The agreement focuses on conducting joint research on disability rights, accessibility standards, inclusive education, employment opportunities, and social integration. It also encourages academic exchanges, conferences, workshops, and awareness programs to promote understanding of the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016 and to build capacity for creating a more inclusive society.

questions.question: Which institution signed a five-year Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with the Survey of India for geospatial research and innovation?
questions.explanation: Survey of India (SoI) signed a five-year Memorandum of Understanding with Kerala University of Digital Sciences, Innovation and Technology, popularly known as Kerala Digital University. The collaboration aims to strengthen geospatial research and promote digital innovation by leveraging advanced technologies such as geoinformatics, artificial intelligence, and machine learning. The partnership focuses on improving the collection, processing, analysis, and application of geospatial data. It also includes joint research and development activities, capacity-building programs, training initiatives, and higher education opportunities. This initiative is expected to support technological advancement and enhance expertise in geospatial technologies and digital sciences in India.

questions.question: Which institution formalised a Framework for Action with the International Solar Alliance (ISA) to advance solar skills and capacity building across member countries?
questions.explanation: The International Solar Alliance (ISA) signed a Framework for Action with IIT Delhi to strengthen collaboration in renewable energy, particularly in human resource development, academic programmes, joint research, and knowledge exchange. This agreement builds upon five years of successful partnership, including the ISA-supported M.Tech programme in Renewable Energy Technologies & Management, which has trained over 100 mid-career professionals from regions such as Africa, Asia-Pacific, and Small Island Developing States. The expanded framework introduces new training models, trainer development initiatives, and broader capacity-building measures to accelerate solar adoption and promote clean energy transitions across ISA’s member countries.

questions.question: In which city was the National Conference on UDISE+ organised by the Department of School Education & Literacy in February 2026?
questions.explanation: Bhubaneswar hosted the two-day National Conference on Unified District Information System for Education Plus (UDISE+), organised by the Department of School Education & Literacy under the Ministry of Education in collaboration with the Government of Odisha. The conference focused on enhancing the reliability, real-time accuracy, and strategic use of UDISE+, which serves as India’s flagship education data platform. Discussions centred on strengthening data integrity, resolving implementation challenges faced by states and union territories, and expanding the system into an AI-compliant decision support framework to enable evidence-based policymaking and effective implementation of Samagra Shiksha and NEP 2020 initiatives.

questions.question: According to the ULLAS scheme, who is primarily targeted for empowerment?

options.C: dults aged 15 and above who missed formal schooling
options.D: School dropouts looking for vocational training

questions.explanation: The ULLAS scheme, known as the New India Literacy Programme (NILP), aims to empower adults aged 15 and above who have missed formal schooling. It focuses on achieving Full Functional Literacy among this demographic, aligning with the National Education Policy (NEP) 2020 objectives. Ladakh's achievement of becoming the first administrative unit to attain Full Functional Literacy under this scheme underscores its success in addressing educational gaps among adults who lacked formal schooling opportunities.

questions.question: With whom did Tamil Nadu partner to empower youth with IT skills through the Naan Mudhalvan program?
questions.explanation: Oracle has collaborated with Tamil Nadu to implement the Naan Mudhalvan program, aiming to train over 200,000 students in advanced IT skills such as cloud computing, AI, data science, ML, and blockchain. This partnership emphasizes Oracle's role in enhancing youth employability by providing training and certifications in cutting-edge technologies through digital and campus-based learning initiatives.

questions.question: Shekha Jheel Bird Sanctuary, declared as India’s 99th Ramsar site in April 2026, is located in which state?
questions.explanation: Shekha Jheel Bird Sanctuary, located in Aligarh, has been recognised as India’s 99th Ramsar site, highlighting its ecological significance. This designation strengthens wetland conservation efforts and underscores the importance of preserving biodiversity. With this addition, Uttar Pradesh now has a total of 12 Ramsar sites, making it a leading state in wetland conservation. Ramsar sites are wetlands of international importance, providing habitats for migratory birds and supporting ecological balance. The inclusion of Shekha Jheel also contributes to climate regulation, groundwater recharge, and promotes eco-tourism and local livelihoods.

questions.question: In which state was the new snake species Calamaria garoensis discovered in 2026?
questions.explanation: The newly identified snake species, Calamaria garoensis, was discovered in the West Garo Hills region, a biodiversity-rich area known for its dense forests and ecological significance. This species was earlier misclassified but later recognised as distinct through detailed taxonomic research. The discovery highlights the rich herpetofaunal diversity of Northeast India, particularly within the Indo-Burma biodiversity hotspot. Meghalaya, with its unique terrain and ecosystems, continues to be a crucial region for biological discoveries, contributing significantly to scientific understanding and conservation of lesser-known reptile species.

questions.question: What percentage of the Sundarbans mangrove forest has lost its capacity to recover from environmental stress between 2000 and 2024?
questions.explanation: A recent research study published in April 2026 highlights a concerning decline in the resilience of the Sundarbans mangrove ecosystem. It estimates that around 10-15% of the forest has lost its ability to recover effectively from environmental stress over the period from 2000 to 2024. This decline is attributed to multiple factors, including cyclonic disturbances, rising salinity due to reduced freshwater inflow, and human activities like shrimp farming and deforestation. The weakening resilience threatens biodiversity, including key species, and undermines the ecological stability of this critical mangrove habitat.

questions.question: Which city topped the national pollution index in India for March 2026 as per CREA rankings?
questions.explanation: Gurugram secured the top position as the most polluted city in India for March 2026, according to the Centre for Research on Energy and Clean Air (CREA). It recorded a high monthly average PM2.5 level of 116 µg/m³, indicating hazardous air quality conditions. Haryana had a significant presence in the rankings, contributing several cities among the most polluted. The findings emphasise the ongoing challenges of air pollution in urban and industrial regions. Efforts under the National Clean Air Programme aim to reduce particulate matter levels, but the data highlight the need for stronger implementation and monitoring measures.

questions.question: In which year was the Biological Diversity Act enacted in India?
questions.explanation: The Biological Diversity Act was enacted in 2002 to conserve India’s rich biodiversity, promote sustainable use of its components, and ensure fair and equitable sharing of benefits arising from the use of biological resources. The Act provides a legal framework for protecting biological diversity and associated knowledge. It led to the establishment of institutions like the National Biodiversity Authority, which plays a key role in regulating access to biological resources and advising the government. The Act also mandates proper documentation and preservation of newly discovered species through designated repositories.

questions.question: What will be emphasized at the annual climate conference to be held in November?
questions.explanation: The annual climate conference scheduled for November will lay particular stress on "Peace" and "Truce" to enable countries to focus on climate solutions amid ongoing conflicts. This emphasis aims to create a conducive environment for discussions and actions on addressing climate change issues during the conference, which will convene in Baku, Azerbaijan, hosting the 2024 UN Climate Change Conference (UNFCCC COP 29).

questions.question: Which critically endangered species was found in significant numbers during the annual waterhole census in the National Desert Park, Jaisalmer, Rajasthan?
questions.explanation: The Great Indian Bustard, a critically endangered species, was discovered in substantial numbers during the waterhole census in the National Desert Park, Jaisalmer, Rajasthan. This finding underscores the importance of conservation measures to protect this majestic bird species from further decline.

questions.question: In which country was the world's first 100% biodegradable pen launched?
questions.explanation: The world's first fully biodegradable pen, named the NOTE pen, was launched in India by Saurabh H Mehta from New Delhi. Featuring a recycled paper refill, non-toxic ink, and options of metal, paper, or bamboo exteriors, this innovation aims to address the significant issue of plastic waste generated by billions of discarded ballpoint pens annually.

questions.question: Who won silver medals for India at the U-23 World Wrestling Championships held in Serbia?
questions.explanation: Hansika Lamba and Sarika Malik secured silver medals for India at the U-23 World Wrestling Championships held in Serbia. Hansika competed in the 53kg category, where she lost 0–4 to Japan’s Haruna Morikawa in the final, while Sarika Malik, in the 55kg category, narrowly lost 1–2 to Ruka Natami. Their achievements significantly contributed to India’s overall success, as the country ended the tournament with an impressive total of seven medals, including five bronze medals in the women’s competition, marking a proud moment for Indian wrestling.

questions.question: In which city did the second edition of the Naval Commanders’ Conference 2025 conclude?
questions.explanation: The second edition of the biannual Naval Commanders’ Conference 2025 concluded in New Delhi after a three-day session that focused on strategic discussions and technological advancements within the Indian Navy. During the conference, a new digital platform named ‘NIPUN’ (Naval Intellectual Portal for Unified Knowledge) was launched to serve as an online hub for naval research and intellectual contributions. Additionally, five key naval publications were released, underscoring the Navy’s commitment to knowledge sharing, modernization, and enhancing operational readiness across India’s maritime domain.

questions.question: Which Indian Navy ship completed the 18th joint hydrographic survey with Mauritius, covering 35,000 square nautical miles?
questions.explanation: The Indian Navy’s hydrographic vessel INS Sutlej successfully completed the 18th joint hydrographic survey with Mauritius, mapping around 35,000 square nautical miles of Mauritian waters. This mission, conducted under the 2005 India-Mauritius MoU on hydrographic cooperation, strengthened maritime safety, environmental management, and regional security. Equipped with advanced instruments such as multibeam echo sounders and side-scan sonar, INS Sutlej also conducted joint EEZ surveillance and anti-piracy patrols alongside the Mauritius National Coast Guard. The initiative reflects India’s broader MAHASAGAR vision—Mutual & Holistic Advancement for Security and Growth Across the Regions—promoting sustainable maritime collaboration in the Indian Ocean.

questions.question: In which city did the four-day international dance and music festival ‘Udbhav Utsav’ begin?
questions.explanation: The international dance and music festival ‘Udbhav Utsav’ commenced in Gwalior with a colorful carnival that started from Captain Roop Singh Stadium and proceeded to Jiwaji University. The festival was inaugurated at the Atal Auditorium, Jiwaji University, by Padma Shri awardees Dr. Nalini and Dr. Kamalini, both eminent Kathak dancers. This grand cultural event celebrates global art forms and promotes cross-cultural exchange through performances by artists from various countries. Gwalior, known for its deep cultural and musical heritage, serves as an ideal venue for such an international celebration of dance and music.

questions.question: In which country is Exercise Ocean Sky 2025 being hosted, with the Indian Air Force participating?
questions.explanation: Exercise Ocean Sky 2025 is being hosted by the Spanish Air Force at Gando Air Base in Spain, with participation from several allied nations, including India, Germany, Greece, Portugal, and the United States. The Indian Air Force is showcasing its Su-30MKI fighter jets during the exercise, aimed at enhancing interoperability, mutual learning, and advanced air combat skills among the participating air forces. Spain’s role as host highlights its growing collaboration with global defence partners, while India’s involvement underscores its commitment to strengthening international military cooperation and operational readiness through such joint exercises.

questions.question: On which date is World Day for Audiovisual Heritage celebrated every year?
questions.explanation: World Day for Audiovisual Heritage is observed annually on October 27 to emphasise the importance of preserving the world’s audiovisual records—films, sound recordings, broadcasts, and digital media—that capture humanity’s cultural and historical diversity. Established by UNESCO in 2005, the day commemorates the 1980 adoption of the “Recommendation for the Safeguarding and Preservation of Moving Images.” The 2025 theme, “Digitizing Our Shared UNESCO History,” highlights the urgent need to convert fragile audiovisual materials into digital formats to protect them from decay, obsolescence, and loss, ensuring that future generations can access and learn from the world’s rich audiovisual heritage.

questions.question: Which country did India defeat 10–9 in the KogniVera International Polo Cup 2024 held in New Delhi?
questions.explanation: India secured a remarkable 10–9 victory over Argentina in the KogniVera International Polo Cup 2024 at the Jaipur Polo Ground, New Delhi. Led by Sawai Padmanabh Singh of Jaipur, the Indian team displayed exceptional coordination, tactical brilliance, and precision in their gameplay. The closely contested match showcased the high skill level of both teams and highlighted India’s growing strength in international polo competitions. Argentina, known for its strong polo tradition, posed a formidable challenge, making India’s triumph a significant achievement in the global polo arena.

questions.question: Which country successfully tested the nuclear-powered ‘Burevestnik’ cruise missile, as announced by its President?
questions.explanation: The nuclear-powered ‘Burevestnik’ cruise missile was successfully tested by Russia, as announced by President Vladimir Putin. This missile is a part of Russia’s advanced strategic arsenal aimed at strengthening its nuclear deterrence and global strike capabilities. The test demonstrated impressive performance, with the missile reportedly flying for 15 hours and covering a distance of 14,000 km. Such advancements highlight Russia’s focus on maintaining a technological edge in nuclear and long-range weapons systems, reinforcing its position as a leading global military power.

questions.question: Which Indian chess players won double gold medals at the 2025 European Chess Club Cup?
questions.explanation: Indian Grandmasters Gukesh Dommaraju and Divya Deshmukh achieved remarkable success by winning two gold medals each at the 2025 European Chess Club Cup. Gukesh represented Team Super Chess, while Divya played for Cercle d’échecs de Monte-Carlo, which triumphed in the Women’s Team Championship. Their performances demonstrated exceptional strategic skill, consistency, and composure against top international players. Alongside them, Nihal Sarin also secured an individual gold, contributing to India’s strong presence in global chess and highlighting the nation’s growing dominance in both men’s and women’s categories on the world stage.

questions.question: Who has been elected as Ireland’s 10th President after a landslide victory over Heather Humphreys?
questions.explanation: Catherine Connolly, an independent left-wing politician, has been elected as Ireland’s 10th President following a decisive victory over Heather Humphreys. Representing Galway West since 2016, Connolly has built a strong reputation as a dedicated public servant and an influential voice in Irish politics. Her prior role as Deputy Speaker of the Irish Parliament showcased her leadership and integrity. Known for her grassroots connection and progressive stance, Connolly’s election reflects a shift in Ireland’s political landscape toward inclusivity and independent representation, marking a significant moment in the nation’s democratic and social history.

questions.question: What is the name of the cyclone approaching the Andhra Pradesh coast, prompting a high alert in the state?
questions.explanation: Cyclone Montha, forming over the southeast Bay of Bengal, has put Andhra Pradesh on high alert due to forecasts of heavy to very heavy rainfall and strong winds. The cyclone is expected to make landfall near Kakinada, between Machilipatnam and Kalingapatnam. In response, the state government has intensified its preparedness measures to minimize potential damage and ensure public safety. Cyclone Montha’s movement underscores the importance of disaster management systems and early warning mechanisms in mitigating the impact of severe weather events along India’s eastern coastline.

questions.question: In which city did the four-day international dance and music festival ‘Udbhav Utsav’ begin?
questions.explanation: The international dance and music festival ‘Udbhav Utsav’ commenced in Gwalior with a colorful carnival that started from Captain Roop Singh Stadium and proceeded to Jiwaji University. The festival was inaugurated at the Atal Auditorium, Jiwaji University, by Padma Shri awardees Dr. Nalini and Dr. Kamalini, both eminent Kathak dancers. This grand cultural event celebrates global art forms and promotes cross-cultural exchange through performances by artists from various countries. Gwalior, known for its deep cultural and musical heritage, serves as an ideal venue for such an international celebration of dance and music.

questions.question: In which Indian state is the festival of Ningol Chakouba celebrated?
questions.explanation: Ningol Chakouba is a traditional festival celebrated in the northeastern state of Manipur, symbolizing the deep bond between married women and their brothers. Observed on the second day of the Meitei month of Hiyangei, the festival involves married women (Ningols) visiting their parental homes, where they are warmly welcomed and treated to a grand feast (Chakouba). The celebration reflects the values of love, respect, and family unity deeply rooted in Manipuri culture. Beyond its social significance, Ningol Chakouba also reinforces community harmony and preserves the rich cultural heritage of Manipur through shared familial traditions.

questions.question: Who has been appointed as the Chief Product and Business Officer at Google Cloud?
questions.explanation: Karthik Narain, a seasoned technology executive and former CTO of Accenture, has been appointed as the Chief Product and Business Officer at Google Cloud. In this role, he will oversee product and engineering teams across cloud, AI, developer tools, and Applied AI, while also leading the go-to-market strategy and collaborating with the public sector division. Narain’s appointment strengthens Google Cloud’s leadership team amid intense competition with AWS and Microsoft Azure. With over 25 years of experience in enterprise systems, AI, and cloud innovation, he is expected to accelerate Google Cloud’s global growth and drive AI-driven digital transformation for enterprise customers.

questions.question: Which Indian city has become the first to implement a Real-Time Flood Forecasting and Spatial Decision Support System (RTFF & SDSS)?
questions.explanation: Chennai has achieved a significant milestone by becoming the first Indian city to fully implement a Real-Time Flood Forecasting and Spatial Decision Support System (RTFF & SDSS) in October 2025. This initiative enhances the city’s ability to predict and manage floods with greater accuracy, thereby improving disaster preparedness and resilience against climate-induced challenges. Funded through the World Bank’s Project Development Grant Fund (PDGF), the system integrates weather data, river flow patterns, and urban drainage models. It positions Chennai as a pioneering example of how technology can strengthen urban flood management and protect vulnerable communities.

questions.question: Which institution has partnered with Coal India Limited to establish a Centre for Sustainable Energy?
questions.explanation: Coal India Limited (CIL) has entered into a strategic partnership with the Indian Institute of Technology (IIT) Madras to establish a Centre for Sustainable Energy. This collaboration aims to promote advanced research and development in clean energy technologies, low-carbon innovations, and repurposing of coal mines for sustainable applications. The initiative aligns with India’s broader goal of achieving a balanced and environmentally responsible energy transition. By combining CIL’s industry experience with IIT Madras’s research expertise, the partnership seeks to create scalable solutions that can contribute to reducing emissions and enhancing energy efficiency across sectors.

questions.question: Which Indian state is set to become the first to be officially declared free of extreme poverty?
questions.explanation: Kerala is poised to make history by becoming India’s first state to be officially declared free of extreme poverty on November 1, 2025. This achievement is the result of the state’s comprehensive Extreme Poverty Eradication Programme, launched in 2021, which identified and assisted families living in severe economic distress. Through targeted welfare initiatives, social inclusion measures, and effective governance, Kerala has significantly improved the living standards of its most vulnerable citizens. The declaration, to be made by Chief Minister Pinarayi Vijayan in Thiruvananthapuram, highlights Kerala’s continued leadership in social welfare and equitable development.

questions.question: On which date is Mole Day celebrated each year to honour Avogadro’s Number?
questions.explanation: Mole Day is observed annually on October 23 from 6:02 a.m. to 6:02 p.m., symbolizing Avogadro’s Number, 6.02 × 10²³, which is a fundamental constant in chemistry. The celebration helps students and enthusiasts appreciate the significance of the mole concept in understanding atomic theory, chemical reactions, and quantitative analysis. Named after Amedeo Avogadro, whose pioneering work laid the foundation for modern chemistry, Mole Day often includes educational activities, experiments, and themed events. In 2025, the theme “MOLEassic Park” highlights the fun and engaging way in which science education can connect with broader cultural references.

questions.question: In which Indian state is the Gangotri Dham located?
questions.explanation: Gangotri Dham is one of the four sacred Char Dham pilgrimage sites located in the state of Uttarakhand. Situated in the Uttarkashi district, it is dedicated to Goddess Ganga and marks the origin of the holy River Ganga. Each year, the temple closes for the winter season during the Annakut festival, and the idol of Goddess Ganga is ceremonially moved to Mukhba village, her winter abode. The temple reopens in summer, attracting thousands of devotees who seek spiritual blessings in the serene Himalayan region of Uttarakhand.

questions.question: In which city is the 42nd IndianOil SERVO Surjit Hockey Tournament being held?
questions.explanation: The 42nd IndianOil SERVO Surjit Hockey Tournament is taking place in Jalandhar at the Olympian Surjit Hockey Stadium. This prestigious tournament, conducted in a league-cum-knockout format, spans 10 days and features 12 competitive teams, including IndianOil Mumbai, Indian Navy Mumbai, and RCF Kapurthala. Played under floodlights, the event not only highlights the sporting culture of Jalandhar but also provides a platform for emerging and seasoned hockey players to showcase their skills. Known for its strong hockey heritage, Jalandhar continues to be a significant hub for field hockey tournaments and talent development in India.

questions.question: Which country has officially abolished the restrictive kafala (sponsorship) system for foreign workers?
questions.explanation: Saudi Arabia has officially abolished the kafala system, marking a historic reform in its labour laws. The kafala system had long been criticized for giving employers excessive control over foreign workers, including the ability to confiscate passports, restrict job mobility, and deny exit permits. By ending this system, Saudi Arabia aims to improve workers’ rights, attract skilled foreign labour, and align its policies with global labour standards. This reform also supports the goals of Saudi Vision 2030, which seeks to modernise the kingdom’s economy and enhance its global reputation as a fair and progressive employer.

questions.question: Who has been conferred the honourary rank of Lieutenant Colonel in the Territorial Army?
questions.explanation: Neeraj Chopra, India’s celebrated javelin thrower and two-time Olympic medallist, has been conferred the honourary rank of Lieutenant Colonel in the Territorial Army. Having joined the Indian Army as a Naib Subedar in 2016, he rose through the ranks to become Subedar and later Subedar Major. Neeraj’s outstanding achievements include prestigious honours such as the Arjuna Award (2018), Khel Ratna (2021), Padma Shri (2022), and Param Vishisht Seva Medal (2022). This recognition highlights his exemplary contributions to Indian sports and his embodiment of discipline, patriotism, and excellence both on and off the field.

questions.question: In which year was the original Vegetable Oil Products, Production and Availability (Regulation) Order introduced?
questions.explanation: The Vegetable Oil Products, Production and Availability (Regulation) Order was first introduced in 2011 under the Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution. It was later amended and reintroduced as the VOPPA Order, 2025. The 2011 version served as the foundational regulatory framework governing the production, processing, and distribution of edible oils in India, ensuring quality control, fair trade practices, and consumer protection. The 2025 amendment builds upon this framework by introducing mandatory registration for all participants in the edible oil supply chain.

questions.question: What is the name of the new elite commando unit and drone platoons recently raised by the Indian Army?
questions.explanation: The Indian Army has raised new Bhairav Battalions along with specialised drone platoons to strengthen its rapid-response and high-mobility warfare capabilities. Each Bhairav Battalion consists of around 250 personnel and is designed to operate between regular infantry and Special Forces. These units will enhance surveillance, strike precision, and adaptability during surprise operations along India’s borders with China and Pakistan. The concept of the Bhairav Battalions and drone platoons evolved from operational lessons learned during Operation Sindoor in May 2025, reflecting India’s growing emphasis on technology-integrated military readiness.

questions.question: In which Indian state is the festival of Ningol Chakouba celebrated?
questions.explanation: Ningol Chakouba is a traditional festival celebrated in the northeastern state of Manipur, symbolizing the deep bond between married women and their brothers. Observed on the second day of the Meitei month of Hiyangei, the festival involves married women (Ningols) visiting their parental homes, where they are warmly welcomed and treated to a grand feast (Chakouba). The celebration reflects the values of love, respect, and family unity deeply rooted in Manipuri culture. Beyond its social significance, Ningol Chakouba also reinforces community harmony and preserves the rich cultural heritage of Manipur through shared familial traditions.

questions.question: In which city did Defence Minister Rajnath Singh inaugurate the Titanium and Superalloy Materials Plant to boost India’s defence self-reliance?
questions.explanation: The Titanium and Superalloy Materials Plant was inaugurated in Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh, marking a significant step in India’s pursuit of self-reliance in strategic materials for defence, aerospace, and electronics. The facility produces high-grade titanium and superalloys used in fighter jets, missiles, naval systems, and satellites. With a production capacity exceeding 6,000 tonnes annually, it supports indigenous manufacturing of critical components like turbine blades and missile parts. Located within the Uttar Pradesh Defence Industrial Corridor, this plant strengthens India’s technological and industrial base, promotes employment, and reduces dependence on foreign imports for strategic defence materials.

questions.question: On which date will Bandi Chhor Divas be celebrated in 2025?
questions.explanation: Bandi Chhor Divas in 2025 falls on October 21. This Sikh festival commemorates the release of Guru Hargobind Sahib Ji from Gwalior Fort along with 52 princes. The day coincides with Diwali but has its own unique spiritual significance, symbolizing liberation, justice, and selflessness. Sikhs celebrate it with prayers, devotional singing, lighting of lamps, and community service through langar. The festival honours the Guru’s act of ensuring freedom for others, highlighting values of equality, compassionate leadership, and collective responsibility. Its observance is widespread both in India and across the global Sikh diaspora.

questions.question: Which country developed its first fully indigenous antibiotic, Nafithromycin, and achieved a major milestone in gene therapy for hemophilia?
questions.explanation: India has developed Nafithromycin, its first homegrown antibiotic, aimed at treating resistant respiratory infections, especially in vulnerable patients. This achievement, alongside successful indigenous gene therapy trials for hemophilia, underscores India’s growing capabilities in biotechnology, pharmaceutical innovation, and clinical research. These breakthroughs were enabled by collaborations between the Department of Biotechnology and private firms like Wockhardt, reflecting a strong public-private partnership. Additionally, India’s progress in genome sequencing and precision medicine positions the country as a rising leader in healthcare innovation, reducing dependence on foreign technologies and advancing its goal of biotech self-reliance under the Viksit Bharat 2047 vision.

questions.question: Who became the first Indian to receive the WCPA-Kenton Miller Award for innovation in protected area sustainability?
questions.explanation: Dr. Sonali Ghosh, Field Director of Kaziranga National Park, became the first Indian recipient of the WCPA-Kenton Miller Award at the IUCN World Conservation Congress in Abu Dhabi, UAE. The award, established in 2006, is presented biennially by the World Commission on Protected Areas (WCPA) to recognise innovative contributions to the sustainability and management of national parks and protected areas. Dr. Ghosh’s leadership and initiatives at Kaziranga National Park have enhanced biodiversity conservation, park management, and community engagement, reflecting global standards in environmental stewardship and making India proud on the international conservation stage.

questions.question: Who has been recommended by Tata Trusts for a third term as Chairman of Tata Sons?
questions.explanation: Tata Trusts has recommended N Chandrasekaran for a third term as Chairman of Tata Sons, the principal holding company of the Tata Group. This recommendation is significant given that Tata Trusts controls 66% of Tata Sons’ equity, giving them substantial influence over leadership decisions. Chandrasekaran’s tenure has been marked by strategic initiatives and governance oversight within the conglomerate. The decision comes amid internal disagreements among the trustees, particularly on board appointments and governance matters, reflecting the importance of strong leadership continuity to maintain stability and direction in one of India’s largest and most diversified business groups.

questions.question: Which Indian spacecraft made the first direct observation of solar activity affecting the Moon’s exosphere?
questions.explanation: Chandrayaan-2, launched by ISRO in 2019, made the first direct observation of how Coronal Mass Ejections (CMEs) from the Sun impact the Moon’s exosphere. The CHACE-2 instrument on board recorded a significant increase in the density of neutral atoms and molecules, confirming that solar outbursts can dramatically alter the lunar atmosphere. This finding enhances understanding of lunar space weather, especially because the Moon lacks a global magnetic field and atmosphere, making its exosphere highly sensitive to solar activity. Chandrayaan-2’s observations contribute valuable data for future lunar missions and planetary science research.

questions.question: Who became Japan’s first female prime minister in 2025, marking a historic milestone in the country’s politics?
questions.explanation: Sanae Takaichi was elected as Japan’s first female prime minister on October 21, 2025, receiving 237 votes in the 465-seat Lower House. Her election represents both a historic breakthrough for gender representation and a political shift to the right, reflecting her conservative views modeled on Shinzo Abe and Margaret Thatcher. Takaichi advocates stricter immigration policies, traditional family values, and a stronger national security stance, while also signaling fiscal stimulus measures to address economic challenges. Her leadership is significant not only for breaking a political glass ceiling but also for influencing Japan’s domestic and international policy direction.

questions.question: Which country has launched its first-ever State Mining Readiness Index to rank States on mining efficiency, reforms, and sustainability?
questions.explanation: India has launched the inaugural State Mining Readiness Index (SMRI) as part of the Union Budget 2025–26. Developed by the Ministry of Mines, the SMRI evaluates States on operational efficiency, reform-readiness, and sustainable practices in managing non-coal mineral resources. The index aims to promote transparency, accountability, and healthy competition among States, while encouraging sustainable mining practices aligned with climate and social responsibilities. It also categorises States based on their mineral resource endowment to ensure fair benchmarking. This initiative marks a significant step in modernizing India’s mineral governance.

questions.question: Which country signed a critical minerals deal with the U.S. to reduce dependence on China and strengthen Indo-Pacific security?
questions.explanation: Australia signed an $8.5 billion critical minerals agreement with the U.S., aimed at reducing reliance on China for key minerals like lithium, nickel, and rare earth elements. The pact includes joint investment in mining and processing infrastructure, market stabilization measures, and reforms to speed up projects. It also features U.S. EXIM Bank support and plans for a gallium refinery in Western Australia. This deal strengthens strategic supply chains, supports defence and technology sectors, and reinforces Indo-Pacific security. It highlights the growing collaboration between the U.S. and Australia to secure critical resources while countering China’s dominance in the market.

questions.question: On which date is Police Commemoration Day observed in India to honour officers who died in the line of duty?
questions.explanation: Police Commemoration Day is observed annually on October 21 in India to honour police personnel who sacrificed their lives in the line of duty. The date commemorates a tragic ambush in 1959 at Hot Springs, Ladakh, where ten Indian police officers were killed and several captured by Chinese troops. The day serves to remember their courage and dedication while reinforcing morale and pride within the police forces. Ceremonies at the National Police Memorial in New Delhi, along with public events during the following Commemoration Week, highlight the sacrifices made by police personnel and strengthen public awareness of their vital role in maintaining internal security.

questions.question: On which date will Bandi Chhor Divas be celebrated in 2025?
questions.explanation: Bandi Chhor Divas in 2025 falls on October 21. This Sikh festival commemorates the release of Guru Hargobind Sahib Ji from Gwalior Fort along with 52 princes. The day coincides with Diwali but has its own unique spiritual significance, symbolizing liberation, justice, and selflessness. Sikhs celebrate it with prayers, devotional singing, lighting of lamps, and community service through langar. The festival honours the Guru’s act of ensuring freedom for others, highlighting values of equality, compassionate leadership, and collective responsibility. Its observance is widespread both in India and across the global Sikh diaspora.

questions.question: Which edition of the Dehradun Literature Festival will be held in 2025?
questions.explanation: The 2025 Dehradun Literature Festival marks its 7th edition, celebrating literature, art, and cultural dialogue. The event will feature distinguished personalities such as Former Chief Justice of India DY Chandrachud, filmmaker Imtiaz Ali, writer and columnist Shobhaa De, and singer Usha Uthup. With the theme “Vasudhaiva Kutumbakam: Voices of Unity,” the festival emphasises the spirit of global harmony and shared human values. Hosted at the Doon International School in Dehradun, the festival continues to serve as a vibrant platform for authors, artists, and thinkers to exchange creative ideas and cultural perspectives.

questions.question: In which Indian state is the Mera Hou Chongba festival, celebrating Hill-valley unity, observed?
questions.explanation: The Mera Hou Chongba festival is celebrated in Manipur and is a unique cultural event that symbolises Hill-valley unity, promoting communal harmony among all indigenous communities. Observed annually on the 15th lunar day of the Mera month in the Meitei calendar, the festival features traditional rituals and a ceremonial march from the Royal Palace to Kangla. It stands out as the only festival in Manipur where participants from all indigenous communities come together, highlighting the state’s rich heritage, social cohesion, and the celebration of cultural diversity.

questions.question: In which city was the Centre for Makhana Excellence launched by Union Agriculture Minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan?
questions.explanation: The Centre for Makhana Excellence was launched in Patna, Bihar, during a Makhana Festival attended by Union Agriculture Minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan. The centre aims to enhance quality control, promote value addition, and support the growth of the makhana industry in India. Alongside the launch, the Minister released the report “Makhana to the world — from culture to prosperity,” highlighting strategies to expand the market reach and economic potential of this aquatic crop. The initiative reflects the government’s focus on boosting agricultural innovation and promoting regional specialties for national and global markets.

questions.question: Which Indian state’s Bathukamma Festival achieved two Guinness World Records for the largest floral arrangement and the most synchronised female dance event?
questions.explanation: Telangana earned global recognition when its Bathukamma Festival set two Guinness World Records — one for the largest floral arrangement and another for the most synchronised female dance event. The vibrant festival, symbolizing devotion to Goddess Gauri and the celebration of feminine energy, featured over 300 artisans crafting a massive floral structure in 72 hours and thousands of women performing traditional dances in unison. Bathukamma, deeply rooted in Telangana’s agrarian and cultural traditions, coincides with Navratri and promotes eco-friendly practices, women’s empowerment, and community harmony, showcasing the state’s rich cultural heritage on an international stage.

questions.question: In which state was the third edition of the Unmesha International Literature Festival 2025 held?
questions.explanation: The third edition of the Unmesha International Literature Festival 2025 was hosted in Patna, Bihar, from 25th to 28th September. Bihar was chosen not only as the venue but also as a symbolic representation of India’s rich intellectual and cultural heritage. The state has historically been a cradle of knowledge, with ancient institutions like Nalanda and Vikramshila, spiritual centers like Bodh Gaya and Vaishali, and deep contributions to India’s democratic, political, and social fabric. Hosting the festival here highlighted Bihar’s global legacy in literature, art, and cultural dialogue while showcasing its vibrant traditions like Mithila painting and Chhath Puja.

questions.question: In which state did the Election Commission of India revise poll dates to accommodate the Bishnoi community’s annual festival?
questions.explanation: The Election Commission of India (ECI) revised the poll dates in Haryana to October 5, 2024, in response to the Bishnoi community’s request to accommodate their annual festival, which falls on the same date. This decision reflects the ECI's commitment to ensuring inclusive voting by preventing any conflict between the festival and the polling day. The change underscores the ECI's efforts to respect cultural and religious sentiments while upholding the democratic process, allowing all eligible voters in Haryana to participate in the election without hindrance.

questions.question: In which country is the annual Kataragama Esala festival celebrated?
questions.explanation: The Kataragama Esala festival, also known as the Kataragama Perahera, is celebrated annually in Sri Lanka. It is a significant religious and cultural event that attracts thousands of devotees and visitors from across the country and beyond. The festival is dedicated to the worship of Lord Kataragama, a deity revered by both Hindus and Buddhists. The celebrations include vibrant processions, religious rituals, and various cultural performances, making it one of the most important festivals in Sri Lanka.

questions.question: In which state is Hul Diwas celebrated to commemorate the tribal uprising against British rule?
questions.explanation: Hul Kranti Diwas is celebrated on June 30 every year in Jharkhand to honour the 1855 independence movement led by tribal heroes Sidho, Kanho, Chand, and Bhairav, among others. This day marks a significant event in India's freedom struggle, where more than 50,000 tribals from 400 villages in Jharkhand revolted against British rule.

questions.question: Where does the Hemis Festival, celebrating Tibetan Buddhism, take place annually?
questions.explanation: The Hemis Festival, known as Hemis Tsechu, is celebrated annually in Ladakh, India. This vibrant cultural event honours Guru Padmasambhava and features the iconic Chaam dance performed by monks at the Hemis Monastery. It showcases traditional Buddhist rituals, thangka exhibitions, and local handicrafts, highlighting Ladakh's rich cultural heritage and spiritual significance.

questions.question: Which company launched the Diversified Equity Fund II as a New Fund Offer in April 2026?
questions.explanation: Axis Max Life Insurance Limited introduced the Diversified Equity Fund II on April 23, 2026, as a New Fund Offer aimed at long-term wealth creation. The fund is designed with a multi-cap investment strategy, ensuring diversification across sectors and market capitalisations. It maintains a minimum of 80% exposure to equities for growth while allocating the remaining portion to debt instruments for stability. The fund is benchmarked against the NSE Nifty 200 Index and is offered through select ULIPs. Its launch reflects the company’s focus on providing balanced investment opportunities with strong return potential over time.

questions.question: Which company launched the Unit Linked Insurance Plan (ULIP) named Promise4Wealth to offer life insurance and wealth creation solutions?
questions.explanation: Canara HSBC Life Insurance introduced the ULIP product Promise4Wealth to combine life insurance coverage with investment opportunities. The plan offers multiple fund options, including equity, debt, and balanced funds, allowing policyholders to tailor their investments based on risk appetite. It also includes features like a safety switch option to secure gains, loyalty additions to boost returns, and return of mortality charges at maturity. Additionally, flexible withdrawal options such as systematic withdrawal plans and milestone withdrawals help meet financial goals, making it a comprehensive financial planning solution.

questions.question: By which year does the RBI’s Payments Vision document aim to achieve its outlined goals?
questions.explanation: The Payments Vision document introduced by the Reserve Bank of India provides a structured roadmap for the development of the country’s digital payment ecosystem. It clearly defines a timeline extending over the next few years, culminating in December 2028. This timeframe allows for the implementation of various initiatives such as enhanced security frameworks, user empowerment tools, and technological innovations like AI integration. By setting 2028 as the target year, the RBI ensures a focused and phased approach toward strengthening digital payments, improving efficiency, and maintaining India’s leadership in global financial technology advancements.

questions.question: Which company became a signatory to the United Nations Global Compact, committing to integrate ESG principles into its operations?
questions.explanation: L&T Finance Ltd became a signatory to the United Nations Global Compact (UNGC), marking a significant step toward embedding Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) principles into its business strategy. By joining this global initiative, the company aligns itself with internationally recognized standards focused on human rights, labour practices, environmental protection, and anti-corruption. It also commits to supporting the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs). As part of this engagement, the company must submit an annual Communication on Progress report, ensuring transparency, accountability, and continuous improvement in its sustainability efforts.

questions.question: Which company launched India’s first passive hybrid index fund combining equity and government securities?
questions.explanation: Edelweiss Asset Management is the entity that introduced India’s first passive hybrid index fund, marking an important innovation in the mutual fund industry. The fund combines equity exposure through the Nifty LargeMidcap250 Index with debt investment in government securities via the Nifty 8–13 year G-Sec Index. This structure allows investors to benefit from both market growth and relative stability. The initiative follows regulatory approvals for debt indices and aims to provide a diversified investment option that balances risk and returns, making it suitable for investors seeking long-term financial stability.

questions.question: Which regulatory body launched the Saathi 2.0 Personal Finance App for Investors?
questions.explanation: The Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) launched the Saathi 2.0 app, aimed at simplifying financial concepts and providing reliable information to investors. This initiative reflects SEBI's commitment to empowering investors and enhancing their understanding of the securities market.

questions.question: Which financial institution faced a penalty from the RBI for violating fair practices code provisions?
questions.explanation: The penalty of Rs 3.1 lakh imposed by the RBI for violating fair practices code provisions was on Hero FinCorp. Despite its response and participation in the hearing, the RBI found the charges against the company substantiated, resulting in a penalty.

questions.question: Which country will soon launch India's RuPay service?
questions.explanation: Maldives is set to launch India's RuPay service, which is an Indian domestic card payment network introduced by NPCI in 2012. The introduction of RuPay aims to reduce reliance on international card schemes like Visa and MasterCard, enhance financial inclusion with affordable card services, and support India's Digital India initiative.

questions.question: Which entity divested its entire stake in Protean eGov Technologies?
questions.explanation: HDFC Bank divested its entire 3.20% stake in Protean eGov Technologies, comprising 12,94,326 shares, for Rs 150 crore through an open market transaction. This sale was made at an average price of Rs 1,160.15 per share. The move indicates HDFC Bank's decision to exit its investment in Protean eGov Technologies.

questions.question: With whom has SIDBI partnered to provide financing for helicopter purchases in India?
questions.explanation: SIDBI has collaborated with Airbus Helicopters to facilitate financing for helicopter purchases in India, aiming to enhance accessibility for civil operators. This partnership signifies SIDBI's entry into helicopter financing and its commitment to supporting the growth of India's rotary wing sector, with Airbus Helicopters being a significant player in the Indian helicopter market.

questions.question: On which date is World Red Cross and Red Crescent Day observed annually?
questions.explanation: World Red Cross and Red Crescent Day is observed every year on May 08 to recognise humanitarian efforts carried out across the world by volunteers and aid workers. The day commemorates the birth anniversary of Henry Dunant, the founder of the International Red Cross and Red Crescent Movement. In 2026, the theme was “United in Humanity. No Matter Where, No Matter When,” highlighting the importance of humanitarian assistance during conflicts, disasters, and refugee crises. Volunteers and relief workers provided support in regions affected by war, displacement, and infrastructure damage, including areas in the Middle East, Ukraine, and refugee camps in Chad, demonstrating global solidarity and compassion.

questions.question: On which date is International Dance Day celebrated annually to promote dance as a universal form of expression and cultural unity?
questions.explanation: International Dance Day is celebrated every year on April 29 to honour the birth anniversary of Jean-Georges Noverre, a pioneer of modern dance. The day highlights the importance of dance as a universal language that transcends cultural and linguistic barriers. It encourages participation from people of all ages and promotes creativity, emotional expression, and cultural exchange. Organised globally with support from institutions like UNESCO, the observance brings together artists, students, and communities through performances, workshops, and events. It also emphasizes the role of dance in improving physical fitness, mental well-being, and fostering global harmony.

questions.question: On which date is the World Day for Safety and Health at Work observed annually to promote safe and healthy workplaces?
questions.explanation: World Day for Safety and Health at Work is observed annually on April 28 to raise awareness about workplace safety and promote healthy working conditions globally. Initiated by the International Labour Organisation (ILO), the day focuses on preventing occupational accidents and diseases while improving overall worker well-being. It also commemorates workers who have suffered injuries or lost their lives due to unsafe work environments. The observance highlights the importance of strong safety standards, mental health awareness, and collaboration among governments, employers, and employees to build safer, more inclusive, and productive workplaces worldwide.

questions.question: On which date is National Panchayati Raj Day observed annually in India?
questions.explanation: National Panchayati Raj Day is observed every year on April 24 to mark the constitutional recognition of Panchayati Raj institutions in India through the 73rd Constitutional Amendment Act of 1992. This reform established a structured three-tier system of local governance, empowering rural communities and promoting decentralisation. The day highlights the importance of grassroots democracy, ensuring the participation of local populations in decision-making. It also emphasises inclusivity through reservations for women and marginalised groups. Celebrations include recognising best-performing Panchayats and promoting initiatives that strengthen transparency, accountability, and sustainable rural development.

questions.question: On which date is World Malaria Day observed annually across the world?
questions.explanation: World Malaria Day is observed every year on April 25 to raise global awareness about malaria and promote coordinated efforts to combat the disease. Established by the World Health Organisation, the day emphasises prevention, early diagnosis, and effective treatment strategies. It also highlights advancements such as vaccines and improved healthcare systems while addressing ongoing challenges like transmission in vulnerable regions. Governments, NGOs, and communities participate through awareness campaigns, free testing, and distribution of preventive tools like mosquito nets. The observance reinforces the importance of sustained global cooperation to achieve the goal of malaria elimination.

questions.question: When is Buddha Purnima 2024 celebrated?
questions.explanation: Buddha Purnima 2024, also known as Buddha Jayanti or Vesak, is celebrated on Thursday, May 23, 2024, marking the birth, enlightenment, and death of Gautama Buddha. This significant Buddhist festival is observed across South, Southeast, and East Asia with prayer meetings, religious discussions, and cultural events, honouring the profound teachings and enduring legacy of the Buddha. It is a public holiday in several Indian states, including Haryana, Delhi, Himachal Pradesh, Jammu Kashmir, West Bengal, Uttar Pradesh, Uttarakhand, Maharashtra, and the Andaman and Nicobar Islands.

questions.question: When is the International Day for Biological Diversity celebrated?
questions.explanation: The International Day for Biological Diversity is annually observed on May 22. This day highlights the importance of biodiversity and encourages global action to protect and preserve it. It serves as a reminder of the crucial role biodiversity plays in sustaining life on Earth and aligns with the UN's Sustainable Development Goals.

questions.question: In which country was the humanoid robot monk Gabi introduced?
questions.explanation: South Korea introduced its first humanoid robot monk named Gabi after it completed a traditional Buddhist precept ceremony at the Jogye Temple in Seoul on May 07, 2026. The initiative was organised by the Jogye Order to address the shortage of human monks and attract younger generations toward Buddhism through technology. Developed using China’s Unitree G1 platform, the robot was given symbolic Buddhist elements such as a rosary and a ceremonial burn sticker. Specially modified vows were also designed for the robot, including respecting life, avoiding deception, and saving energy. Gabi is expected to participate in religious and cultural events such as the Yeondeunghoe lantern festival.

questions.question: Which Prime Minister of the Solomon Islands was ousted after losing a no-confidence vote in May 2026?
questions.explanation: Jeremiah Manele, the Prime Minister of the Solomon Islands, was removed from office on May 7, 2026, after losing a no-confidence vote in the national parliament. He lost the motion by 22 votes to 26 in the 50-seat legislature. The political crisis intensified after multiple cabinet resignations and the withdrawal of coalition partners from the ruling Government for National Unity and Transformation. Concerns regarding governance, financial accountability, and rising infrastructure debt to China further contributed to the instability. Following the vote, parliament was adjourned so that the Governor-General could oversee the process of electing a new national leader under the country’s parliamentary democratic system.

questions.question: Which country participated with India in the ninth Foreign Office Consultations held in May 2026?
questions.explanation: India and Sudan conducted the ninth round of Foreign Office Consultations (FOC) in Port Sudan on May 4, 2026, to review and strengthen bilateral relations.
